tei:div.tei:p: rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang /kru'u rin/ dgra 'dul/kru'u rin gzhon pa/ gdugs dkar tshe ring /gtso sgrig pa/ bsod nams tshe ring /gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ rta mgrin skyabs/ rin chen don grub/sgrol ma rgya mtsho/rtsom sgrig u yon/ rdo rje tshe ring / tshe ring thar/ gsang bdagapadma rdo rje/ blo gros/ bde skyid sgrol ma/bkra rgyal/ zla ba tshe ring / dbang phyug mtsho mo/lis zha'o kru'u/ lha byams rgyal/

sngon 'gro'i gtam/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtam/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing ri klung bar khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/bod mi rigs rnams lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol nas gzhis chags shing 'tsho gzhes gnang ste 'od stong rnam par bkra ba'i lo rgyus bskrun yod la/ khyad par du bod rig pa zhes mtshan snyan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la mngon par ldir ba'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod zad mtha' med pa zhig nga tsho phyi rabs pa'i bgo skal du stsal cing / gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i mkhas dbang mang po rim par byon nas dus rabs so sor rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos sna tshogs shig rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang /bod rang gi khyad chos dang yongs su mthun pa'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar ba zhig gsar skrun bgyis pa des/1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsom rig spyi'i rigs sam lus kyi rnam pa je mang je tshang du btang ba yin pas/ rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs thad bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes shig dang rmad du byung ba'i dge mtshan zhig bskrun par snang ngo / /skabs bab kyi brjod bya legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad de don gang la 'jug ce na/ yongs grags su sgra yangs 'jug dang dog 'jug gnyis su dbye ste brjod par bya dgos te/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing don gyis phyug pa'i gsung rnam dag dang bstan bcos mtha' dag la legs bshad ces pa sgra yangs 'jug gi don yin la/ rtsom stangs nges can zhig gis 'ching ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la legs bshad ces pa sgra dog 'jug gi don yin no/ /de ltar 'jug pa'i don gnyis ni phan tshun 'gal bar mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pa'i phyir/ sgra dog 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na yangs 'jug gi don gyi rang bzhin ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /yin na'ang sgra yangs 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na dog 'jug gi don gyi bdag 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/nyid ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i nges pa ma mchis so/ /'dir brjod pa'i legs bshad ni sgra dog 'jug gi don yin te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la brjod pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa der khyad chos ci zhig ldan zhe na/ de la 'di ltar brtag dgos te/brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs la dpe don legs par sbyar te tshigs bcad kyi rnam pas ston pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos la legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin/ de'i brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs yin par smra bar rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang bstun nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ chos lugs/ slob gso/ dmag don la sogs pa chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya dngos mang po la legs par dpyad nas/chos lugs kyi bsam blo/ srid 'dzin gyi thabs lam/ mkhas blun gyi spyod pa/ blang dor gyi tshad gzhi bcas lkog gyur gyi don mang po la rang nyid kyi lta stangs dang bzhed tshul gsal bar ston pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /legs bshad bstan bcos de sgyu 3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsal gyi rang bzhin yongs su gtams pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos yin pa'i dbang gis/ de'i rjod byed kyi tshig dang ston byed kyi thabs la brtsams chos gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos mang po yod/ mdor sdud na/ legs bshad kyi brtsams chos mtha' dag tshigs bcad kyi rnam pa yin pa dang gcig sho lo ka gcig las tshig rkang gnyis dpe dang tshig rkang gnyis don snga phyi nges med du legs par sbyar te bstan bya rdzogs par ston pa dang gnyis/gsal byed kyi dpe skye bo mkhas blun thams cad kyis nyams su myong ba'am thos pa las byung ba'i yun ring du 'dris pa'i bya dngos yin pa dang gsum/ tshig sbyor bde zhing go sla ba/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe'i rang bzhin ldan pa/ skye bo kun gyis dka' tshegs med par bde blag tu 'jug nus pa dang bzhi/ tshig snyan zhing ro nyams ldan pa/ skye bo mchog dman kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa dang lnga'i khyad par gyi yon tan ldan pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi rtsom rig gi rnam pa de/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gal che zhing 'phang mtho ba'i go sa yod par mkhas pa 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/rnams kyis yang yang du bsngags pa'o/ /legs bshad rtsom rig de bod la ji ltar byung ba dang ji ltar 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thad cung tsam dpyad na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang tun hong yig cha nas zhal gdams zhes pa dpe don sbyar nas bslab bya'i rang bzhin yod pa'i brtsams chos byung / de dag ni legs bshad rtsom rig gi sa bon lta bur gyur te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa de bod yul du thog mar gzhi chags so/ /de rjes spyi lo dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gdams de dag gi srol rgyun gzhir byas shing / 'phags yul gyi rtsom rig skye bo gso thigs sogs brtsams chos 'ga' dper byas nas legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i sho lo ka bzhi brgya lhag yod pa'i brtsams chos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam gzhag gtan la phab/ dus rabs bcu drug par paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas sa skya legs bshad kyi rnam gzhag dang cha yongs su mtshungs pa'i mkhas blun brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bshad padma dkar po'i chun po zhes bya ba sho lo ka brgya lhag ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam pa de je rgyas je legs su btang / de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad par gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes gong smras legs bshad bstan bcos dag ma dper byas nas chu'i bstan bcos dang shing gi bstan bcos zhes bsdoms pas sho lo ka nyis brgya lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos gnyis mdzad pa dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mkhas dbang dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pas gung thang pa'i chu shing bstan bcos kyi rtsom stangs dang yongs su mthun pa'i lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba sho lo ka drug cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes pa sho lo ka sum cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos sogs du ma mdzad/ brtsams chos de dag ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dpe chos can gcig gi steng du de'i skyon yon brtags shing don dang sbyar nas bslab bya'i tshul gyis ston pa yin 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/pas legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gsar ba zhig spel ba yin/gzhan yang mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos gong smras legs bshad rtsom stangs kyi legs cha yongs su bsdus nas rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba le'u nyer gcig dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gong nas gong du spel ba yin no/ /smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi pir rtse las /thon pa'i leṭa par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /rang re gangs can rtsom rig bang mdzod du/ /'od 'bar nor bu gcig tu ci yang snang / /de yang 'dzam gling rig gnas dga' tshal du/ /legs bshad ces pa'i me tog mtshar sdug cig /rnam par bzhad pas phyi nang mkhas pa yi/ /yid kyi bung ba dbang med phyogs 'dir 'khor/ /'di ltar legs bshad kyi che ba brjod pa dang rtsom rig gi rin thang dpog pa ni/ rtog bzo dang sgro 'dogs kyi gtam tsam ma 7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yin te/ bstan bcos de dag gi dngos gzhi dang de las byung ba'i phan yon gyis bsgrubs pas so/ /'o na legs bshad bstan bcos las byung ba'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ gzhan phan dge phyogs la mos pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba spong dgos pa'i slob gso gtong ba dang gcig yon tan la bstod cing blun rmongs la smad pa'i bsam blo spel ba dang gnyis/ las la brtson pa dang le lo spong dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum/ che ba la gus shing chung ba la gces pa'i lugs bzang spel ba dang bzhi/ mthun sgril la dga' zhing dbyen 'byed la sdang ba'i spyod bzang dar spel gtong ba dang lnga'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyogs lnga las bslab bya'i tshul gyis gdams te/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo dag sbyong dang kun spyod legs skyong byed pa la phan yon dpag dka' ba byung zhing / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dpal yon dang bsam blo'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang spyi tshogs mthun sgrig byed pa la phan nus gzhal dka' ba bton pa yin no/ /da res mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis legs bshad 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bstan bcos de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa'i dpe tshogs par skrun byas pa de/ spyi tshogs la phan pa'i dge mtshan dang / rig gnas la phan pa'i don snying ldan pa zhig yin no/ /gna' mo'i legs bshad bstan bcos kyis/ /spel ba'i dgongs pa'i dge mtshan de/ /deng gi bsam blo'i dpal yon gyi/ /don snying dang mthun e ma rmad/ /ces spyi lo2006lo'i zla3pa'i tshes24nyin gyi na ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ /

dkar chagadakar chag rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam bzhugs so/ / rje tsong kha pas mdzad/(1)bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes bzhugs so/ /paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/(11)zhal gdams mgur ma bzhugs so/ / shar skal ldan rgya mtshos mdzad/(25)lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad bzhugs so/ / lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis mdzad/(29)bslab bya mu thi la'i 'khri shing bzhugs so/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/(36)mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs so co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyis mdzad/(43)rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i 1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad/(62)bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhugs so/ / lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad/(70)bslab bya mu tig phreng ba bzhugs so/ /thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad/(83)nyams myong rgan po'i 'beel gtam yid 'byung dmar khrid bzhugs so/ / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad/(92)bod la slob gnyer du song ba rnams la bslab bya byas pa mu thi la'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyis mdzad/(109)man ngag snying po bzhugs so/ /yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/(113)pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla bas mdzad/(118)lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal bzhugs so/ /dngul chu dharma bha dras mdzad/(129)2

dkar chagazhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs so/ / zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtshos mdzad/(139)ri bya nga yi skad cha/grub pa'i dbang rgyug ngag dbang tshogs gnyis kyis mdzad/(150)yid la bsam pa'i don tshig lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs bzhugs so/ /kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtshos mdzad/(178)bslab bya skyon mtshang zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman gyi thur ma bzhugs so/ / rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad/(186)bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba bzhugs so/ /rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad/(194)snying po'i lha chos byed par gdams pa bzhugs so/ /dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad/(210)bod sog gi sku skye rnams la 455 ba'i zhal gdams bzhugs so/ / tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzad/(214)nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs bzhugs so/ /dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtshos mdzad/(226)tha ma kha dang / myos byed/ sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs 3
gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(247)slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhu/gas so/ /nom chi mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis mdzad/(267)

rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam/rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam bzhugs so/ /rje tsong kha pas mdzad/bslab gsum rgyan dang thos pa'i pha rol son/ /stong gsum khyab pa'i grangs ldan 'gro ba'i mgon/ /sku gsum mngon mdzad bla ma'i zhabs pad la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gnyis phul byung lus stobs rgyas pa la/ /bslab gsum rnam dag gser gyi dra bas g.yogs/ /sku bzhi'i mche ba rab dkar shin tu brtan/ /sku lnga'i bdag nyid thub dbang lag ldan rgyal/ /dal 'byor thob kyang dal ba'i skabs med cing / /bde 'gror skyes kyang bde bas dben par gyur/ /chos la mos kyang chos don rtogs pa med/ /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo gros dman yang blo bzang zhes btags pa'i/ /rgyal khams pa khyod rang gi bskul tshig la/ /ma g.yengs rna ba'i dbang shes legs gtad de/ /lung dang rigs pas legs par brtags byas nas/ /'dir smras don rnams nyams su blang bar rigs/ /khyod kyis sngon yang dug gsum la spyad pas/ /thog ma med nas tha ma da yi bar/ /ma rig khrod 'dir bgrang las 'das pa 'khor/ /bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /da dung 'di la spyad par byas na ni/ /slar yang ngan song gsum las 'gro sa med/ /kyi hud ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal bzod gyur tam/ /kye ma'o de rgyu deng nas spang bar rigs/ /zhes smras pa dang / kho na re/ 'o na der mi skye ba'i thabs ci yod/de yi sdug bsngal yang ji tsam/ sdug bsngal de nyams su myong ba'i rgyu ci/ zhes pa'i lan smras pa/2

rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam/ngan 'gro'i gnas su mi skye'i thabs dag ni/ /bshad kyis legs par nyon dang rgyal khams pa/ /'phral phugs kun tu mi bslur nges gyur pa'i/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /sems can 'di dag thog ma med nas bdag /drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma ma drin can yin/ /de slad ma rgan de dag byang chub la/ /'god pa'i phyir du byang chub mchog sems bskyed/ /bka' dang bstan bcos ji snyed gsungs de yi/ /dgongs don yongs 'dzin bzang pos bstan don la/ /dben pa'i gnas su grogs med gcig pu ru/ /g.yeng ba spangs te rtse gcig gnas par bya/ /rjes kyi skabs su dge des mtshon pa yis/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i dge rtsa rnams/ /mkha' mnyam ma rgan rnams kyi don du ni/ /'khor gsum dag pa'i thabs shes gnyis ldan gyis/ /3

legs bshad bstan bstos phyogs bsgrigs/sgro skur mtshan ma'i tshogs rnams spangs byas nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sa der bsngo bar bya/ /gang du gnas na dug gsum la sogs pa'i/ /nyon mongs tshogs rnams yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel/ /dkar phyogs tho rangs rgyu skar ltar 'grib pa'i/ /gnas ngan myur du spong dang rgyal khams pa/ /sna tshogs 'dam skyes dpag med gcal du bkram/ /rkang drug ldan rnams dga' ba'i glu len zhing / /snyan pa'i dar dir sgrog par byed pa yi/ /dbeen gnas dam pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /tshig tsam shes kyang don la blo ma phyogs/ /sdom brtson rnams la sdang shugs mnar sems can/ /phyogs 'dzin rlung gis rnam par g.yengs gyur pa'i/ /bla ma'i gzugs brnyan spong dang rgyal khams pa/ /yin lugs khong du chud cing dbang po dul/ /mthong ba tsam gyis gzhan yid 'phrog par byed/ /

rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam/bsten pa tsam gyis dge 'phel skyon 'grib pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa sten dang rgyal khams pa/ / dmu rgod ma rungs dug sprul khros 'dra zhing / /'grogs pa tsam gyis rang gzhan 'phung bar byed/ /thar ba'i srog rtsa gcod par byed pa yi/ /grogs ngan myur du spong dang rgyal khams pa/ /gzhan la 'tshe bas dben pa'i ri dwags dang / /nyan shes 'khor du bde ba bskyed pa'i sgra/ /rgyun du sgrog pa 'dab bzang gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /de 'dra'i grogs dag sten dang rgyal khams pa/ /de ltar ji skad bstan bzhin byed gyur na/ /ngan song gnas rnams gang du'ang mi skye zhing / /gnas skabs mngon mtho mthar thug nges legs kyi/ /go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro rgyal khams pa/ /dri ba dang po'i lan rdzogs so/ /kwa ye da dung gson dang rgyal khams pa/ /5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal che chung ni/ /rnam pa gsum du 'gyur te chen po ni/ /dmyal ba rnams la yod de de yang ni/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal brgya phrag gnyis su 'gyur/ /yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod dang / /ngu 'bod chen po tsha ba rab tsha dang / /mnar med pa ste tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ /chu bur chu bur rdol dang kyi hud dang / /a chu so tham pa dang utpal ltar/ /gas dang padma ltar gas che gas te/ /de ltar grang ba'i dmyal ba rnam brgyad dang / /me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam dang ni/ /spu gris gtams sogs nye 'khor ba dag dang / /rgya mcho'i 'gram sogs nges med la gnas pa'i/ /nyi tshe ba dang rnam pa bco brgyad do/ /de dag rnams kyang snga ma snga ma las/ /

rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam/phyi ma phyi ma'i sdug bsngal bzod par dka'/ /mdor na tsha grang sdug bsngal bzod dka' yis/ /kun nas gzir cing thar ba'i mthu ma mchis/ /'bring ni yi dwags la yod de yang ni/ /phyi nang zas skom sgrib pas gsum du 'gyur/ /phyi yi sgrib pa can rnams rgya mtsho la'ang /rnag khrag sogs su mthong nas spyod skal med/ /nang gi sgrib pa can rnams zas skom sogs/ /mi rnyed gal te cung zad rnyed gyur kyang / /mgrin par mi tshud longs spyod mthu yang med/ /zas skom sgrib par gyur rnams zos pa dang / /'thungs pa rnams kyang me lce'i phreng ba ru/ /gyur nas rang nyid dag kyang tshig par byed/ /mdor na bkres skom sdug bsngal bzod glags med/ /dag gis gzir cing thar ba'i skabs ma mchis /chung ngu dud 'gro la yod de yang ni/ /7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bying dang kha 'thor sgo nas gnyis su 'gyur/ /de dag gcig la gcig za'i sdug bsngal dang / /glen cing gti mug la sogs sdug bsngal gyis/ /rtag tu gzir cing thar ba'i skabs ma mchis /de 'dra'i sdug bsngal spong thabs mi byed par/ /chags sdang gnyis kyis rang gzhan rgyud sreg cing / /mi dge sna tshogs sgrub pa'i bya ba 'di/ /da lta nyid nas dor dang rgyal khams pa/ /dri ba gnyis pa'i lan rdzogs so/ /da dung gson dang bshad do rgyal khams pa/ /de lta'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu dag ni/ /phyi nang chos la bdag dang bdag gir bzung / /bdag 'dzin las byung 'dod chags la sogs pa'i/ /dug gsum nyon mongs lte ba rab brtan cing / /na rga skye 'chi'i rtsibs rnam bzhi dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal gyi dang 'gyur dang khyab sogs kyi/ /8

rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam/sdug bsngal rnams kyi mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i/ /las ngan 'khor lor 'khor 'di byung ba yin/ /dri ba gsum pa'i lan rdzogs so/ /zhes de skad smras pa dang / kho yi rangs te/ 'di skad du/e ma deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar /dkon mchog skyabs 'gro byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su bla mas bstan pa yi/ /man ngag nyams blangs dge rtsa byang chub bsngo/ /kye ma'o ngan song gnas las 'jigs pa ang /kye ma'o nam 'chi'i nges pa mi snang na/ /kye ma'o gar skye shes pa mi snang na/ /kye ma'o mi skye'i rang dbang mi snang na/ /kyi hud bla na med pa'i bla ma dang / /kyi hud yid bzhin nor 'dra'i yi dam dang / /kyi hud bstan la gnod 'joms bstan skyong gis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i bdag 'dzin 'di/ /9

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gtan nas nye bar bcom nas gtan gyi skyabs/ /mthar thug chos sku thob nas mtha' bral gyi/ /gnas lugs 'gro la ston cing gnas gyur cig /ji ltar smras las nyes skyon chu 'dzin tshogs/ /mchis gang 'phags dang tshu rol mkhas rnams kyi/ /thugs rje'i mgyogs 'gros rab tu bsal byas te/ /bdag gi rnam dpyod tsha zer gsal bar mdzad/ /'di las thob pa'i rab dkar dge ba 'di/ /'di dang phyi ma kun tu mi zad gter/ /gter chen bum bzhin dpag yas yon tan dag /dag dang ma dag 'gro la stsol gyur cig /ces rang la bskul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'khor ba las skyo ba'i gtam zhes bya ba 'di mkhas pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa rgyal khams pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas gzhan la phrag dog dang 'gran sems kyis ma yin par rang nyid thar lam la bskul ba'i don du lto 'gro'i rgyu skar gyi dbang po mda'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes la mkhas pa du ma'i 'byung gnas yul dbus kyi sa'i cha chos grwa chen po bde ba can du sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so/ /10

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes bzhugs so/ /paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba/bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsum gyi/ /ye shes gtsang ma'i rang gzugs la/ /shākya seng ger mtshan gsol ba'i/ /ston pa mchog des bdag skyongs shig /mkhyen pa'i cha shas phra mos kyang / /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i shes bya'i khyon/ /rdul phran go sar 'god mkhas pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dge legs stsol/ /bdag la phan 'dod grogs rnams la/ /mngon par mtho dang nges legs kyi/ /11

wa(pegasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da walam bzang mtshon phyir dam pa'i gzhung / /ji bzhin 'bel ba'i gtam 'di gleng / /dran pa yis kyang gdung sel ba/ /khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma des/ /blo ldan khyim na gnas pas kyang / /don mchog bsgrub pa'i thabs 'di gsungs/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs kun gyi gzhi/ /bla ma mchog la rag las pas/ /yon tan bcu ldan dam pa de/ /legs brtags tshul bzhin bsten pa gces/ /nyams thag 'khor bar rgyu ba'i tshe/ /bslu med dkon mchog gsum po las /lhag pa'i skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas ni/ /nyin mtshan dus drug skyabs 'gro zhing / /de yi bslab bya'i rim pa dang / /12

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/dkar nag las 'bras legs bsams nas/ /phra zhing zhib pa'i blang dor 'tshal/ /sdig pa chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs chen dang / /phung grol chen po byed 'gyur te/ /khong bar song ba'i dug bzhin no/ /bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang / /'jig rten pha rol bde chen 'dren/ /don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te/ /'bru rnams phun tshogs smin pa bzhin/ /rgyal sras zhi ba lha yis kyang / /yid la bsams pa'i dge byas pas /gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni bsod nams des/ /'bras bu'i yon gyis mngon mchod 'gyur/ /sdig pa byang ba bde 'dod kyang / /13

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni sdig pa des/ /sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam 'joms gsungs/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i khyim pa la/ /phan par mdzad pas bslab gzhi lnga/ /gsungs phyir yongs rdzogs ma nus kyang / /sna gcig sna 'ga'i tshul gyis bsrung / /khyad par bzang po'i dus rnams la/ /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims/ /bzhes shig mtho ris 'gro ba yi/ /lam bzang zla dang bral ba lags/ /drang bo'i rang bzhin g.yo sgyu med/ /tshig btsun bden par smra ba dang / /'dod chung chog shes dul ba yi/ /mi la dpal mgon nye bar gnas/ /don chen bya ba ci bsgrub kyang / /14

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/gros dang 'jam po'i sgo nas bsgrub/ /grub na mchog yin ma grub kyang / /skyon du mi 'gyur mdzes pa yin/ /blo chung mgu sla khro ba skyen/ /gsar 'grogs che zhing phyi thag thung / /ngag ni cal col ra ma lug /de 'dra mkhas pas dug bzhin spang / /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /mang po'i nang du phyogs zhen dang / /gnyen po bsten phyir gang zag dang / /chos la smod pa 'byung nye yi/ /des na lha bcas ston pa des/ /nga'am nga 'dra'i gang zag gi /tshod bzung gzhan gyis bzung gyur na/ /nyams par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /thal bas g.yogs pa'i me dong la/ /15

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bag yod bsten la ji bzhin du/ /rtsed mo ga zha'i ched du yang / /brnyas smod nam yang bya ba min/ /gang gis byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ngan sems bskyed na de snyed kyi/ /skad cig grangs mtshungs bskal par ni/ /dmyal bar gnas zhes thub pas gsungs/ /de bzhin 'phags pa lha yis kyang / /'gro la phan phyir gang zhig la/ /'jig rten srid du gnas yod pa/ /de la sor gnas dag phud na/ /sdang la bsam thag ci yod gsungs/ /de bzhin rigs gzugs thos pa dang / /lang tsho dbang thang gis rgyags pas/ /sgo gsum brlang bor spyod pa de/ /dgra ltar kun tu gzigs par mdzod/ /16

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/rnam mang skye bo 'dus pa'i sar/ /dpa' rtsal ngom dang nyams dga'i phyir/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor dag /'byung bas blang dor tshul la brtag /rtswa chu tsam gyis 'tsho ba yi/ /bya dang ri dwags nya la sogs/ /mgon skyabs med pa 'di rnams ni/ /snying rjer 'os shing gzhan dag la'ang / /gnod 'tshe chom rkun byi bo byed/ / tshis/ rtsu ba phra ma lce gnyis dang / /ngo tsha khrel bor myos 'gyur la/ / bag med spyod las ldog pa'i rigs/ /khyod kyis 'bangs 'khor gzhan dag kyang / /snyoms par bu bzhin skyong byas na/ /de dag gis kyang khyod nyid la/ /pha bzhin snying nye bkur bar 'gyur/ /17

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nye ring skye bo mtha' dag la/ /tshig ngan mde'u rtse mi ston te/ /rnam smin phar zhog 'phral du yang / /de lan brag ca bzhin du 'byung / /mngag gzhug yin yang zhen ldan pa/ /rgan nam gzhon yang blo can la/ /dgyes par mdzad cing de dag gi /tshig kyang sbrang rtsi lta bur bzung / /brtse zhing gus pas gzhan dag gis/ /gsol la brnyas par mi bya ste/ /rta yan srab med lta bu la/ /phyin chad phan par smra ba dkon/ /bya ba ci dang ci byed kyang / /dang por legs par brtags te bya/ /ma brtags gya tsom byas pa las/ /'gyod cing nyes par gyur pa mang / /18

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/ rang skyon rang gis shes dka' bas/ /mang po mthun par bdag gi skyon/ /brjod na mkhas pas nges byas te/ /phyin chad khrag ngan bzhin du dbyung / /dgra gnyen nges pa ma mchis shing / /chags sdang can gyis ma khyab pa/ /phyi nang gang na'ang med min pas/ /sgo gsum drang bo'i lam du srongs/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal gyis/ /mang po'i nang du ngag la brtag /gcig pur 'dug tshe sems la brtag /gsungs pa ji bzhin nyams su longs/ /yon tan phan 'dogs sdug bsngal zhing / /'di dag phan gnod chung ngus kyang / /'bras mang 'grub pas gnag spongs la/ /dkar po'i sa bon rgyun du thob/ /19

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/grogs med srid par 'khyams pa na/ /sbyin dang mtshungs med gnyen mchog med/ /de'i phyir 'jungs pa'i sems bral bas/ /gtong la rtag tu dgyes pa skyed/ /grags pa nyams 'gyur drug spangs nas/ /dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu la/ /goms par byas pas lha dang mi'i/ /go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ba lags/ /'khon du 'dzin pas phung krol dag /bskyed pas sdang dang khro spangs te/ /bzod dang des pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /nad med gzugs bzang dam pa sgrubs/ /chos gsum 'di dag phal mo che /rgyal bas khyim pa rnams la bsngags/ /de'i phyir 'di 'dra'i tshul spyod pa'i/ /khyim gnas byang grol them skas lags/ /20

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/tshe 'di rmi lam glog dang mtshungs/ /'jig rten pha rol 'jigs pa che/ /des na phyi ma'i lam rgyags dang / /grogs dag 'bad pas bsgrub pa'i rigs/ /'dod yon ro la brkam pa dang / /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'brid mkhas pas/ /don chen yal bar 'chor bas na/ /dge tshogs bsgrub la bcad rgyar mdzod/ /snyigs dus skye bo'i tshe srog dang / /srid pa'i phun tshogs mtha' dag la/ /yid brtan cung zad ma mchis pas/ /rtag tu bag dang ldan par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi/ /rnam mang bstan bcos mtha' dag la/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs bkram byas na/ /legs bshad mang po de las 'byung / /21

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/legs bshad mang du mthong thos kyang / /blang dor tshul bzhin ma byas na/ /mig can g.yang la mchong dang mtshungs/ /des na nyams len snying por dril/ /gal te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang dam pa 'thob bzhed na/ /byams dang snying rje'i rtsa ba can/ /byang chub sems mchog bskyed kyang 'tshal/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /sgyu ma chu nang zla ba ltar/ /bden med rtogs pa'i lam goms pas/ /nyes brgya'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin/ /'di lta'i nyams len la gnas nas/ /lus ni zab gsal lha yi sku/ /ngag ni grag stong sngags kyi sgra/ /yid ni snang stong chos dbyings dang / /22

bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes/dran shes rgya las ma grol bar/ /spyod lam kun tu skyong byed cing / /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyis/ /yang dang yang du brgyan pa gces/ /'di 'dra'i spyod tshul la gnas pa/ /skyes pa'am bud med yin yang rung / /khyim gyi dpal la spyod bzhin du/ /mtho ris rnam grol dag 'tshal bgrod/ /snyigs ma'i gdon gyis yid myos pas/ /phan par smra dang de nyid kyi/ /rjes su 'jug pa ches dkon yang / /skal bzang rnam dpyod yangs pa yis/ /yun ring yang dang yang bskul bas/ /legs bshad rin chen 'phreng spel te/ /blo ldan mgul ba'i rgyan nyid du/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes byas bkod/ /23

/legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wad dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /mi bzad srid pa'i mtsho brgal te/ /sku gsum nor bu'i gling mchog tu/ /bde blag 'jug pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes zhes bya ba 'di yang / dang ba dang rnam dpyod dang gtong ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gyis mdzes pa skal bzang mgon po dbang rgyal gyis nan cher bskul ba la brten nas/ shākya'i dge slong blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po'i gtsug lag khang du thogs med du smras pa skye bo mtha' dag la phan pa rgya chen por gyur cig /24

zhal gdams mgur ma/zhal gdams mgur ma bzhugs so/ /shar skal ldan rgya mtshos mdzad/oṃ swa snyi/dpal be'u bkra shis g.yung drung mnga'/ /sku mthong ba tsam gyis dga' bde ster/ /rje thos pa dga' dang dbyer med pa'i/ /pha chos pa thugs rje can gyis skyongs/ /sngon rgya gar yul gyi paṇa grub gtso/ /dpal rgyal ba'i sraso po zhi ba lha/ /dus deng sang rgyal sras rin po che/ /mtshan dran pa'i mod la dad pa skyes/ /mgon skyabs gnas de nyid bka' drin las/ /gnas dben pa gang 'dod sten du byung / /dus da res sa pho sprel lo la/ /25

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sa bde la yangs pa'i ri khrod bsten/ /phu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag gnas/ /mda' dad dang ldan pa'i yon bdag mang / /mtha' gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /gnas ri thang mtshams nas nyams dga' ba/ /bya sna tshogs snyan pa'i glu len zhing / /chu bzang la rig pa dwangs pa'i mthar/ /ri spang shug brag gis brgyan pa na/ /nged ri ba mang po lhan cig tshogs/ /dus phal cher dge sbyor gang nus skyong / /skabs la lar 'di 'dra'i glu dbyangs 'then/ /pha bla ma'i bka' drin lhag par che/ /dus nyin bzhin gsol ba btab na legs/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub gang 'dod pa/ /lar 'bad brtson med par ngang giso 'byung / /rten dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba dang / /26

zhal gdams mgur ma/de yun ring mi sdod 'jig pa'i tshul/ /rang sems thog skor la yang yang soms/ /de gnad du song na chos 'go 'dzin/ /las rgyu 'bras phra zhib mi bslu bas/ /dge gang nus sgrub cing sdig pa spongs/ /mtho srid pa'i rtse nas mnar med bar/ /gnas 'khor ba 'di ru mi skye bar/ /gdong bzang po da lam e rnyed ltos/ /de rnyed na 'dun ma'i yang rtser phyin/ /khong sems can thams cad pha dang ma/ /drin bzang po'i lan du byams snying rje/ /gang sgom pa de la byang sems zer /chos byams dang snying rje byang chub sems/ /lam phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /dus rgyun du nyams len mthil byas na/ /mi de la sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /27

—legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dus rtag tu ma bu bzhin du skyong / /mgon ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /chos phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ /bcud stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /'di bka' phyag gnyis ka'i sgom khrid gtso/ /'di nyin re bzhin du sgom de la/ /lha yi dam tshogs kyis dngos grub ster/ /dpal chos skyong srung mas bar chad sel/ /'di rang dang gzhan la phan phyir du/ /dus de ring nyams dgar glu ru blangs/ /glu 'di 'dra len na ri la shog /dge 'dis kyang rang gzhan la phan shog /ces pa 'di yang skal ldan rgya mtshos rang lo drug cu re gnyis pa la bde yangs phu'i ri khrod bkra shis nyams dgar bris pa'o/ /28

lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad/lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad bzhugs so/ /lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan gyis mdzad/dge legs dpal ster bla ma dang / /bslu med skyabs mchog rin chen gsum/ /las kun sgrub pa'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /kun la dang bas phyag bgyis te/ /sngon bsags las smon gyis sbrel ba'i/ /dad gus skal ldan slob bu la/ /'di phyi kun tu phan pa yi/ /blang dor bslab bya mdor bsdus bri/ /btsan po'i khrims dang mi mthun pa'i/ /29

—/legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ snguspyod pa kim pa'i 'bras bzhin spang / /rang la ltos pa thams cad kyang / /tshul bzhin sgrub la sbyor ba gces/ /'grogs 'dris 'brel ba'i che phra la/ /legs nyes bya byed phra mo yis/ /dga' khro'i 'gyur ldog ring spang ste/ /gzhung bzang phyi thag bsring ba gces/ /gnyen dang nye du nang 'khor la/ /spyi snyoms byams brtse'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /skabs dang sbyar te bab 'brel dang / /mthun pa'i skyong bran bya ba gces/ /dbang byar spyod pa'i sde mang la/ /nye ring ris su mi gcod cing / /thams cad byams pas skyong ba dang / /legs nyes rnam dbye 'byed pa gces/ /dga' ba'i bzhin dang rnam 'gyur gyis/ /30

lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar byedapa'ibaslababyagacesapabatram̐bargyad/da ngo bstod gzhan skyon gleng ba yi/ /gcam bus kha gsag smra ba la/ /rtog dpyod zhib tu byed pa gces/ /blo ldan gya gyu'i sems med par/ /gnas tshul ji bzhin brjod pa yi/ /gtam gyi brjod byar legs brtags nas/ /snying po dang du len pa gces/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran/ /dma' la sdang ba'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung 'gyur bas/ /ngan spyod 'di dag spong ba gces/ /rgan la gus shing mnyam la mdza'/ /dman la byams par byed pa yi/ /kun dang mthun pa'i ya rabs kyi/ /spyod pa lhur len byed pa gces/ /glu gar rgyan po 'gyed pa sogs/ /31

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ha cang thal ba'i rtsed mo la/ /g.yeng ba don chen nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bag med spyod pa spong ba gces/ /khyad par myos byed 'thung ba ni/ /dran med 'gyur bas mi khyu nas/ /'bud cing ngan 'gror skyur byed pas/ /dug chu bzhin du spong ba gces/ /rta rtsal 'phong dang gtam smra sogs/ /dpa' bo'i yang rtsal yon tan la/ /sbyong ba pho rab lugs yin pas/ /de rnams brtson pas sbyong ba gces/ /mdor na bsam sbyor bzang po yis/ /'jig rten spyod pa tshul mthun la/ /bslab na mtho ris thar ba'i rgyur/ /'gyur bas tshul bzhin slob pa gces/ /'on kyang chos dang mjal dus 'dir/ /32

jilukṣiṃ krotram̐ngadoragasalabastsond+rayolpobabyagacesa.ayorsāwa/'ag na sprags la~X khyad patt+waṃdu//'aṭwāṃgs pa nyamasale na bya ༵sa pas//'a ltadī nyams su na pa gas//ṭwāṃ ma mapy-i kṣiṃsum dam pa ༵//nga nas saṭwāṃpungarnon 'cha'//sdo gsung thu~Xs byen bangapy-i pa dang // la phyag mad da pa gas//rab tu byung zlo thamasacad la//brnyas par snye bya dag snang dngado// kyigus pas banartso bkur phaṭwāṃ 'gas //byabasgrubalabakon papy-is//rgyun du blagro ma kān maṭwāṃ la/de/skyabasa' bdapaṭwāṃ'ila'abapy-i dang //gzungs sngags zab bzlas bad sogs//kha ton byed la brtson pa gces///lnga// //// ༷///bla ma rnal 'ar skyabs 'a dang //

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lam rim lta ba phyag chen gyi/ /dmigs rim rnams la bsam pa dang / /sgom pa lhur len byed pa gces/ /'di ltar bgyis na gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug don chen bde blag tu/ /'grub par dam pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /de phyir tshul 'dir 'bad pa gces/ /tshul 'dir 'bad la bla ma dang / /yi dam mchog gsum srung ma yis/ /byin rlabs dngos grub mchog stsol zhing / /gces par skyong ba'i bkra shis shog /ces lugs gnyis kyi blang dor gsal bar byed pa'i bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di ni rigs rus phun sum tshogs shing chos la dad 'dun dang brtson pa che ba'i dpon po har chin byams pa bkra shis kun gyis 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor 'jam dbyangs gong ma ba hwang ti'i lung gis kon ting phu'u shan bkang tshi tā kau shrī ming gzhan lcang skya hu thog 34
dbang blo bzang chos ldan dpal bzang pos

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslab bya mu thi la'i 'khri shing bzhugs so/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang / /byams dang 'jam dbyangs jo bo yab sras dang / /rgyal ba gnyis pa rgyal ba'i dbang po sogs/ /bla ma mchog gsum lha yis dus kun skyongs/ /dge legs rtsa ba mchog gsum ngo bo dang / /yon tan bstan gzhi bstan 'gro'i srog yin phyir/ /yongs rdzogs bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten pa dang / /bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bral med snying ltar skyongs/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' don che thob dus 'dir/ /khe chung nyen che chos brgyad mtho snyegs sogs/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma spangs te rang gzhan gyi/ /36

bslab bya mu thi la'i 'khri shing /dam chos snying po chig dril byed dus yin/ /mi dge'i 'bras bu ngan song 'jigs bsam la/ /dkon cog yon tan dran pa'i skyabs 'gro dang / /las 'bras bslu ba med tshul yang yang du/ /legs bsam 'di snang chags zhen gcod pa gces/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba log par ma gyur phyin/ /bya ba gang byas dge bar mi 'gro bas/ /mtho snyegs mi bya 'di la nan tan sgoms/ /rigs drug bzang ngan mtho dman gar gnas kyang / /btson khang bzang ngan mtho dman ji bzhin du/ /yang yang bsam la srid pa rgyu dang bcas/ /bzlog thabs bden bzhi'i lam la yang yang dril/ /'khor ba'i snang tshul sdug bsngal ma shes par/ /rnam dag nges 'byung skye ba mi srid pas/ /khams gsum gar skyes bshan pa'i bsha' lug bzhin/ /las nyon gnyis kyis yang yang 'chi tshul bsam/ /37

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshul de shes kyang 'ching byed kun 'byung gi /rtsa ba bdag 'dzin phra mo ma bcom par/ /thos bsam rlom pa dka' spyad tshul sogs kyis/ /mi grol de phyir zab lam bdag med btsal/ /nam zhig zab mo'i lta de rnyed pa'i tshe/ /thag khrar sbrul bzhin phung po bdag med par/ /rtogs pas da lta'i 'di bzhin chos brgyad kyis/ /mi 'khyer rtag tu ngu bzhin tshol bar rigs/ /bdag med rtogs kyang byang chub sems bral na/ /tshogs gnyis rgya chen yun ring spyad byas kyang / /zhi ba'i rgud las mi grol rang don gyi/ /gces 'dzin bcad nas gzhan don phan yon bsam/ /'gro rnams pha mar gyur dang sdug bsngal tshul/ /rmongs pas bsgribs dang skyon gyis mnar ba'i tshul/ /yang yang bsams nas snying rje'i rtsa ba tshugs/ /sems bskyed ces pa'i ming la ma 'khrul bar/ /38

bslab bya mu thi la'i 'khri shing /dge ba gang byas nges par gzhan don du/ /byed dam mi byed rang la legs ltos la/ /'gro mthong tsam gyis sems bskyed dran nus mdzod/ /de lta'i bdag med lta dang byang chub sems/ /med par lha bsgoms sngags bzlas tshul khrims sogs/ /bdag 'dzin bsgoms pa la 'gro mu stegs kyis/ /bdag 'dzin ngang nas lha bsgoms sngags sogs bzhin/ /mi grol lam 'di gnyis la nan tan skyed/ /sems de bskyed kyang phyin drug spyod pa la/ /bsgrub pa med na sems bzang tsam yin pas/ /phyin drug spyod dang gzhan don bsgrub pa'i ched/ /tshogs bsags smon lam sgo brgya 'byed par bya/ /snod rung thabs mchog 'jug sgo dbang la zhugs/ /dngos grub rtsa ba dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ /bsrung na rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlobs shing / /mkha' 'gros bka' bzhin sgrub phyir sngags lam myur/ /39

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nges par snyigs dus tshe gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ster byed rim gnyis go rim grangs nges la/ /chog spyir ma 'jog yid ngor 'phrod nges la/ /bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor a ho skal ba bzang / /lha sgom tsam min sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi/ /ngo 'phrod bsgoms pas rdzogs rim myur skye zhing / /nga rgyal bsgoms pas bgegs zlog lhas byin rlabs/ /gnad gnyis tshang ba'i sku gsum lam khyer sgoms/ /gnad bzhi ldan pa'i rtsa rlung thig le la/ /gnad bsnun las rlung bcad de stong bzhi'i mthar/ /lha skur 'grub pa'i snang phyogs stong phyogs kyi/ /ma bcos rdzogs rim mchog 'di rgyal bas bsngags/ /da ltar rdzogs rim zab mo ma thob kyang / /yid ngar skor dgu'i bsre ba legs sbyangs pas/ /'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pas skye 'chi'i 'gang / /sprul ba'i gar gyis bdud bzhi nges bcom ste/ /40

—sprakro3muthila'i'a'igo /skye ba gsum bzhi sogs la mngon 'tshang rgya/ /de bas rim gnyis lus dang sems bzhin chongs/ /de lta'i lam la sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /nyin mtshan so so'i kun spyod thun mtshams sogs/ /mdo dang rgyud sde rang rang gzhung bzhin du/ /tsha grang ltar min zung 'brel spyod pa gces/ /de ltar sdom pa gsum dang rim pa gnyis/ /gdan gcig steng nas nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje 'chang nas jo bo yab sras dang / /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i lugs la dad pa dang / /thub bstan yongs su rdzogs par 'dzin 'dod cing / /blo gros chen po can rnams dpyod par 'tshal/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar bya ba des/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa'i mun tshogs kun bsal te/ /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam sad 'od/ /lus can kun gyis thob par gyur cig gu/41

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zhes theg chen rim gnyis dang bcas pa'i bslab bya mu thi la'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba 'di ni rang gi slob ma gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba tshe blos btang gi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa lhun grub rgya mtshos zhing khams kun khyab kyi dhu be dang bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba 'dis kyang skye dgu kun la phan thogs par gyur cig /

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyis mdzad/na mo shākya mu na ye/'dir ni mdo sde zab mo las/ /gsungs pa'i don 'ga' mdor bsdus nas/ /rang gzhan dag la phan pa'i ched/ /'god par bya ste de yang ni/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas 'byung ba'i/ /blo gros bzang mos zhus pa las/ /khong khro spong dang byams la gnas/ /chos 'dod sangs rgyas gzugs byed na/ /rtag tu gzugs mdzes 'thob par bshad/ /dus su sbyin gtong 'gyod med sbyin/ /yid 'ong sbyin dang rnam smin la/ /43

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/re ba med par sbyin byed na/ /rtag tu longs spyod chen por 'gyur/ /phra ma spong dang log lta spong / /dam chos srung dang sems can gzhan/ /byang chub yang dag 'dzin 'jug na/ /mi phyed 'khor dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bde gshegs me tog tshogs kyis mchod/ /gnod sems spong zhing sku gzugs byed/ /rdzogs sangs mos pa rgya che na/ /sangs rgyas zhing du rdzus skye 'gyur/ /gzhan gyis dge ba sgrub pa dang / /chos nyan pa la bar mi gcod/ /mchod rten mar me 'bul ba dang / /rjes dran ting 'dzin sgom byed na/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /g.yo med dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten/ /44

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/gzhan gyi rnyed la ser sna med/ /byang chub spyod la dga' byed na/ /rtag tu dgra ni med par 'gyur/ /ji skad smras bzhin byed pa dang / /mdza' bo'i rang bzhin mi 'chab cing / /klan ka med par chos nyan dang / /chos smrar dpyas skur mi byed na/ /rtag tu ngag tshig btsun par 'gyur/ /sdom pa rnam gsum yang dag len/ /mdo sde zab mor rtag tu mos/ /sems can rnams la byams sems ldan/ /byang chub sems dpar sangs rgyas ltar/ /mos na las sgrib byang bar 'gyur/ /chos kun bden stong mnyam nyid lta/ /dge la rab brtson sangs rgyas dran/ /sdig bshags dge ba sangs rgyas sar/ /45

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bsngos na bdud las kyis mi tshugs/ /gzhan gyi bsam pa rab rdzogs byed/ /skyabs la mos pa shugs drag dang / /rgya chen sbyin pa la 'jug cing / /dkon mchog mchod la brtson byed na/ /'chi tshe sangs rgyas mngon mthong bshad/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab mdor/ /stong ba nyid la mos pa dang / /byang chub sems ni mi gtong zhing / /dam pa'i chos ni 'dzin bgyid na/ /bsod nams thams cad sdud par ba/sungs/ /gzhan yang mdo sde thar chen las/ /snying rje chen po bskyed pa dang / /le lo med cing brtson 'grus bskyed/ /skye shi 'khor ba mi 'drar shes/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bsam byed na/ /46

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/sems la gdung ba med par 'gyur/ /chos kun bdag med ces brjod dang / /skye gnas cog la dga' med brjod/ /theg chen bsngags pa brjod byed cing / /dge sdug 'bras bu mi brlag ces/ /brjod na nges tshig 'gyod mi 'gyur/ /tshul khrims srung dang mang du thos/ /sbyin gtong rab tu 'byung byed na/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /khe stor mi snyan grags pa dang / / smad cing dma' dbab sdug bsngal kyang / /mi g.yo legs pa'i phyir 'jug na/ /chos kyi tshul las g.yo mi 'gyur/ /gzhan la las 'bras yid ches ston/ /sbyin pa la ni lan mi re/ /dam pa'i chos ni srung ba dang / /47

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byang chub sems dpar bstod byed na/ /dkar chos thams cad yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ /dge ba yun du sgrub byed dang / / nyes pa byung rnams sel bar byed/ /thabs mkhas brtson 'grus dge ba kun/ /byang chub chen por bsngo byed na/ /sa bcu'i bar du bgrod par 'gyur/ /sems can yid dang mthun 'jug dang / /dge la yi rang sems bskyed cing / /sdig bshags chos 'khor bskor bskul na/ /thabs la mkhas pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi phan bde sgrub byed cing / /rang gi dga' ba yongs 'dor dang / /bzod bsgom le lo spong byed na/ /sems can kun gyi ston par 'gyur/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rjes dran dang / /48

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/dge kun rdzogs byang phyir bsngo dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dang / /theg chen bsngags pa sgrog byed na/ /sems bskyed chud mi za bar 'gyur/ /nyan rang yid byed blo 'dor dang / /dam chos sgrub pas mi skyo dang / /thos pa'i chos kun ston byed na/ /spyod pa gcig tu yongs dag 'gyur/ /theg chen chos la rin chen dang / /sman dang dbyig dang 'drar blta dang / /sdug bsngal zhi bar lta byed na/ /rin chen chos rnams bsgrub par 'gyur/ /'dus byas chos kun rang bzhin gyis/ /'ongs med 'gog med mi gnas dang / /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung shes na/ /nyes pa'i las kun byang bar 'gyur/ /49

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dran pa nyer bzhag dbang bo bsdams/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba stobs bskyed dang / /dben par 'du 'dzi spong byed na/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur/ /gzhan las mtho snyam mi sems dang / /rtag tu bkur bsti gus sems ldan/ /gzhan phan sgrub cing bdag mi bstod/ /rnyed dang bkur bsnyi grags pa kun/ /'tshol med gzhan la chos ston na/ /tshogs mang kun dang mthun par 'gyur/ /dam chos srung zhing ston pa dang / /rtag tu ya rabs chos la spyod/ /kun la rnam par rtog med na/ /chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo 'byed 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi skyon la mi rtog dang / /zhe sdang can la byams pa sgom/ /50

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/chos kun rten 'brel du ston dang / /bla med byang chub rtag dran na/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba zad mi 'gyur/ /rtag tu chos kyi sbyin byed dang / /gzhan gyi skyon rnams brjod mi byed/ /chos kyis bsdus te ston mkhas dang / /zab mo'i chos rnams shes gyur na/ /pha rol phyin rnams rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhi dul mnyen des sems dang ldan/ /dge rtsa mthu ldan byed pa dang / /sems can thams cad yongs mi gtong / /thabs shes stobs ldan sgom byed na/ /bsam bzhin 'dod par skye bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu sems can don mi skyo/ /sangs rgyas tshad med mchod pa dang / /byams sems tshad med sgom par byed/ /51

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sangs rgyas ye shes la mos na/ /byang chub phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ /sems can don phyir smon lam 'debs/ /sbyin pa'i spyod lam la dad ldan/ /brtson 'grus che la 'dun pa dang / /rgyal ba'i chos la mos spyod na/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin mi chad bshad/ /dri med byin gyis zhus pa las/ /phrag dog mi bya phra ma spong / /skye bo mang po dge la sbyor/ /byams pa rgya chen sgom byed na/ /bdud rnams 'dul bar byed nus 'gyur/ /ji skad smras bzhin byed pa dang / /zab mo'i chos la mos byed cing / /yid dam shin tu brtan pa dang / /gzhan dag byang chub 'dzin 'jug na/ /52

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/zhing rnams g.yo bar byed nus 'gyur/ /mar me sbyin dang dam chos 'dzin/ /bag med rnams la'ang chos ston dang / /mchod rten rin chen dra phul na/ /'od zer ldan pa'i lus 'thob 'gyur/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang bu mo sbyin/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas bsngags pa brjod/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sgom na/ /gzungs ni rab tu 'thob par 'gyur/ /'khor ba la ni yid 'byung dang / /rang nyid gcig pur gnas la dga'/ /dge la brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / /bya ba mtha' ru phyin byed na/ /ting 'dzin yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang lus yang bar yid byed dang / /sems kyang yang bar yid la byed/ /53

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos rnams kun la mngon zhen bral/ /khams bzhi mkha' dang mnyam shes na/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /khong khro med cing rtsod pa med/ /bde gshegs rten la byi dor byed/ /tshul khrims la gnas legs 'ongs smra/ /chos smrar khro ba med gyur na/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /badmar bder gshegs gzugs byas mchod/ /gzhan skyon mi 'dzin dga' bar byed/ /dge rtsa sangs rgyas sar bsngo na/ /sangs rgyas drung du skye bar 'gyur/ /slong la mi brnyas sbyin byin dang / /ser sna med par dngos po gtong / /rgyal mos lta ngan kun spong na/ /rtag tu longs spyod 'thob par 'gyur/ /54

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/chos la ser sna med sbyin dang / /mi mthun med cing 'gyod pa sel/ /yang dag gdams ngag ji bzhin ston/ /stong nyid zab mo sgom byed na/ /shes rab chen po 'thob par 'gyur/ /lung nod kha ton gdams ngag 'doms/ /gzhan la yid 'ong ngag tshig smra/ /thar 'dod gzhan la chos ston dang / /dge bsngo ting 'dzin la mkhas na/ /rtag tu tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ /dam chos srog phyir mi spong zhing / /sdig pa'i grogs la mi bsten dang / /chos smra ba la skur mi 'debs/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran sgom na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'phrad par 'gyur/ /mchod rten la ni rin chen gtor/ /55

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —dri zhim bdud rtsis mchod rten 'khru/ /spos dang me tog rnams kyis mchod/ /mkhan slob gus pas bsten byed na/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'thob 'gyur/ /chos la khri stan sna tshogs 'bul/ /bsnyi stangs byed pas mi skyo dang / /chos smra ba la rgol mi byed/ /sems can byang chub la 'jug na/ /dpe byad brgyad cu 'thob par 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod 'dzin/ /nyin mtshan phung po gsum pa 'don/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog la mos/ /lus srog mi lta chos sgrub na/ /spobs pa rnam dag 'thob par 'gyur/ /phrag dog med cing ser sna med/ /kun la phan pa'i sems snyom dang / /56

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mardor bsdus/ 'khor dang chos min mi 'dre na/ /sangs rgyas zhing dag 'thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi 'khor ni 'byed mi byed/ /mi mthun pa dag sdum byed cing / /lung nod kha ton byed 'jug dang / /phra ma'i tshig rnams spong byed na/ /dge 'dun phun tshogs ldan par 'gyur/ /gzhan mchod byed la phrag dog med/ /pha rol phyin rnams gus pas 'tshol/ /tshul 'chos med cing byang sems la/ /ston pa lta bur gus byed na/ /gang 'dod zhing du skye 'gyur bshad/ /klu rgyal rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bsngags brjod cing / /chos 'dod g.yeng bar mi byed dang / /gzhan gyi 'gyod pa sel byed na/ /57

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi khom gnas las grol bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems ni mi gtong dang / /tshul khrims srung zhing nyams mi byed/ /smon lam rnam dag 'debs pa dang / /gzhan phyir snying rje cher bskyed na/ /lha mi'i skye ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran bsnyen bkur mchod/ /bsngags brjod sku bzhengs lta bar 'dod/ /sangs rgyas zhing du skye bar smon/ /sangs rgyas ye shes chos mos na/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas mthong bar 'gyur/ /dge ba'i bshes la bsnyen bkur zhing / /chos la gces spras nga rgyal med/ /bka' blo bde zhing mos byed na/ /skye kun bshes gnyen 'phrad par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i yum dang sdud pa las/ /58

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/stong nyid zab mo sgom pa dang / /sems can yongs su mi gtong zhing / /ji skad smras bzhin byed pa dang / /sangs rgyas byin gyis brlabs gyur na/ /bdud rnams kun gyis tshugs mi 'gyur/ /sbyin pa yis ni longs spyod ldan/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gro thob/ /bzod pa'i stobs kyis gzugs mdzes dang / /brtson 'grus yon tan gong du 'phel/ /bsam gtan mngon shes la sogs 'grub/ /shes rab kyis ni grol bar bshad/ /gzhan yang mdo sde du ma las/ /nges 'byung sems bskyed yang dag lta/ /lam gyi gtso bo rnam gsum dang / /skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum gyi/ /thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam/ /59

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rnam gsum bshad cing de yang ni/ /'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi/ /mngon mtho tsam zhig don gnyer lam/ /skyes bu chung ngu'i lam dngos dang / /thar ba tsam zhig don gnyer lam/ /skyes bu 'bring gi lam dngos dang / /sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba'i lam/ /skyes bu chen po'i lam dngos dang / /thams cad mkhyen pa don gnyer ba/ /gzhir byas mngon mtho nges legs dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub don gnyer gsum/ /skyes bu gsum dang thun mong pa'i/ /lam du bshad de khyad par dbye/ /thog mar 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal las/ /thar 'dod nges 'byung gal che ste/ /de med legs spyod 'khor pa dang / /60

mdo nas dngos su gsungs pa'i bslab bya mdor bsdus/des zin thar pa'i rgyur 'gyur bshad/ /rdzogs byang bsngos pa'i dge rtsa ni/ /chung yang zad pa med do zhes/ /gsungs phyir dge ba ci bsags pa/ /bsam pa thag pas rdzogs byang bsngo/ /de sogs mdo las gsungs pa'i tshul/ /mtha' yas dpag med mchis na yang / /'dir ni rang nyid dad pa yis/ /kun nas bslangs te cha tsam bris/ /ci phyir zhe na mdorkelas ni/ /gaṅgā'i bye snyed sangs rgyas zhing / /rin chen bkang ste rgyal mchod pas/ /gang gis rgyal ba'i gsung ltar du/ /dam chos tshigs bcad gcig byin yang / /bsod nams che bar gsungs phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di yang bshad sgrub ming can gyis dad pas sbyar pa'o/ /61

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa bzhugs so//rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtshos mdzad/ne'u gsing spang la skyes pa'i/ /spang rgyan me tog bkra yang / /dgun gyi kha rlung 'tshub dus/ /rdul phran tsam du 'thor bas/ /da lta mdangs bkrag mtshar dus/ /dkon mchog drung du phul dang / /sngon bsags sbyin pa'i 'bras bu/ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod 'byor yang / /nam zhig gang zag gzhan gyis/ /62

rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa/bdag bzung rdzas su 'gyur bas/ /da lta rang dbang yod dus/ /sbyin pa'i zhing la phul cig /rtsal gsum dar la rdzogs pa'i/ /g.yu 'brug skad gseng mtho yang / /dbyar gsum nam zla'i tha mar/ /sgra skad nyams par 'gyur bas/ /da lta mkha' la 'phyo dus/ /dbyar rnga dal bur sgrogs dang / /mthun 'jug 'jig rten las la/ /gsung snyan 'gyur khugs 'khrol yang / /nam zhig mgrin pa'i lam la/ /dbugs kyang chad par 'gyur bas/ /da lta smra lce bde dus/ /grag stong zlo bar 'bungs shig /mkha' la rgyan du chags pa'i/ /63

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sprin dkar lang tsho gsar yang / /drag pa'i rlung dang phrad nas/ /phyogs bcur 'thor bar nges so/ /da lta lang long 'khrigs dus/ /sbrang char bcud du phobs dang / /khu khrag gzhan gyi rdzas bzhin/ /bdag bzung lus 'di mchor yang / /nam zhig mi gtsang rdzas bzhin/ /'brel med 'dor bar 'gyur bas/ /da lta rtsal stobs ldan dus/ /dge ba'i bran du khol cig /dwangs bsil yid la 'thad pa'i/ /nyal 'gro lhung lhung 'bab kyang / /mi ring thigs pa tsam yang / /lus med skem par 'gyur gyi/ /da lta rgyun bzang 'bab dus/ /64

rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa/rtsi thog gsos su drongs dang / /rang bde gzhan la gnod pa'i/ /thabs tshul sna dgu 'gyu yang / /nam zhig ming don tsam yang / /'char med rmongs par 'gyur gyi/ /da lta blo rig gsal dus/ /zab rgyas gdams ngag sgoms shig /tshong 'dus sa yi lte bar/ /lho byang tshong phrug 'dzom yang / /zhag gsum nang bar dus su/ /so sor gyes par 'gyur bas/ /da lta yud tsam tshogs dus/ /'khon dang mthun 'grogs spongs dang / /tshe sngon las kyis bkug pa'i/ /dgra gnyen byams sdang che yang / /mi ring rigs drug gnas su/ /65

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/so sor 'gro bar 'gyur bas/ /da lta ris su bcad nas/ /dgos med chags sdang spongs shig /ston dus mkha' la shar ba'i/ /nya rgyas nam 'phang mtho yang /'dzam gling sa 'dir gnas pa'i/ /skye bo tsha gdung can la/ /lus sems dga' bde skyed pa'i/ /shugs 'byung 'od dkar 'gyed do/ /gzhan la phan bde 'dod pa/ /rang sems khong na gnas kyang / /phyogs dus skye bo kun gyi/ /don gnyis dpal du 'gyur bas/ /lus ngag tshul 'chos spangs te/ /lhag bsam bzang po skyed cig /glu dbang gtsug gi nor bu/ /66

rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa/phyogs lhung rtog pa med kyang / /mchod dang bkur snyi chen pos/ /rtse gcig gsol ba thobs la/ /gang bsam re ba'i 'bras bu/ /lag rtser stsol bar nges so/ /bla ma sku gsum dbang phyug /'gro la nye ring spangs kyang / /mos gus ltem rkyang med pas/ /rtse gcig dran pa de la/ /'di dang phyi ma kun gyi/ /legs tshogs 'grub par nges so/ /dbang po bslad pa'i mthu yis/ /mkha' la snang bkrag mtshar yang / /gso dpyad mig sman rnon pos/ /sbyangs pa'i de ma thag tu/ / rab rib snang ba log pa'i/ /67

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/stong gsal rjen par 'char ro/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis dkrugs pas/ /kun rdzob ci yang 'char mod/ /'khrul ba'i rang mtshang gcod pa'i/ /rigs shes lta ba'i ngo na/ /blo brid snang ba log pa'i/ /gnas lugs ltad mo ltos shig /stong gsal mkha' yi ngos na/ /tshugs thub bden par med kyang / /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mang po/ /tshogs pa'i 'ja' tshon ri mo/ /gtad med ci yang 'char ba'i/ /ngo mtshar 'di la ltos dang / /dpyad na 'di zhes bya ba'i/ /ngos bzung ci yang med kyang / /rgyu rkyen cha shas mang por /68

rang gzhan dam pa'i chos la rgyud bskul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa/btags yod ming tsam 'di la/ /bya byed thams cad 'thad pa'i/ /sgyu ma 'di la gzigs dang / /bden dngos bslu ba med pa'i/ /dmigs gtad gang yang med kyang / /khog yangs brag gi phug par/ /sgra brnyan brag ca'i dbyangs kyis/ /rang 'dzin shes pa bskyed pa'i/ /nus pa thogs med bzhin du/ /slu med don la grub pa'i/ /snying po cha tsam med kyang / /don ldan tshig gi phreng ba/ /'di ltar spel ba'i gtam gyis/ /kun rdzob 'gro ba mang por /phan pa rgya chen gyur cig /69

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po bzhugs so/ /lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes mdzad/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/dge legs dpal du sdug pa'i rin chen sems kyi nor bus ci yang sa/tams/ /ma smad yid 'ong spyod pa'i rlabs phreng 'dzum pa'i tshogs gnyis chu gter las/ /nyer 'ongs kun rtog sprin bral kun bzang lhun grub 'phrin las snang 'bum 'gyed/ /'gro ba'i lam bzang mtshon pa'i mig gcig thub dbang smra ba'i nyi mar 'dud/ /rmongs pa'i dug chus myos pa'i yid kyi glang smyon khyu/ /mi bzad gol ba'i lam du yang yang 'phyan pa las/ /70

bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po/chos bzhin spyod pa'i dam pa'i lam du 'dren byed pa'i/ /thabs kyi mchog gyur kyo ba rnon po 'dir bshad bya/ /thog med srid par lan brgyar 'phyan pa las/ /stes kyis thob pa'i dal 'byor yid bzhin nor/ /chos bzhin bsgrubs pas don ldan byed pa la/ /snying nas dga' rnams dam pas rangs pa'i gnas/ /lto ba 'gengs dang gnas mal bde ba tsam/ /snying por rlom nas ngal brgyas bsgrub pa dag /rten bzang thob kyang blang dor la rmongs pa'i/ /phyugs kyi ngang tshul nyid la gzhol bar zad/ /de phyir bdag nyid legs su 'dod pa rnams/ /nges pa kho nar gtan du bde ba'i thabs/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos tshul zab mo la /'jug pa'i gtan gyi 'dun ma ma nor gces/ /'di na 'phral gyi 'tsho ba'i thabs tsam yang /gang la re ba'i yul la brtag dgos na/ /71

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gtan bde'i lam du 'khrid pa'i skyabs 'cha' ba'i/ /bshes gnyen bzang po brtags pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /gang la bshes su bzung ba de nyid la/ /lus dang longs spyod sgrub pa'i mchod pa yis/ /mnyes pa kho na byed la 'bad pa ni/ /bde legs rtsa bar mdo rgyud kun las bsngags/ /blang dang 'dor ba tshul bzhin bsgrub pa la/ /ji ltar bsgrub tshul ji bzhin shes dgos shing / /de la de ston rnam gzhag thos dgos pas/ /rgya chen gzhung la thos pa 'tshol ba gces/ /rigs dang mi rigs rnam par 'byed pa la/ /yang dag rigs tshul ji bzhin shes dgos pas/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyi rigs lam ston pa'i gzhung / /kun la phyogs rer ma song sbyangs pa gces/ /rigs tshul phyogs re tsam gyis tshim pa dang / /g.yo thabs zol sbyor pha rol 'bebs pa yi /72

bslab sta gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po/sbyor ba kho na slob dang mnyan pa ni/ /phung byed 'chad dang mnyan pa'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /gang la slob pa'i gzhung lugs de nyid kyi/ /mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa'i lam /bskyed dang goms dang grub pa'i 'bras bu'i tshul/ /ston tshul tshig spyi tsam du ma lus par/ /don gyi gnad 'gag so sor phyed pa yis/ /bsam dang bsgom pas lag tu len pa na/ /nam yang gol sar 'chor du med pa yi/ /thabs tshul ston dang mnyan pa dam pa'i tshul/ /snga phyi legs par 'brel ba'i mtshams sbyor dang / /gzhung gi go ba bskyed pa'i bsdus pa'i don/ /log bshad gol sa spangs pa'i brgal lan dang / /don 'bras ji ltar bsgrub pa dgos pa'i don/ /yan lag rgyas par bshad pa tshig gi don/ /'di lnga gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i thabs mchog ste/ /73

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgya gar kha spu can gyi lugs srol yin/ /nges par gzhung don shes la med mi rung / /gnad don bor ba'i sla bar rgyas bshad byed/ /gzhung tshig khol byung tsam la yang yang bzlos/ /tshig gi na yams tsam gyi 'brel ba dang / /'chad dang rtsod pa'i tshul la bdag ma rangs/ /de phyir gzhung tshig nus pa 'don lugs dang / /de yis lam la nges pa bskyed pa'i tshul/ /gsal la 'dril ba'i go ba ster lugs la/ /snying por bzung ba'i thos pa gnad du 'gro/ /sngon dus chos bzhin spyod pa'i dam pa yis/ /lus srog thed la bor ba'i dka' spyad kyis/ /btsal ba'i mdo sngags gzhung dang gdams pa'i tshoṭa/ /phal cher nub cing 'ga' zhig nub la nye/ /'di lta'i ngang tshul mngon du gyur na yang / /rgyun ja re tsam chad pa'i rtsis med par/ /74

bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po/chos kyis lto rgyab 'byid pa lhur len pa/ /thub bstan 'dzin pa mkhas pa'i bzhad gad yin/ /de'i phyir thos pa 'tshol ba'i kun slong dang / /thos pa'i bsam sbyor ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ /ma nor tshul bzhin nyams su legs bstar na/ /thos pa'i phan yon mtha' dag 'byung bar nges /gang zhig thub pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel las/ /tshig gcig tsam yang lhag mar ma lus par/ /kun kyang dang po'i las can gang zag gcig /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par 'khrid byed pa'i/ /lam gyi gtso bo yan lag ci rigs par/ /dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas 'du ba la/ /blo kha nang du phyogs te rigs pa yis/ /yang yang bsams te nges shes rnyed pa gnad/ /rin chen gling du chas pa'i skyes bu'i tshogs/ /ngal ba sel phyir ded dpon mkhas pa yis/ /75

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lam du grong khyer yid 'ong sprul ba ltar/ /chung 'bring theg pa gsungs par rgyal bas bshad/ /gzhan don byed la dpa' ba'i sems dpa' yis/ /rigs can gsum gyi sman pa sgrub pa'i phyir/ /mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa mtha' dag la/ /thos bsam sgom pas nges par slob dgos la/ /rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi/ /dgongs don snying por mi pham mgon pos bshad/ /de'i phyir theg pa gsum gyi gsung rab kun/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du/ /de yang mdo dang de yi dgongs 'grel rnams/ /thad ka thad ka'i lam gyi nyams len du/ /blangs nas rang gi rgyud la sbyor shes na/ /mkhas pa mgu ba'i nyams su len tshul yin/ /gzhan du 'dzam gling rgyan gyi gzhung lugs la/ /mi tshe hril gyis thos pa bsags gyur kyang / /76

bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po/nyams su len tshe grog po phugs rdug tu/ /phyin ltar ma sbyangs gnas su phyir ldog pa'i/ /ngang tshul de yis blo gros ldan pa rnams/ /rangs pa 'thob pa'i gnas skabs ga la mchis/ /de yang thog mtha' bar gyi kun slong rnams/ /phyir lta kho nar song bas lan pa lags/ /sngon byon tshad ldan mkhas grub phal mo ches/ /gsung rab lta zhog bya sgrung tshun chad kyang / /nyams len grogs su shar ba'i rnam thar gyis/ /go 'phang mthon po brnyes la gzhigs par mdzod/ /de ltar thos bsam gnad du legs song na/ /de nyid bsgom dang nyams len gtso bo yin/ /thos bsam sgom gsum cig car 'byung bas na/ /tshegs med lam gyi rtogs pa rnyed par 'gyur/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i skyes bu phal mo ches/ /mtshams dang 'dag sbyar gcig dril ma mdzad kyang / /77

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad pa mdzad bzhin par/ /sa lam rtogs pa phul byung brnyes la stos/ /thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi tshul/ /dri med rigs pas legs par nges pa rnams/ /ji ltar rigs par dpyad dang 'jog pa yis/ /yang yang goms par byed la sgom zhes zer/ /bstan pa'i gnad la nges pa ma rnyed par/ /ri sul stong bar dka' thub spyod pa yis/ /mi tshe bskyal kyang 'khor pa'i rtsa ba la/ /gnod pa rdul tsam 'byung ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /nges 'byung lta dang byang chub sems bral na/ /bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang ni bskyod dka' ba'i/ /ting 'dzin brtan po ji tsam yod gyur kyang / /lhag spyod ting 'dzin las ni 'phags mi nus/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar ba yi/ /khas blangs tshul khrims dag pa gzhir bzung nas/ /78

bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po/ting 'dzin shes rab nyams su blang gyur na/ /lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum gyi ming 'thob lags/ /de dag gzhung lugs chen po mtha' dag la/ /ris su ma chad nyams len byed nus pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo blo gros ldan rnams kyis/ /thos bsam sgom pa byed tshul mdo tsam ste/ /da dung zhib tu rgyas par shes 'dod na/ /blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras kyi/ /dri med gsung rab spyi dang khyad par du/ /lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag rnams la ltos/ /de ltar nyams len gnad du 'gro ba la/ /skyes thob shes rab che ba'i rlom sems dang / /dka' spyad khur du bzod pa'i sdug bsran dang / /thos bsam ngal ba mang ba'i sdug yus tsam/ /kho nas sa chod ci yang mi 'byung bas/ /ma nor lam ston bshes la bsten pa dang / /79

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos mthun grogs bsten gzhung mang blta rtog byed/ /phyag skor maṇḍal gzungs sngags bzlas brjod sogs/ /lam gyi mthun rkyen bsod nams tshogs gsog dang / /'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyong ba'i sgo du mar/ /snying nas 'bad pas brtson pa shin tu gces/ /khyad par lha dang bla ma dbyer med la/ /mos gus shugs drag blo sems gcig dril gyis/ /tshig tsam min par gsol ba legs btab na/ /ci byas lam du 'gro ba gdon mi za/ /gal te rang gi blo nus stobs chung zhing / /snyigs dus tshe ni phal cher yun thung bas/ /rnam mang gzhung la thos dang bsam pa yis/ /bdar sha gcod pa'i spros pas 'jigs gyur na/ /tshang la ma nor gdams pa'i snying po mchog /thun mong thun mong min pa'i lam rim rnams/ /gsal la 'dril bar nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /80

bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po/blo bzang rgyal ba'i snyan brgyud zab mo rnams/ /tshul bzhin ston pa'i mtshan ldan bshes gnyen las/ /ma nor legs mnos dbeen pa'i ri sul du/ /chos brgyad spros pa btsan thabs bcad nas su/ /sgrub pa lhur len byed pa snying gtam yin/ /bgrang yas bskal par gang gi mtshan tsam yang / /thos par dka' ba'i rdo rje'i theg pa la/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i sbyor ba ci nus kyis/ /bag chags 'thug po 'jog pa gnad du che/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen la/ /tshul bzhin slob pa'i rim pa 'di bshad pas/ /bdag gzhan ma lus skye ba thams cad du/ /rnam dag lam dang 'bral ba med gyur cig /ces rgyal ba'i bstan pa ji ltar slob pa'i rim pa mdo tsam brjod pa gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni skyes pas thob pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal dang ldan zhing rgyal ba'i gsung rab la snying nas 'jug par 'dod pa'i 81
〉 na u rad zhabs drung daskuchos smra ba lcang skya rol ba

bslab bya mu tig phreng ba/ bslab bya mu tig phreng ba bzhugs so/ /thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mjod/dge legs tshogs gnyis rin chen las grub pa'i/ /sku gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang la/ /dbang bsgyur 'gro la brtse ba'i spyan stong can/ /chos kyi rgyal po bla mar phyag bgyis nas/ /sngon bsags las smon dge ba'i mthu btsan pas/ /stobs kyi 'khor bsgyur rigs las blo gros kyi/ /snang ba nyi ma'i 'od ltar ches gsal ba/ /lha yi btsun pa khyod la 'di skad smra/ / dal ba thob dang bstan la mjal ba dang / /dge ba'i bshes dang 'phrad pa ches dka' na/ /'di dag thams cad 'dzom pa'i lus rten 'di/ /don med stong zad byed pa shin tu phangs/ /83

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kun gyi srog la dbang bsgyur 'chi bdag bdud/ /nges par 'ong la nam 'ong cha med cing / /glo bur slebs tshe phan nges chos las gzhan/ /med phyir dam pa'i chos la 'bad par rigs/ /yang srid phyi mar gar skye rang dbang med/ /bde sdug gang myong da lta'i las la rag /bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod na/ /dkar nag las la blang dor bya bar rigs/ /'jig rten 'di na mi bslu gcig kyang med/ /nam yang bslu med dkon mchog kho nar nges/ /de bas de la snying nas skyabs song na/ /'khor ba ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyabs par nges/ /ji ltar sa la brten nas lo tog bzhin/ /tshul khrims rtsa ba snying rje'i chus brlan par/ /brten nas dkar po'i chos kun skye gsung phyir/ /khas blangs tshul khrims srog las gces par bsrung / /84

bslab bya mu tig phreng ba/ji ltar 'og gzhi med par khang pa yi/ /thog dang yang thog 'gebs 'dod bzhad gad gnas/ /de bzhin chos kyi gzhi ma tshul khrims dang / /bral ba'i zab mo'i chos kyis phan pa dka'/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs char gyis ma brlan na/ /rang rgyud tha ba skam por dge sems kyi/ /myu gu tsam yang skye bar mi 'gyur na/ /byang chub 'bras bu smin par ji ltar 'gyur/ /de phyir lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /bsam dang sbyor bas bsten tshul ma log cing / /zol med dad pas snying nas gsol btab na/ /gnas skabs mthar thug dgos 'dod lhun gyis 'grub/ /chos kyi rtsa ba bla ma'i dam tshig yin/ /chos kyi snying po nges 'byung byang sems yin/ /chos kyi mthar thug nges don dbu ma yin/ /chos kyi gnad 'gag de la 'dus so zhes/ /85

—wastugasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa chos kyi rgyal po bla mas de skad gsung / /chos kyi tshul la snying nas 'jug 'dod na/ /chos kyi ro yi bcud 'di myong yang 'tshal/ /thog ma med nas rang sems rgya yan 'di/ /phyi rol sna tshogs yul la 'phro 'phro nas/ /nang du blo kha gtan nas ma phyogs pas/ /gsal rigs sems kyi rang gzugs ye ma mthong / /da ni bla ma'i gdams ngag me long la /bltas nas rang sems skyes bu'i bzhin ras kyi/ /glo bur dri ma'i nag nog kun bsal nas/ /dri bral rang zhal mjal na mi 'thad dam/ /'khor pa ba dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du sna tshogs bkra ba 'di/ /nang gi sems kyi ri mor bris tsam las/ /phyi rol don gyi steng nas grub pa med/ /rang sems mes pos 'khor 'das kun sprul mod/ /86

bslababyamutigaphrengang /wabyed po nyid kyang brtags cing dpyad pa'i tshe/ /'di yin 'di min ngos bzung dang bral ba/ /gsal rig bde ba'i nyams myong tsam du zad/ /zhi bde'i mal du bskal pa brgya stong bar/ /mnyam gzhag gnyid du yur ba'i 'phags pa'i gnas/ /thob kyang gzhan don sgrub la mthu dman pas/ /blo ldan don gnyer gtso bor 'os ma yin/ /thog med dus nas drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ /ma rnams 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal me chen gyis/ /mnar bas cho nge 'debs rnams yal dor nas/ /rang bde'i don gnyer de las tha chad su/ /de phyir snying rje'i rtsa ba brtan po can/ /rin chen byang chub sems kyi dpag bsam shing / /don gnyis 'bras bu g.yur du za ba de/ /skye rgu'i nyer 'tshor 'grub pa'i thabs la 'bad/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra bo che/ / 87

—wa79thushadabastan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bgrangs ring bskal par ltos min snyigs dus kyi/ /tshe thung gcig la mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ /gsang sngags nye lam 'dir 'phrad skal ba bzang /de yang 'jug sgo dbang thob dam sdom rnams/ /gces par bsrung ste bskyed rdzogs man ngag gnad/ /nyams myong can gyi bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin/ /thun bzhi'i rim pas nyams su blang byas te/ /zag bcas mngon shes tsam dang thun mong gi /dngos grub phran tshegs tsam gyis mi tshim par/ /mchog gi dngos grub gtso bor don gnyer ba/ /de la rnal 'byor pa zhes mkhas rnams zer/ /mdor na 'di phyi gnyis las phyi ma dang / /chos dang 'jig rten gnyis las dam chos dang / /bshad dang sgrub pa gnyis las sgrub pa rnams/ /gtso bor 'dzin pa ma nor 'dam ga yin/ /'on kyang thos pa med pa'i sgom pa ni/ /88

bslab bya mu tig phreng ba/ lag rdum brag la 'dzegs dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /de bas thog mar rgya chen gzhung lugs la/ /gnad du 'gro ba'i thos bsam bgyid pa 'tshal/ /tshig 'khri'i lbu bar dam bca'i stegs 'cha' zhing / /gzhan smod tshig mda'i sbyor ba lhur len dang / /ming dang go sa mthon po la re bas/ /lang tsho yol bar byed rnams don snying rul/ /rin chen chos kyang dkon la 'tshe ba mang / /gsungs phyir chos kyi bar chad zhi ba'i ched/ /skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs mdo sgrol la sogs la/ /'bad na tshe dang chos kyi bar chad bzlog /'du 'dzi lus 'phyor kha zhim long gtam gnyid/ /shwa sogs rnam g.yeng kho nas dus 'da' na/ /bdud dang bar chad gzhan nas ma 'ongs kyang / /rang nyid rang gi bdud du babs pa yin/ /sdig pa'i grogs la rgyal ba'i sras kyang 'jigs/ /89

—legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ — de phyir dam pa min pa'i las dag la/ /sbyor bar byed na pha ma yin yang rung / /bdud du gsungs phyir brtags nas spongs pa gces/ /'dir ni mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos/ /dam pa'i legs bshad spyi dang khyad par du/ /bka' gdams bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar sogs/ /yang yang bltas shing yi dam 'cha' bar byos/ /ji skad bshad pa'i don rnams nyams blangs na/ /tshe dang chos la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /thos bsam mthar phyin rang gzhan kun 'tshengs pa'i/ /dga' ston bzang po nyams su myong bar nges/ /dam pa'i zhal nas zab mo'i chos kyi gtam/ /thos kyang yul dus 'di 'drar smra la phangs/ /de ring blo ldan khyod kyis bskul ba las/ /snying gtam kha ru bton te yi ger bkod/ /dge bas 'gro ba ma rig ling thog gis/ /90

bslab bya mu tig phreng ba/blang dor lta ba'i blo mig sgrib pa rnams/ /yang dag gtam gyi dmigs bu la brten nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam du 'khrid par shog /ces bslab bya mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni mi'i dbang po har chin wang ratna siddhi'i rigs sras lha'i btsun pa mthu stobs nyi mas dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing du slob gnyer la 'gro skabs nan tan chen pos bskul ba'i ngor/btsun gzugs7blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas bla brang bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi gzim chung 'chi med dga' tshal du shar mar spel ba dge legs su gyur cig /

—/lenasabashadabasnanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ ——nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam yid 'byung dmar khrid bzhugs so/ /gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad/skye ba'i sa bon spangs pa yis /rga shi'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba/ /zag zad thub pa rnams la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i rgyun lam gcad du gsol/ /srid pa'i 'brog dgon thang dkyil na/ /rgas 'khogs rgad po nyal ba la/ /lang tshos dregs pa'i gzhon nu zhig /'ongs te co 'dri 'di skad gleng / /rgad po 'gro 'dug bya byed kun/ /gzhan dang mi mthun cal col rang / /byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zer/ /92

nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam/de la rgad pos lan smras pa/ /yog li sha dar khrag dar gyi/ /'phur ma lding khyod nga la nyon/ /nga yang lo 'ga'i sngon tsam na/ /tārshani las lhag sgos lhag cig yin/ /rgyug na gyi lang rta yang zin/ /bzung na byang kha'i 'brong yang thub/ /yang zor nam mkha'i bya dang mtshungs/ /mdzes pa lha phrug gzhon nu 'dra/ /bkrag mdangs can gyi gos kyang gyon/ /rin thang can gyi rgyan yang btags/ /zhim mngar can gyi zas kyang zos/ /bang rtsal can gyi rta yang zhon/ /rtse rgod ma byas gcig kyang med/ /dga' skyid ma myong gcig kyang med/ /'chi ba 'ongs dogs ga la yod/ /93

legasabashadabakaun bcosaphyogs bsgrigs/ —rga ba'ang thog tu 'ongs ma snyam/ /mdza' bshes 'du 'dzi'i 'ar 'ur gyis/ /g.yeng nas mgo bo 'khor ba'i thog /rga ba'i sdug bsngal g.yo can 'dis/ /'jab nas 'ongs te car gyis mnan/ /rang rgas rang gis ma tshor la /tshor ba'i dus su 'phyis nas gda'/ /shel gyi me long la bltas tshe/ /rang lus la yang skyug re bro/ /spyir na lus sems thams cad nyams/ /lhag par mgo nas thur nyams te/ /rgas pa a bhi ṣpeñtsa'i chus/ /mgo nas dbang rab bskur ba 'dra/ /skra lo dung ltar dkar ba 'di/ /nag nog dri ma dag pa min/ /'chi bdag mchil ma'i rgyang mda' de/ /94

da wa sderhage —da dzomasamyongargatsho'i'apho—skyam / sgeb mo'i zol gyis babs pa yin/ /dpral ba'i rwa gnyer khrig khrig 'di/ /bu chung rgyags pa'i zho gnyer min/ /tshe tshad lo mang 'das pa'i grangs/ /dus kyi pho nyas bris pa yin/ /blta 'dod zim zim mang ba 'di/ /mig tu du ba song ba min/ /dbang po nyams pa'i rab rib kyis/ /bsgribs nas bya thabs zad pa yin/ /rna ba gtad nas nyan pa 'di/ /lkog tu gsang gtam yod pa min/ /sgra kun rgyang na grags pa bzhin/ /shar te thos su re ba yin/ /sna chu thigs thigs 'bab pa 'di/ /mu tig do shal bstar ba min/ /gsal 'tsher lang tsho'i chab rom de/ /95

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gdung byed nyi mas bzhus pa yin/ /so yi 'phreng ba lhung ba 'di/ /skye 'dod se'u brjes pa min/ /tshe 'di'i za kha tshang ba yis /za byed lag cha bsdus pa yin/ /kha chu thar thar byed pa 'di/ /sa la chag chag 'debs pa min/ /sngon spyad longs spyod thams cad la/ /zhen log thud kyis 'debs pa yin/ /mi gsal ldab ldib smra ba 'di/ /skad rigs gzhan zhig shod pa min/ /don med ngag 'khyal smra ches pas/ /lce yang a thang chad pa yin/ /bzhin ras bsdus shing mdog ngan pa/ /spre'u'i 'dra 'bag gyon pa min/ /g.yar bo'i lang tsho phyir khyer bas/ /96

— nyamasamyongargazug po'i 'bel gtam/mi sdug rang mdog bstan pa yin/ /mgo bo g.yug g.yug byed pa 'di/ /gzhan gyi bya bar 'phya ba min/ /mthar byed dbyug pa'i sne phog pas/ /ma bzod klad pa 'dar ba yin/ /lam la kha gtad sgur ba 'di/ /rgya khab bor nas 'tshol ba min/ /sa la lang tsho'i nor bu dang / /dran pa stor ba'i rnam 'gyur yin/ /langs tshe sug bzhi 'dzugs pa 'di/ /phyugs kyi lad mo byas pa min/ /byin pas lus po ma theg pa'i/ /ram 'degs lag pas byed pa yin/ /sdod tshe chem gyis lhung ba 'di/ /grogs la 'khang ra byed pa min/ /spro dga'i sems kyi dpyang thag dang / /97

wadapegasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/lang tsho'i zungs thag chad pa yin/ /'gro tshe yom yom 'khyor ba 'di/ /mi chen gom stabs byed pa min/ /na tshod khur bo ha cang rang /lci bas yo drang shor ba yin/ /lag pa yab yab 'dar ba 'di/ /nor la hab sha byed pa min/ /lag par 'ong tshad cig car du/ /gshin rjes phrogs kyis dogs pa yin/ /bza' btung nyung shas spyod pa 'di/ /zas la ser sna byed pa min/ /lto ba'i me drod nyams pa yis/ /mi rgan sgyel gyis dogs pa yin/ /gos chung srab bde gyon pa 'di/ /yang chas byas nas 'khrab rgyu min/ /nang gi lus stobs shor ba yis /98

nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam/gos kyang khur du song ba yin/ /stod dbugs 'tshang zhing phu 'debs pa/ /gzhan la sngags lcag brdeg pa min/ /dbugs kyi 'gyu ba breng breng 'di/ /nam mkhar yal 'dod snga ltas yin/ /bya spyod thams cad 'gyur ba 'di/ /col chung gang dran byed pa min/ /rgas pa'i gdon gyis zin pa yis/ /rang 'dod dbang na med pa yin/ /las don thams cad brjed pa 'di/ /snang chung har rgyag byas pa min/ /rten gyi dbang po nyams pa yis /dran rig shes pa rdib pa yin/ /da lta nga la 'phya mi dgos/ /rgas pa ma bgos spyi na yod/ /lo gsum lon dus khyod la yang / /99

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bang chen snga ma sleb nas 'ongs/ /ngas bshad rna bar mi 'gro ste/ /nyams myong nang nas skyes te 'ongs/ /deng sang tshe lo mar 'grib pas/ /nga yi lo tsam khyod mi sdod/ /gal te bsdad na tshod 'di la/ /kha yang cher grag mi nus mod/ /byas pa'i lan du gzhon nu yis/ /mis 'phya khyis 'gom bla 'tshong bo/ /khyod 'dra byas te sdod pa las/ /sngon du shi na dga' zhes zer/ /lan du rgad po khrel 'dzum bcas/ /tshe ring skyid rgyag 'dod pa la/ / rgas pa mi 'dod a re glen/ /shi yang skyid rgyu dka' mo yin/ /dad zas dkor zas ma zos shing / /100

nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam/dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrungs/ /thos bsam sgom pa byas yod na/ /nam zhig shi yang skyid pa yin/ /nga ni de 'dra cung zad kyang / /sems la 'dzin rgyu mi 'dug pas/ /phung po rgas rung gson na dga'/ /zhag gcig yin kyang bsdad na snyam/ /byas pas gzhon nu blo 'gyur te/ /bden no bden no rgad po bden/ /mig gis mngon sum mthong ba dang / /khyod kyi bshad pa ngo 'phrod pas/ /dmar khrid sems la 'bab pa byung / /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ya re nga / /rgan po go mthong rig gsum che/ /'jigs pa de 'dra mi 'byung ba'i/ /thabs shig yod na drang bor shod/ /101

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byas pas rgad po 'dzum bzhin du/ /de yi thabs yod las kyang sla/ /byed kyang phal cher mi dgos mod/ /skyes tshad thams cad 'chi na yang / /rgas nas 'chi ba nyung shas yin/ /dgos rgyu mi 'chi'i thabs dgos kyang / /de ni gang du song yang med/ /sngon byon sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /skyes chen rgyal blon thams cad 'das/ /da lta bzhugs pa kun kyang 'da'/ /khyod rang gcig pur gang nas sdod/ /de bas chos shig byed nus na/ /rgas pas lus po rgud na yang / /sems la dga' spro'i gdeng zhig yod/ /'chi ba thog tu babs na yang / /bu chung pha khyim 'gro ba 'dra/ /102

nyamasarjond+rarganapo'i'abel gtam/thabs kyi yang rtse 'di las lhag /sangs rgyas la yang gsung du med/ /mi rgan nga yi snying gtam yin/ /'on kyang ngas bshad kha na med/ /rang don rang gis bsam blo thongs/ /byas pas gzhon nus legs so legs/ /'on kyang gnyen gyi las don dang / /khang gzhi nom pa'i gtong len sogs/ /bya ba las don 'phro mang bas /lo 'gar khom pa mi 'dug kyang / /de rjes nges par chos shig byed/ /de dus nged gnyis 'phrad dgos zer/ /rgad po shin tu ma mgu bar/ /khyod kyi bsam don stongs pa yin/ /lo 'ga'i 'phro nas byed snyam pa/ /nga la'ang snga mo zhig nas yod/ /103

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las 'phro mi rgan kha spu bzhin/ /bcad kin bcad kin je mang yin/ /lo 'ga' lo 'ga' ma tshar ba'i/ /ngang la mi tshe tshar nas thal/ /phyi bshol 'di yis thams cad bslus/ /khyod la chos kyi re ba med/ /don med kha bshad nyi ma 'phul/ /de bas khyed rang yul du song / /rgad po ma ṇi 'don du chug /byas pas gzhon nu ha las te/ /rgad po rtog dpyod mi gtong bar/ /de 'dra zer lugs gang na yod/ /bya ba las don 'di tsam zhig /bskyur nas 'jog lugs ji ltar yod/ /byas pas rgad pos a ha ha/ /nga la de skad byas chog ste/ /104

nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam/lho phyogs 'di na bya ba'i 'phro/ /e 'grub rtog dpyod mi gtong ba'i/ /rgad po btsan po ma zhig yod/ /de la gros shig e chud ltos/ /de yis hab rgyug byas pa'i nyin/ /rgan gzhon mtho dman thams cad kyi/ /las 'phro rtsi skud bregs pa bzhin/ /zed de bzhag nas 'gro kin snang / /de dus mi bskyur thabs med yin/ /gnas lugs mi 'chol dbang med yin/ /nam rkyang bskyur nas 'gro ba la/ /da lta bskyur na don yod yin/ /'on kyang phan par smra ba dkon/ /de bas de la nyan pa dkon/ /byas pas gzhon nus phyag btsal te/ /bla ma dbu gdugs skor mkhan nas/ /105

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dge bshes che gnyan tsho la yang /gdams pa 'di las zab mi 'dug /rgad po'i tshul bzung dge ba'i bshes/ /khyed kyis ci gsungs bzhin du byed/ /da dung gdams pa thugs rjes gzigs/ /byas par rgad pos 'o na legs/ /rgad pos ma myong dgu myong yang / /dang por chos kyi rkang tshugs pa/ /'di las dka' zhig mi 'dug pas/ /rgas shing 'khogs nas yong sa med/ /byed na gzhon pa'i dus 'dir gyis/ /gzhon dus rkang zhig 'dzugs thub na/ /rgas kyang lag len sla tshod red/ /chos kyi gnad cig go byung na/ /ci byas chos su 'gro tshod red/ /blo sna ma mang dran thog rang / /106
