nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam/'di nas chos la chig dril mdzod/ /rtsa ba bshes gnyen tshul bzhin sten/ /dam tshig sdom pa mig bzhin srungs/ /'di snang 'khri ba rbad kyis chod/ /blo bzang rgyal bstan snying po la/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gcig tu dril/ /rgyab brten bsag sbyang la 'bad na/ /sangs rgyas lag pa'i rtse na yod/ /a re dga' la a re skyid/ /bu gces bsam pa 'grub nas yong / /byas pas gnyis ka gros mthun te/ /de yi nyin mo ring nas bzung / /chos brgyad dri mas ma sbags pa'i/ /dam chos sgrub pa lhur blangs so/ /de ltar rgan gzhon 'char sgo dang / /nyams la dpag pa'i gtam 'di yang / /107

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gzhan mtha' dag nyams len la/ /blo kha phyogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig /rang la nyams myong ma mchis kyang / /sems can mos pa sna tshogs par/ /'di 'dra yis kyang phan srid snyam/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris/ /'di la rtog bzo tsam zhig ma yin gyi bzhi brgya pa las/ khyod ring gson pa la dga' zhing / /rgan nyid la khyod mi dga' na/ /e ma khyod spyod skye bo ni/ /'dra la dam pa lta bur 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel pa zla bas mdzad pa las/ mi rgan po 'ga' zhig skyed mos tshal du zhugs pa la gzhon nu rnams kyis rgad po khyod gzugs ngan no zhes bzhad gad du byed cing de rnams kyis yun ring du gson par 'dod pa'ang yin te/ de'i phyir de rnams kyi spyod pa ni rmongs pa'i skye bo dang 'dra ba kho na la dam pa ltar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir de ltar na bdag nyid kyi sdug bsngal rig pas gzhan 'chi ba na gzhan dag kyang 'di lta bu'i chos can no zhes skyo ba dang ldan par bya dgos so/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa gsal bar byas pa yin no/ /108

bod la slob gnyer du song ba rnams la bslab bya byas pa mu thi la'i phreng ba/bod la slob gnyer du song ba rnams la bslab bya byas pa mu thi la'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyis mdzad/o bde legs su gyur cigalegs smon gyis bskrun dal 'byor 'khri shing rtser/ /mang thos me tog rnam par rgyas shul du/ /mkhas mang 'bras bu yongs su smin pa'i dris/ /rab 'byams spro ba dag gi snyan gyi sgor/ /lung gi chu gter dbus su rtag nyal yang / /rtogs pa'i yon tan gsher gyis ma brlan pa'i/ /shes rgyud skam thag chod pa'i rdo yi spun/ /col chung zhig gis 'di skad gsol la dgongs/ /rtog ge'i rigs pa rno ba tsam zhig la/ /mkhas pa mgu ba'i gna' skad mi 'dug pas/ /109

/legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhung gi don la 'byor nges slob gnyer zhig /rdo rus thug nges yong ba gal che'o/ /de phyir grwa ba so so'i 'gal 'du la/ /go lugs mi 'dra ba re yong nges gshis/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i khungs dang nyer gtugs te/ /bdar sha chod nges gyis shig grogs po dag /sgos su sngags la bag chags ma thebs na/ /sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje'i theg /ces sogs bsngags pa brjod pa'i dgos pa yang / /stor nyen che'o snying gi grogs po dag /mang du thos kyang 'chad la mi mkhas na/ /lce brgya sprul nas smras kyang lkugs pa yin/ /rtsod la mkhas kyang rtsom tshul mi shes na/ /mkhas pa'i snyan pa rang dang mnyam du 'chi/ /kha nas rtsom yang sug bris mi 'byor na/ /dpa' rtsal che ba'i lag rdum gnyis pa yin/ /110

bod la slob gnyer du song ba rnams la bslab bya byas pa mu thi la'i phreng ba/rtsom tshig yi ge gzhung bzhin ma byung na/ /mkhas pa khrel zhing don log ston nyen che/ /yi ge dag kyang snyan ngag mi ldan na/ /yid 'ong mdzes ma gos hrul gyon pa bzhin/ /mngon brjod gsar snying brda' yis ma spud na/ /grong tshig 'dres pas mkhas rnams bzhad pa'i rgyu/ /de'i phyir rig gnas kun la mkhas pa dang / /mdo sngags zung la rig rtsal ci yod kyis/ /mkhas par sbyangs nas pha yul 'dir phebs nas/ /da gzod bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs 'gyur ro snyam/ /de ring thug kyang lab rgyu 'di las med/ /nangs par shi yang kha chems 'di rang yin/ /zhus pa 'di la zhus dag ma dgos par/ /gang zhus dgongs pa'i yul du bskyud med 'tshal/ /bla ma bden tshig grub pa'i bden mthu dang / /bla ma sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang / /111
bdag cag lhag bsam 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /khyed cag ci bsam de ltar 'grub gyur cig /a lag sha'i lha rams pas smras pa'o/ /

man ngag snying po bzhugs so/ /man ngag snying po bzhugs so/ /yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad/na mo gu ru/gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i don/ /grub chen rnams kyi thugs dam mthil/ /zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /man ngag snying po'i rtsa tshig bri/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /gzhi dang rten dang rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa ste/ /de yi rnal 'byor sgom tshul ni/ /ma nor lam bzang ston byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i sku gzugs la/ /phyogs bcu rgyal ba kun bzhugs par/ /113

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ /de phyir sangs rgyas kun 'dus su/ /bcos min nges pa rnyed gyur na/ /bshes gnyen bsam pas bsten tshul gyi/ /gnad kyi man ngag de nyid do/ /'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa/ /dge ba'i bsam pa nyid las 'byung / /dge sems skye ba bla ma la/ /rag las phyir na legs tshogs kun/ /bla ma'i mthu las 'byung bar nges/ /rgyal kun ngo bor blta ba ni/ /dang ba'i dad pa sgom tshul lo/ / legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas su/ /blta ba yid ches sgom tshul lo/ /ci gsung bka' bzhin sgrub byed pa/ /mngon 'dod dad pa'i skyong tshul lo/ /114

man ngag snying po bzhugs so/ /mi 'dod rkyen ngan byung ba sogs/ /gal che'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bla ma spyi bor bsgom byas nas/ /phur tshugs gsol 'debs byed pa gces/ /rgya chen bsod nams gsog 'dod tshe/ /bla ma mdun du bsgom byas nas/ /mchod tshogs rgya mtshos mchod pa gces/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /bla ma snying dbus bsgom byas te/ /rang gi sems dang bla ma gnyis/ /dbyer med bsre ba man ngag go /dad ldan gdul byas gsol btab tshe/ /rang sems bla ma dbyer med du/ /bsgom nas bla ma'i phyag g.yas kyis/ /gzhan la byin rlabs byed par bsam/ /gzhan gyis phyag sogs byed pa'i tshe/ /115

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bla ma nyid la phyag byed par/ /bsam na rang gzhan kun la phan/ /nyon mongs 'khrul snang shar ba'i tshe /snying dbus bzhugs pa bla ma rje/ /spyod ngan 'di yis thugs khrel zhes/ /bsam na de ma thag tu bzlog /dge sems gsar du skyes pa'i tshe/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'di 'o zhes/ /bsams nas bka' drin rjes dran te/ /gus pas mchod la brtson par bya/ /mdor na yab rje dam pa'i bka'/ /gsung rab snying po'i mthar thug pa/ /gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i/ /man ngag gnad kyi don po ni/ /rang sems bla ma yi dam gsum/ /dbyer med gcig tu bsres byas nas/ /116

man ngag snying po bzhugs so/ /gnyis spangs mkha' dbyings dbus dag tu/ /dran shes rgya yis bcings byas na/ /bde chen 'od gsal nyin byed 'char/ /nyin byed de yi 'od zer gyis/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis kyis/ /rgyan gyis spras pa'i lha bu 'byung / /lha bu de yi 'od snang gi / mkha' dbyings yongs su 'geng bar byed/ /'on kyang 'jig rten mes po sogs/ /mthu chen gyis kyang mi mthong na/ /skye bo phal bas mthong re skan/ /de phyir de lta'i tshul 'di la/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba zhes su grags/ /tshul 'di 'jam mgon bla ma yis/ /snyan brgyud man ngag 'dzin pa yis/ /snying gi bu la brtse bas gdams/ /117

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /bis pa ngag dbang mi pham zla bas mdzad/na mo/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs/ /bla ma skal ldan rgya mtsho thugs rje can/ /bdag gi drin can pha ma thugs rjes skyongs/ /bla ma khyed las lhag pa'i skyabs gnas med/ /pha ma 'di bas lhag pa'i drin can med/ /da res min pa drin ngo ji ltar shes/ /drin lan myur du bsab par cis kyang 'dod/ /'dod pa ji bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs rje ma chung bla ma spyan ras gzigs/ /kye ma bdag dang pha ma rigs drug rnams/ /118

pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa/mtha' med 'khor pa'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol/ /'khor pa 'di la thog mtha' ma mchis pas/ /skye ba 'di la grangs shig ga la yod/ /lus rten 'di 'dra ma blangs bya ba dang / /yul phyogs 'di ru ma skyes bya ba med/ /bdag ni khams gsum 'khor pa gar skyes kyang / /skye gnas bzhi bo gang yang rung bar skyes/ /de las mngal dang sgong skyes thams cad ni/ /drin can pha ma dag la brten nas skyes/ /skye ba thog ma med nas yang yang du/ /pha mar gyur nas drin gyis bskyangs pa yi/ /drin can pha ma 'di dag snying re rje/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /skye ba sngon gyi las dang smon lam mthus/ /tshe 'di'i pha ma bu tshar gyur pa las/ /brtse gdung lhag par che ba'i drin can ma/ /119

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /lha bas lhag pa'i rnyed dka' don che ba/ /chos ldan mi lus yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ /da lta gang las rnyed pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /a ma drin can lus kyi sgrom bu nas/ /sha khrag gdos bcas phung po gces spras kyis/ /zla ngo bcu la khur ba'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /thur sel rlung gis 'byung ba g.yos pa'i tshe/ /sha rus kha khar 'dral ba'i sdug myong yang / /sems la mi dga' med pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /mjal nas khrag dang chu ser lhan cig lus/ /btsas ma thag tu gtsang ma'i chab kyis bkrus/ /byi dor gang legs bgyis pa'i drin can ma/ /120

pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa/bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /sha rus nyor nyor len sna med pa'i dus/ /lag pas 'jam por blangs nas pang du bzung / /kha sna lce yis ldag pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /rang lus rang gis skyob pa'i nus pa med/ /nyi lhags char gyi gdung ba myur du bskyabs/ /gom pa tsog por 'jog pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /kha yis zas snyod mi gtsang lag pas phyis/ /snabs lud dri ma kha ru song na yang / /snang ba zhen pa ma log drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /brang la nu 'bur rgyas pa'i 'o 'dzin las/ /byams pa'i shugs kyis zags pa'i nu zho'i rgyun/ /nam 'dod kha ru bsnun pa'i drin can ma/ /121

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /nyin mtshan med par rum phug dro bar bcug /mtshan mo gti mug gnyid kyis non pa'i tshe/ /gsod dogs nub gnyid chags pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /'grang dus 'dzum zhing bgad na spro ba skyes/ /ltogs dus g.yo zhing ngu ba skad cig kyang / /mi bzod nu ma bsnun pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /rkang bzhi dud 'gro lta bur 'gro ba'i dus/ /lag mgos 'then nas rkang gnyis 'degs 'jog gi /gam tse gom tse slob pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /dang po glen pa lug ltar lkugs pa zhig /da lta thams cad smra zhing don go ba'i/ /mi skad 'di tsam bslabs pa'i drin can ma/ /122

pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa/bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes thungs/ /lo gsum dus su gar 'gro mig gis 'tsho/ /lo bzhi la sogs gang lon gzugs tshod kyi/ /zhwa gos lham sogs bsgrubs pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /lo bcu lon nas rang mgo thon pa'i tshe/ /sems kyi kho thag chod pa'i dga' skyid dang / /rtag tu sdod snyam 'grogs pa'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /skyes tsam nyid nas ji srid 'grogs pa'i bar/ /byams pas blta zhing snyan pa'i tshig gis 'bod/ /brtse ba'i sems kyis skyong ba'i drin can ma/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /bla ma sangs rgyas gsung gis dran gsos nas/ /a ma khyod kyi sku drin yang yang du/ /bsams na yid rab g.yo ba'i drin can ma/ /123

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas go 'phang 'dod na yang / /a ma khyod drin snying nas ma bsams shing / /gces par ma bzung lam sna zin thabs med/ /sangs rgyas khyod la rag las drin can ma/ /lam bzang ma nor ston pa'i bla ma dang / /lam de gang la dmigs pa'i drin can ma/ /lam mchog bsgrub la dgos pa khyad med na/ /sngon chad de ltar ma shes shin tu nongs/ /a ma khyod drin ma bsam blo re 'gyod/ /drin can yal bar dor ba snying nas 'gyod/ /ma gus brnyas smod bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /kha lan lag lan bgyis pa mthol lo bshags/ /sems dkrugs thugs dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /ngag bcag gsung dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags/ /mgo bskor rdzun gyis bslus pa mthol lo bshags/ /124

pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa/bsnyen bkur tshul bzhin ma byas mthol lo bshags/ /pha dang ma la gnod pa'i las byas pa'i/ /sdig can de dag sus kyang skyob thabs dka'/ /sngon tshe ston pa mdza' bo'i bu mo ru/ /'khrungs pa'i gtam rgyud sogs kyis yid ches skye/ /pha dang ma la gus pas bsnyen bkur ba'i/ /mi la bde skyid snyan gsum nges par che/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/ /mdzad pa rnam thar bsam na yid ches skye/ /skye ba 'di la drin can pha ma yis /chos ldan mi lus bskyed pa'i don po la/ /chos shig byung na rang skyid gzhan skyid de/ /chos mthun bsam pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chi bar nges shing nam 'chi cha med la/ /'chi tshe chos min gzhan gyis phan pa med/ /shi nas med du mi 'gro skye nges shing / /125

legos bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skye ba'ang ngan 'gro bde 'gro gnyis las med / /gar skye las kyi gzhan dbang ma gtogs pa/ /da lta rang la rang dbang ci yang med/ /sdig can bzod par dka' ba'i ngan 'gro dang / /dge ba gang byas bde nas bde bar 'gro /ngan song 'jigs las skyob nus dkon mchog gsum/ /skyob thabs rang gis ma byas skyob mi nus/ /bya rgyu chos las med par blo thag chod/ /chos zhes bya ba sdig spong dge sgrub yin/ /skyes pa'i tha ma nges par 'chi ba la/ /kha drag can yang cung zad 'dug dbang med/ /gcig tu 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /bsogs pa'i tha ma nges par 'dzad pa la/ /ser sna can yang cung zad 'khyer dbang med/ /gcig tu 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /126

pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i snying po bsdus pa/bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /mthon po'i tha ma nges par rgud pa la/ /nga rgyal can yang cung zad 'gying dbang med/ /gcig tu 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyis thugs rjes zungs/ /'grogs pa'i tha ma nges par 'bral ba la/ /brtse gdung can yang cung zad 'grogs dbang med/ /gcig tu 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos /bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes zungs/ /ma khyod 'di nas gcig pur 'gro ba'i tshe/ /nga dang khyod dang spyan ras gzigs mgon gsum/ /mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal lo drin can ma/ /tshe 'dir yun ring 'grogs pa'i dus kyi mthar/ /mnar gcod sdug bsngal med par dga' bzhin du/ /zhing mchog bde ba can der skye bar shog /skyes nas bla ma sangs rgyas mjal bar shog /127

legs geshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mjal nas byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /thob nas sems can don rnams byed par shog /bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /smon lam thams cad 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /der smras pa/dam pa'i gsung la bcos slad mi 'os kyang / /phal pa'i ngag sgros byi dor bgyis pa 'di/ /mi pham dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis/ /mi pham dkon mchog ces bya'i 'dod ngor smras/ /dad med rnams la don du mi 'gyur yang / /dad pa can la ci yang phan pa srid/ /rdo thog myu gu'i re ba ma mchis kyang / /zhing la sa bon gang btab skye la ltos/ /bsod nams gser gyi thur ma ring po des/ /rang gzhan kun gyi blo gros mig phye nas/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi yum/ / rang zhal rjen par mthong ba'i skal bzang shog /128

lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal/lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal bzhugs so/ /dngul chu dharma bha dras mdzad/oṃ bde legs su gyur cigasmra ba zla med 'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal/ /rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi pham mgon/ /mgon po klu sgrub thogs med jo 'brom zung / /zung 'jug mngon gyur 'jam mgon bla mar 'dud/ /lugs gnyis shes bya'i khyon dang mnyam song ba'i/ /grangs med rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i chu klung 'bum/ /yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i rgya mtshor legs 'khyil ba/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mos dge legs stsol/ /129

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshe 'di'i bde sgrub 'jig rten mi chos dang / /gtan gyi bde sgrub dam pa'i lha chos gnyis/ /'gal med gcig grogs gcig tu 'char ba'i gtam/ /sgrog la sgra 'dzin gtod dang shes ldan dag /'jig rten mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug dang / /dam pa'i lha chos dge ba bcu yi khrims/ /chos ldan sa spyod mes dbon rnam gsum gyis/ /byang phyogs 'gro la bcas 'di nges par mdzod/ /'di snang dgra bo'i 'jigs 'phrog dpon po la'ang /gus pas bsnyen bkur rim gro bya dgos na/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun sel mchog gsum la/ /phyag mchod skyabs 'gror dus kun brtson par mdzod/ /dang por las 'bras spang blang shes pa dang / /bar du nan tan nyams su len pa dang / /tha mar sdig sgrib stobs bzhis sbyong ba ni/ /dam chos sgrub tshul lags pas 'bad par mdzod/ /130

lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal/khams gsum 'gro kun gnyen du mtshungs mod kyang / /tshe 'di'i sgyu lus ster ba'i pha dang ma/ /phan 'dogs zhing du rgyal bas bsngags pa la/ /yid ches gus pas bkur sti bsgrub par mdzod/ /stobs 'byor kha drag ldan pa'i skye bo ni/ /mang yang bstan 'gror phan thogs cang ma mchis/ /de phyir lung rtogs yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /dam pa spyi gtsug rgyan du bsten par mdzod/ /rigs rus cho 'brang btsun pa'i ya rabs dang / /na tshod thos dang bslab pas rgan pa la/ /phu dud bsgrub na bde skyid 'phel 'gyur zhes/ /mkhas mchog dpa' bos gsungs la yid ches mdzod/ /khyi dang glo ba phrad pa ji bzhin du/ /rgyus med mi la gsar 'grogs ma snga bar/ /dbyar dgun 'gyur med lha shing shug pa ltar/ /sngar 'dris mdza' bshes kun la gzhung ring mdzod/ /131

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/thag ring gnyen las khyim mtshes dgra bo yang /dga' zhes gna' bo'i ngag las 'byung ba bzhin/ /yul mi khyim mtshes rang ltos 'khor 'bangs dang / /gnyom chung kun la phan pa gang thogs mdzod/ /mchog gsum dkar phyogs lha dang rang sems gsum/ /dpang btsugs drang bo'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa la/ /sngon byung khyim bdag tshul khrims tshong dpon gyi/ /'gran zlar 'os pa'i yi dam brtan po mdzod/ /dmyal ba'i bud shing lta bu'i sdig can 'ga'i/ /'phral snang zas gos stobs 'byor kha drag la/ /'gram chu ldang nas de rjes ma 'brang bar/ /ya rabs dam pa'i tshogs la mig ltos mdzod/ /zas nor sngon gyi sbyin shugs la rag pas/ /gsog srung dam yang 'phel ba'i nges pa med/ /de bas 'di phyi'i bde legs spel bzhed na/ /mchod sbyin gnyis kyi phyogs su longs spyod mdzod/ /132

lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal/rang la che phra'i phan 'dogs skye bo la/ /lhag dang mnyam sogs rang nus dang bstun pa'i/ /phan lan bgyid pa'i bsam sbyor ma bsten na/ /khrel med grangs su brtsi bas dogs zon mdzod/ /ngag nas cal col ra smra lug smra dang / /bre dang srang la g.yo sgyu byed pa sogs/ /kha zhe ngo lkog bsam sbyor 'gal ba'i las mtha' dag srog 'phrog dug bzhin spong bar mdzod/ /'gro kun bde 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod phyir/ /chags sdang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po'i ngang /dge dang bde bar spyod pa 'ga' mthong tshe/ /phrag dog med pa'i dga' ba bsgom par mdzod/ /g.yo sgyu zhags snes chags ldan dam bcings nas/ /ngan spyod g.yang du skyur bar byed pa yi/ /dug 'dres kham zas lta bu'i bud med kyi/ /gros dbang ma gtong rang thag gcod par mdzod/ /133

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dman 'bring chen po su la smra yang rung / /rang gzhan 'phral phugs don la legs gzhigs nas/ /ha cang pher dang zhum min bden gtam gyis/ /'jam zhing don phigs smra tshul mkhas par mdzod/ /gting ring 'khor pa'i gcong rong zab mo'i nang / /snyigs ma'i tsher rnon skyes pa'i klong tshud phyir/ /phyi nang gang nas gnod 'tshe ci byung yang / /theg pa che zhing blo khog yangs par mdzod/ /grog sbur nas bzung bsam shes mi yi bar/ /kun gyi gces pa so so'i srog yin zhing / /rang la tsher ma zug pa'ang mi bzod pa'i/ /ngang tshul bsams nas srog gcod spong bar mdzod/ /gzhan gyis yongs su bzung ba'i dngos po dag /mthu dang 'jab bu'i sgo nas blangs gyur na/ /'phral du gtam ngan rgyal khrims chad pa 'phog /phyi ma dbul por 'gyur bas bag zon mdzod/ /134

lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal/'khor pa'i btson rar 'ching byed lcags sgrog de/ /'dod chags sred pa yin par shes byas nas/ /bgrod bya yan lag gnas dang dus min du/ /log par g.yem pa 'bad pas spong bar mdzod/ /phyi mar ro 'dzin thong gshol gyis rmo zhing / /tshe 'dir dman pa'i gral du tshud pa dang / /gzhan gyi 'dod don sgrub la gegs byed pa'i/ /'du shes bsgyur ba'i rdzun tshig spong bar mdzod/ /sems can mthun pa rnams la dbye 'dod dang / /mi mthun pa la mi 'dum par 'dod nas/ /'byed tshig bden rdzun snyan min gang rung gis/ /smra ba phra ma lags pas spong bar mdzod/ /rigs lus tshul khrims kun spyod skyon sgrog sogs/ /pha rol snying la bsnun pa'i tshig rtsub mos/ /rang gzhan dge rtsa'i ljon shing sreg 'gyur bas/ /rtsub mo'i tshig de gre bar bskyil bar mdzod/ /135

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal blon chom rkun 'dod pa bud med kyi/ /gtam sogs don med cal col sna tshogs kyis/ /rang gzhan dge sems rtsad nas 'byin byed pa/ /ngag kyal lags pas 'di yang spong bar mdzod/ /chags brkam 'chums 'khu zil non sems dang lngas/ /gzhan gyi nor dang yo byad la sogs pa/ /bdag gir gyur cig snyam du smon pa ni/ /brnab sems lags pas yang dag spong bar mdzod/ /zhe sdang mi bzod 'khon 'dzin 'khu ba dang / /zil non sems lngas sems can gzhan dag la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam ngan 'chang ba ni/ /nyes dmigs lhag par che bas spong bar mdzod/ /rmongs dang drag shul log par rgyun du zhugs/ /rab tu nyams dang zil non sems lnga yis/ /las 'bras bden bzhi dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ /med par lta ba'i log lta spong bar mdzod/ /136

lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal/de ltar ji skad gdams pa bzhin bsgrubs na/ /tshe 'dir ya rabs mkhas pa'i grwar tshud cing / /phyi mar mngon mtho'i rten bzang rim brgyud nas/ /nges legs grong khyer bgrod par gdon mi za/ /'on te rang nyid sdom gsum yongs mnos kyang / /bag med spyod pas nyin mtshan 'da' bzhin du/ /gzhan la 'doms 'di mdze can 'ga' zhig gis/ /mkha' lding dbang po'i sgrub thabs bsngags dang mtshungs/ /de lta na yang dpyod ldan grogs po yis/ /nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ /'khos bral dge sbyong dharma bha dra yis/ /bzhad ljongs sa 'dzin phug yangs ngos su sbyar/ /de las 'ongs pa'i rab dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /drin can mkha' mnyam 'gro ba mtha' dag la/ /lugs zung blang dor 'dzol med 'doms pa la/ /rnam mkhyen rgyal ba kun dang mtshungs par shog /137

ces lugs zung gi blang dor 'dzol med du 'doms pa'i bslab bya rin po che'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpyod ldan bkra shis chos 'phel lags nas nan chen pos bskul ngor/ dge sbyong dbang phyug chos bzang gis sbyar pa'o/ /

zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu/zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs so//zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtshos mdzad/bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs kyi don ni/ khyod kyis gzhung lugs la thos bsam bgyis/ bshes gnyen dam pa mang du bsten/ gdams ngag ni yod/ 'dus byas thams cad rtag pa yin pa shes/ 'khor pa'i mtshan nyid bde ba yin pa mthong / da bsam blo zhig gtong ran yin tshod du 'dug pas sgrub pa nyams len zhig e yong snyam pa'i re ba bdag la yod/ sgrub pa'i gzhi rten tshul khrims dag pa yin kyang bsrung bya sna gcig gi chog shes mi bya bar phyogs thams cad nas ra ba brtan po dgos/de'i steng nas nyams su len lugs mā a lags tshang la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pa ltar sum skya byed dgos/ de la ltung bshags gsungs nas bshags sbyangs byas na de las dga' med/gang ltar yan lag bdun pa maṇḍal mchod 'bul sogs bsags 139

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sbyangs kyi rlan zhig yod na tshig spyi'i myu gu de je rlon du 'gro ba myong bas kyang grub/ lam thun mong pa sngon 'gro kho na min gyi des gzhi 'dzin dgos pa thun mong zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pas shes/thog mar dad pas sna ma drangs na dge sems yin min yang shes dka'/ dad pa dmigs rkyen las skye dgos pas yon tan bsam pa gal che/ yon tan mthong ba'i gegs sel tshul lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir zhes pa ltar yin/ dad pa phyogs zhen du mi 'gro ba'i thabs shes pa yang gal che/ mi rtag pa la phra rags mang du gsungs mod thog mar sang phod da tsam bdag ji 'dra snyam/ de las je ring du btang ste ma mtha' lo lnga bcu tshun chad la 'chi bar thag chod snyam du bsam/ de nas 'chi kha ma'i gnas skabs dang /bar do'i gnas skabs sogs rim par bsam/ de nas skye ba gcig dang bcu khri 'bum sogs blang na skyid sdug ji 'dra yong dgos rgyu red bsam/ yang kha tshur 'khor te da lta bla ma 'di 'dra dang mjal/ gdams ngag 'di 'dra yod/ shes rab de tsam mchis bzhin du des dgos pa gang yang ma byung na ci byed snyam du blo 140

zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu/'tshab e lang blta/ de nas yul ba khyim tshang la bsam na bza' mi khyim gang bo'i shul na mi re re las med/ grwa thog grogs mched sogs rang las rgan gzhon mang bo shi song tshul re re bzhin dran par bya/ spyir gyi bstan pa'i dar rgud/ 'jig rten gyi bde sdug bya ba che chung thams cad 'gyur song ba 'di la bsam blo btang / ston pa thugs rje can gyis dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ zhes pa nas/nges par 'jig par gyur pas zhes sogs la bsam blo legs par btang na phan thogs cung zad yod/ de chags zhen dang 'dres yod pa 'dra bas bsam blo cung zad rgya bskyed de 'khor bar skye ba zhig blangs phyin mtha' mi brtan pas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug tshul zhib tu bsam na gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi gnas zhes sogs gsungs pa la mig gis mthong rgyu dang / lag pas 'dzin rgyu lta bu'i go ba zhig 'char/ de nas kun 'byung gi sdug 'og 'di nas thar ba zhig byung na snyam pas ma rig pa la gnang ba gtan zhus shig byed lugs e 'dug soms/ mgo 'dren byed mkhan mi rtag sogs bcu drug po yin kyang bu bzang ba bo bdag 141

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/med rtogs pa'i shes rab red/ de'i ma ni'i 'og la 'jug rgyu re e rnyed rem/ kha nas bshad rgyu tsam des kho mi mgu/ tan tan tig tig cig dka' rung phyogs 'gro re shin tu gal che/ de nas rang gi ma'am gnyen drin can zhig rkang lag rnams mes tshig nas nyam thag pa'i skad kyis rang la 'bod cing yod na/ khyod re zhig sdod dang nga mi khom par 'dug zer lugs e 'dug myong ba la bskor nas bsam/ de'i mtshams nas gnyen nye du shi song ba rnams kyis da lta skyid sdug ji 'dra myong ba sus shes/ des mtshon nas ma drin can la la tsha bas nyam thag la la grang bas nyam thag la la bkres skom gyis nyam thag lhag par shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs sogs mig gis mngon sum du mthong ba rnams yid yul du byas/ de tshos sdug bsngal ji 'dra myong na myong du chug nga la za rgyu dang gon rgyu yod/yon tan dang bkur bsnyi yod snyam du bsdad na de las khrel med pa su yod snyam du bsam/ de nas de dag la phan bde sgrub lugs gtan nas med na thabs mi snang yang / sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang po sems can yin pas grol lugs shig yod 'dug des 142

zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu/na ma rgan de rnams kyi bde ba thams cad ngas bsgrub/ sdug bsngal thams cad ngas bsal/ de yang gzhan la rag ma las par bdag gcig pus sgrub pa zhig byung na snyam du sems dung dung ba byed/ de nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dran nas de 'dra ba zhig thob na sems can gyi don mtha' dag sgrub nus par thag chod mod/ de spang las shwa mo brdol ba ltar mi yong bas rgyu phun sum tshogs pa zhig gis sgrub dgos pas/ phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi la bslab tshul sa rgyan sbyar ba las byung ba dang / yul mkhyen pa gsum/ lam sbyor ba bzhi nyams su blangs nas 'bras bu chos sku dang 'phrin las nyer bdun/ 'byung tshul sogs rgya chen spyod pa dang / grub mtha' so so'i bzhed lugs kyi lta ba rim gyis je phrar 'gro tshul rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs kyi dgongs pa ltar zab mo lta ba'i rim pa/ de'i steng du lam pa gnyis sogs bsnan te mdo sngags cha tshang ba'i lam gyi bgrod lugs spyi khog tsam 'char bar byas nas/ de'i ched du nyams len 'di byed pas 'di de 'dra ba'i rgyur gyur cig snyam du smon lam gyi rnam pas 143

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sems bskyed na bsam pa rgya che ba go sgrub zer/ de'i ngang nas skad cig dkrong bskyed dang / rdor dril byin rlabs kyis snga ma gnyis slar yang gsal 'debs/ de ltar rim pas kun slong gi rtsi ma yal bar yang dang yang du gsal 'debs pa 'di gal che/ dran 'dun du re bas ma zin na thabs shes ya bral du 'gro lugs gzhung chen nas gsungs pa de red/ sa bdun pa man chad na smon sems yod gsungs pas 'di la dbang bo byed dgos/ lhag par sngags lta ba'i steng nas yong dgos pa bsang dang gtor chung re yan chad la swa bhā wa dgos pa de red/ stong ba'i ngang las zhes 'byung khungs kyi tshig sbyar ba de'i steng nas cho ga yongs rdzogs 'gro dgos/ de tsho dka' mod de mi mgo dang thod pa dang dri chen dri chu rta sha khyi sha sogs sems la shar rung sdug bden red/ mtshon don legs par dran dgos/ gzhal yas khang lta bu la khang pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig shar na de dge ba yin don med/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa rdul phra rab re res kyang srid zhi'i rgud pa thams cad sel nus pa'i tshul bsam na dad 144

zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu/pa zhig skyes yong bas ma mtha' dge sems los yin/ 'bras bu lam byed de'i steng nas yong dgos/ lha la yang sku mdog phyag mtshan shar rung sku 'dra mthong ba dang ci khyad/ thugs kyi rnam pa 'char mi thub rung / rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan gsungs pa des lhan pa rgyob/ ma thub na mos pa lam byed la khag zhog de yang ma thub na ma mtha' gson po yin tshul cig dran dgos/ bzlas pa'i skabs su yang sems lhod na skyo shas kyi lcag gis brob/ sun na dad gus kyi spro ba bskyed/ 'di gal che snyam nas ha cang bsgrims na rlung 'khrugs pas lus sems lhod chags pa dgos/ blo sna bsgyur ba la bsgrims dgos pa min gyi/ gzhan zhig gis skad cha bshad na ngu rgyu dang dgod rgyu yong ba de la blo bsgrims mi dgos pa dang 'dra/ blo'i tshod de tsam dgos zhes bla mas gsungs/ gal te yid sun na mdun ri rgyab ri nas lung ba phan tshun rma chu lho byang sogs rim gyis dbus gtsang dang sog yul sogs yul gru rgya chen po ji ltar yod tshul rim gyis bsam blo btang na rlung dwangs pas nges par phan thogs/ gzhan la 'di 'dra bshad gi med kyang khyod rang la 145

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nges par phan thogs snyam nas dmar khrid du zhus pa lags/ srid pa'i sdong bo chen po gcod pa la rno gcig pu yod pas mi chog gista re'i rgyab 'thug po dgos pa ltar/ sngags kyi myur khyad la mdo phyogs kyi rgyab khyog dgos/ de la yang yu ba dang 'dzin mkhan gyi stobs shugs tshang dgos pa ltar cha thams cad nas lam yongs rdzogs dgos pa 'di kho na gal che bas snying gi gces nor yin pas de thugs la zungs/ yi ge bskur na dgon lung nas yong mkhan yod bsam/ kho bo cag kyang sgrub pa nyams len gyi skal ba shin tu phra bas sems gting nas skyo/ tshe lhag zhag gcig las med rung dge sbyor kho na byed bsam ste/ de'i steng du gtan nas mi 'gro/dbyar thog chu spor na bsam yod/ o rang tshur yong thabs 'phral du dka' rgyu red/ rim gyis yong thub na bzang bsam/ dpe cha de tsho yang 'di kar 'phrod na bzang bsam/ gal te bsnyen pa ma thub rung spros pa la mgo mi 'khor ba shin tu gal che/ gzhan don la kha mkho ma thug lo legs na phub ma los yod/ da lta nyin re zhag re bzhin bstan pa rin po che 'grib 'gro bar 'dug pas gzhan la 146

zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu/phan pa shin tu dka'/ ri rtse'i nyi ma mtho gang bo 'di la rang gis 'bad pa lhur mdzod/ des na ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa yang nges par 'jig par 'gyur bas/ ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang brtul ba brtan pos sgrub par mi byed ces gdong la phyag mdzub btsugs nas gsungs pa 'di yang dang yang du dran par bya ba gnad du che lags/ /smras pa/ dkon mchog rgyal ba kun dngos mtshan ldan rje/ /yab sras zung gi zhal gdams mar dkar gyis/ /mdo sngags phan tshun dbyer med bsre ba yi/ /snying gtam thud kyi dum bu 'di dbul lo/ /mchog tu dkar ba'i legs byas zla 'od kyi/ /snye ma gsar pa'i spu long g.yo ldan pa'i/ /dad gus gar du zlos pa'i 'khri shing la/ /don gnyis me tog phon po ci yang 'dzin/ /'jam dbyangs gsung gi 'khor lo chos kyi dung / /snyan dgu'i gdangs su rol pa'i legs bshad la/ /147

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rjes chags ri skyes gzhon nu'i thugs kyi mkha'/ /gdams ngag zla ba'i 'od kyis bsnyems gyur cig /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i gshog zung gis/ /gol shor mtha' spangs dbu ma'i mkha' dbyings su//bde stong gar gyis rtsen pa grub pa'i rigs/ /rgod po bye ba'i tshogs gral bsnyegs gyur cig /na tshod yas phyin rgan mos 'o byed cing / /na tshod mas lhung byis pa'i ngu co theg /ras dkar hrul bos mgo lus mi thums pa'i/ /rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' la lhung gyur cig /yang na chos gos gsum gyis lus mdzes shing / /ngag nas sde snod gsum gyi bzlas brjod brtson/ /shes rgyud ril ba bslab gsum bdud rtsis gtams//drang srong mchog gi brtul zhugs skyong gyur cig /ka ra bi ra'i me tog thod bcings nas/ /tshe lhag ri rtser phyi ma'i rgyal khams kyi/ /148

zhal gdams gdams pa'i lcags kyu/ltad mo blta bar rings pa'i rgan po yang / /dngos mjal gleng mo bcud du sim gyur cig /bdud bzhi khams du byed pa ma he'i zhal/ /bdud sde'i gshed du gdangs pa khro bo'i rgyal/ /dge ldan bka' bsrung dpal mgon rnam gnyis kyis//khyed la g.yel med rtag tu grogs byed shog /ces 'phrin yig gdams pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di nyid phyag tu 'bul rten bla ma mgon po'i man ngag ltar bsgrub khul bgyis pa'i dam tshig mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje'i mdud pa lha rdzas bcas bkra shis 'khyil gyi rang shag nas zla7tshesa'adage bar phul/ /149

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ri bya nga yi skad cha/grub pa'i dbang phyug ngag dbang tshogs gnyis kyis mdzad/ri bya nga yi skad cha/ /dbu nag bod la gtam rgyud/ /rdza spang mtshams su gnas pa'i/ /bya rgyal gong mo'i skad cha/ /ma ki 'gro drug sems can/ /mig 'phrul las la spyod pa/ /ri dwags skom pa'i smig rgyu/ /chu la mthong nas 'tshol yang lto ru phyin rgyu mi 'dug /lus sems sos dal med pa'i/ /sdug bsngal las la spyod kyang / /mthar thug 'bras bu mi 'dug /150

ri bya nga yi skad cha/zo chun khyud mo bzhin du/ /yang yang 'khor ba'i sems can/ /sun pa yid la e shar/ /skyabs mchog bla mas gzigs dang / /thar 'dod blo sna yod na/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /dbyar gsum skyes pa'i me tog /kha dog lnga ru 'tsher ba'i/ /'dab ma ze'u 'bru ldan pa/ /sa gzhi kun tu khyab pa/ /bung ba 'khor zhing glu snyan/ /'bu srin mang bo'i spyod 'gros/ /mthong na yi mug go dka'/ /bar chad glo bur 'byung ba/ /khri gdugs nyi ma'i tshad pa/ /thog dang ser bas brabs na/ /151

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha dog nyams dang shul med/ /lus rten 'dzoms pa'i 'bu tsho/ /chu shul rtswa sbur gseb la/ /ro tshogs thang ma brdal 'dug /'jig rten bya byed de ltar/ /tshig don de la go dka'/ /'dzam gling skyes pa'i pho mo /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /brtsegs pa'i sa mkhar rdo mkhar/ /rmang rdo sra brtan blangs kyang / /shi ba'i nangs par mi 'dug /sgyu ma yin par go dka'/ /kha bad sge'u skar 'dzoms kyang / /snying bo med par go dka'/ /pan 'ja' gser bad brgyan pa/ /kun slong rnam dag sgo nas/ /152

ri bya nga yi skad cha/bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag ma gtogs/ /'jig rten brtsegs pa'i mkhar la/ /snying bo med par go dka'/ /rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal po/ /sgyu ma'i rgyal sar spyod dus/ /kun la phan pa'i rgyal khrims/ /dgung la nyi zla shar bzhin/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyis skyongs mdzod/ /snying gtad thub pa go dka'/ /rgyal srid mtho ba'i mtho rogs/ /blon 'bangs 'khor la rag las/ /blo gtad thub pa'i mi chen/ /blo khog yangs la rtsal ldan/ /blo rgyud chos kha dkar ba/ /sde dpon bde la bkod pa'i/ /de 'dra'i blon 'bangs go dka'/ /153

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang 'dod phug la bcug pa'i/ /g.yo khram can gyi mi ngan/ /kha mkhas phyi bsgyur nang ldag /zhum zhum mang bos zhu ba/ /'phral 'phral bden bden 'dra yang / /de 'dra'i kha la nyan na/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka phung yong / /chos srid bstan la gnod pa'i/ /mi ngan tshar gcod byed pa'i/ /de 'dra'i rgyal blon go dka'/ /bla chen bstan 'gro'i don byed/ /rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i bla ma/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /rang rgyud brtul ba'i bla ma/ /gzhan don mdzad pa yin na/ /gzhi rten mi 'gyur tshul khrims/ /154

ri bya nga yi skad cha/so sor thar ba'i sdom pa/ /rang srog bzhin du srungs dang / /lta spyod rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i srung tshul/ /yid la 'bral med chongs shig /'gro la phan pa'i snying rje/ /phyogs ris med pa'i 'gro don/ /lus ngag yid kyi phan pa/ /dgra gnyen med pa'i spyod par/ /rgyal sras sems dpa'i lag len/ /rtag tu brtse bar skyongs mdzod/ /mtshan ldan gtsug gi nor bu/ /rtag tu spyi bor khur dang / /dbang bzhi'i char rgyun phobs dang / /snang grags lha sngags ye shes/ / rol bar rang ngo sprod pa'i/ /155

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da warang zhal yang yang mjal ba/ /de 'dra'i bla ma go dka'/ /phyi tshul bla ma'i tshul bzung / /zol zog bla gos 'od 'bar/ /rang rgyud ma btul dbang bskur/ /nga che snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ /lha sngags ting 'dzin bor ba'i /gyer dbyangs stong bas ci bya/ /rang 'dod phug la bcug nas/ /ci rag snyam pa'i bla grwa/ /gzugs byad legs po yod kyang / /zhen chags dbang gis spyod 'gros/ /'jig rten phal las lod byung / /bdud kyi phye gtor 'gam pa'i/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo sgrub pa/ /lus ngag yid la go dka'/ /156

ri bya nga yi skad cha/ chos byed ri khrod 'grim pa'i/ /rtogs ldan pho mos go dka'/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /dben gnas ri khrod 'grim dang / /gzhan don phyogs med 'byung sogs/ /gang shar spyod par gshegs dus/ / sdom gsum rgyan gyis rab brgyan/ /bslab gsum ldan pa'i rtogs ldan/ /chags med zhen med 'gro don/ /khyer so gsum gyi mdzad spyod/ /phyogs ris med par skyongs mdzod/ /rang rang blo dang 'tsham pa'i/ /che chung theg pa'i chos bshad/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed pa/ /ris med 'gro la spel mdzod/ /nor dang longs spyod bkur sti/ /157

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/zhen med sgyu mar rol pa'i /de 'dra'i rtogs ldan go dka'/ /bla btsong chos pa'i rkang 'dren/ /zol zog can gyi rdzun 'bag /nyams rtogs med pa'i mig hrig /gtum mo med pa'i ras gzan/ /mnyam bzhag med pa'i sgom thag /bskyed rdzogs med pa'i ral ba /ma mthong mngon shes 'chad dang / /ma mjal lha zhal mjal mdog /ma rtogs nyams rtogs skyes mdog /ma zhig 'khrul zhig yin mdog /spyod pa dus dang ma 'brel /grub chen spyod yul yin mdog /bag med sha chang nag spyod/ /rkang 'dren dmyal ba'i gting rdo/ /158

ri bya nga yi skad cha/de 'dras 'di 'dra go dka'/ /khrims ldan btsun pa rnams kyis/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /'dus sde'i sgrig la 'dug dus/ /sgrig mthun nyam chung gyis dang / /mthar thug btsan sa zin yong / /bla ma chos khrims pa yis /ma mthong ba yis sa ru/ /ngan spyod khram las ma byed/ /rang rgyud legs par btul mdzod/ /go dka' mchog tu bshad pa/ /tshig snyan 'di la nyon dang / /dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong / /rang rgyud brtul ba'i btsun pa/ /rang 'dod med pa'i rgyan cha/ /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spongs dang / /159

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan phan gzhir bcas sgrubs mdzod/ /cho ga chos spyod gyer dbyangs/ /phyag rgya stangs stabs gar 'cham/ /kun slong rnam dag lhod med/ /brtson 'grus bzang bos sbyangs nas/ /mdo sngags rgyud nas gsungs pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhed don/ /byas tshad chos su 'gro dang / /bla ma'i gang gsung bka' sgrubs/ /mched lcam 'dus sder bkur ste/ /dag snang bzang bo yod pa'i/ /de 'dra'i btsun pa go dka'/ /ngan spyod khram las byed pa'i/ /bstan pa'i chom rkun phung byed//rang mtshang ngan pa go dka'/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /160

ri bya nga yi skad cha/'dus pa'i gral du 'dug skabs/ /chos spyod cho ga bor nas/ /long gtam bag med las spyod/ /phyag rgya gar stabs bor nas/ /dge bskos ma mthong sa ru/ /go cha mtshon la byi dor/ /rdzas dang mda' cha yang sgrub/ /'dus sde bla mar lkog kha/ /mched dang bla grwa'i bar du/ /dbyen kha mang bos dkrug dang / /dbang dang sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor/ /sgron me gcig la lta zhing / /srog gis bsdus pa'i mched la/ /bsam sbyor ngan pas sdang ba/ /dge 'dun spyi yi nor la/ /hab 'thob byed dang tshong 'phrog /161

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/g.yo sgyu can gyi pan 'khreb/ /'chi ba snying nas e go /chags zhen skye bo las lod/ /chags spyod ngan dgu can gyi/ /dge 'dun dkrug pa'i gsor rdo/ /mi chen blon 'bangs rnams kyi/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /mi chen g.yo sgyu med pa/ /rang 'dod chung ba'i gyad blon/ / gzhan phan sgrub pa'i dpa' bo/ /rgyal khrims srung ba'i so pa/ /mi chos lha chos zung 'brel/ /de 'dra'i blon 'bangs go dka'/ /rgyal srid chos kyis skyong ba'i/ /blon 'bangs bzang bo 'di ltar/ /rang rgyud mda' bas drang ba/ /162

ri bya nga yi skad cha/nor la 'dod pa chung ba/ /kha mchu rtsod pa thug dang / /rgyal la zhu ba byung dus/ /rang gzhan khyad par ma byed/ /rgod zhan shugs la ma bskur/ /nor zas phag nas ma za/ /'di phyi gzhig pa byed dang / /zhu ba drang bor phul ba'i/ /de 'dra'i mgron gnyer go dka'/ /mi ngan phal gyi spyod pa/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /nyam chung rgod po'i bde sdug / drang bor zhu ba mi 'bul/ /rang phyogs rgyal dang gzhan pham/ /phugs su bcug pa'i 'gong bo/ /yang na nor rdzas lkog zan/ /163

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ka cha ci 'dod spyad nas/ /bden rdzun go log zhu ba'i/ /bla btsong drag drag 'dod pa/ /sde dpon mgo ske 'byed pa'i/ /g.yo can rdzun rkyal kha mkhas/ /sde dpon phung ba'i mi ngan/ /go ba med pa'i glang rgan/ /'di phyi med pa'i sdig rgan/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo de 'dras/ /'di 'dra'i go ba go dka'/ /stag shar rnams kyis go dka'/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /drin chen byas pa'i pha ma/ /snying dang mig bzhin btsa' dgos/ /drin lan byams pas skyongs dang / /rang la phan pa'i kha ta/ /164

ri bya nga yi skad cha/byams dang gyong bos ci smras/ /kha ta de la nyon dang / /mi bslu ba la thag chod/ /bkur snyi bzang bo byas pas snyan grags legs po 'thob yong / /rang rgyus med pa'i mi de'i/ /bzang bzang yag yag mthong yang / /blo gtad snying gtam ma snga/ /nye ya shag pos bslus pa/ /gtam rgyud mang bo e go /blo gtad med pa'i mi de/ /bzang bzang mang bo yin mdog /blo snying gtad pa'i tshig 'dra/ /bya byed sna tshogs byed pa/ /'phral 'phral bzang bzang 'dra yang / /rang rgyud mi la ma bskur/ /165

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/snga phyi ci yong ma bsam/ /glo bur bya byed ma snga/ /spun zla chung ma bu tsha/ /mdza' bshes rtag tu 'grogs la/ /mthun 'jug bkur sti rem tsam/ /thang lhod med par bgyid dgos/ /rang mtshang rang gis brtag dgos/ /mi la khrel kha ma che/ /mtho dman med pa kun la/ /ngo lkog med pa'i bya spyod/ /rang rgyud drang ba mchog gces/ /rang rtsis chung zhing gzhan phan//lhag bsam bzang bo'i stag shar/ /kun gyi gtso bor 'gyur yong / /de 'dra spyod pa'i mi mchog /dus kyi dbang gis go dka'/ /166

ri bya nga yi skad cha/go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /go dka' ngan pa'i rjes btul/ /mi ngan tha ma'i spyod pa/ /drin chen pha ma rgas rtsa/ /drin lan ngan 'jal btang nas/ /zas gos tha ma ster dang / /gyong tshig rdeg rdung mang bos /ar gtad yid pham byed pa'i/ /khrel med dmyal ba'i gting rdo/ /spun zla bu tsha mi dum/ /ngo shag lkog lab che ba/ /gsar 'grogs che zhing rdzun rkyal/ /phan sems kha tas bskyangs la/ /go log dgra ru lta ba/ /bzang bo'i kha la mi nyan/ /g.yo can rdzun rkyal ngan pa/ /167

da legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa rang rgyud bslu ba'i mgo skor/ /bzang bzang mang bo smra dus/ /ha go med pa'i glang rgan/ /gsang gtam ngom mtshang yod tshad/ /rang rgyud dgra la bskur nas/ /rang gzhan phung ba'i mi ngan/ /gzhig long med pa'i bya spyod/ /pho sgo med pa'i tshad 'dod/ /ci yang mi shes shag smra/ /rang phung rang sgrub byed pa'i/ /mi ngan de 'dras go dka'/ /go dka' pi wang rgyun thag /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /na chung rnams kyis go dka'/ /rang khyim go la sdod dus/ /pha mar bkur snyi bzang bo/ /168

ri bya nga yi skad cha/drin lan 'jal ba'i bu mo/ /ming bo spun zla rnams la/ /byams brtse'i gshis rgyud bzang ba/ /gzhan gyi chung mar 'gro dus/ /rang 'dod g.yo khram med pa'i/ /rgan rgon bza' mi nyam chung / /bkur snyi byams pas skyong mkhan/ /spun zla che chung med la/ /mi gcig 'dra ba'i rtsis 'jog /gzhan g.yem chung zhing gsang thub/ /nor gsog mkhas shing mdzangs ldan/ /bzang ngan shes pa'i go ba/ /gnyen 'dun byams pas skyong mkhas/ /smra nyung chos la dkar ba/ /khyi sprang slong mo kun la/ /sbyin btang snying rje'i rtsal ldan/ /169

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de 'dra'i na chung go dka'/ /go dka' ngan dgu'i go dka'/ /go dka' 'di la nyon dang / /na chung ngan pa'i spyod 'gros/ /pha mar drin lan mi 'jal/ /ming bo bza' mi rnams la/ /'khon 'dzing lkog lab che ba/ /khyo dad che zhing rdzun rkyal/ /gsar 'grogs skyen zhing khrel med/ /rang lus mi thub nes khur/ /gzhan gyi chung mar song na/ /dang po gsar 'grogs bzang bzang / /de nas ngan mtshang mngon yong / /rgan rgon pha ma nyam chung / /rdeg rdung byed dang zas skal/ /gcod cing ngan dgu byed dang / /170

ri bya nga yi skad cha/spun zla dbyen dang bza' dkrug /ngan dgu tshang ba'i bdud mo/ /phyi tshul legs kyang nang ngan/ /dug rkyal 'dra ba'i bud med/ /gang la lus ngag 'grogs la/ /phan pa med pa'i gnod skyel/ /gsang mi thub cing mig ser/ /bzang lan ngan 'jal rkun byed/ /bsam sbyor nag cing dbyen che/ /nag spyod sdig la dga' ba/ /chos la mi gus 'bar sha /snying rje med cing g.yo khram/ /sprang long khyi sprang rnams la/ /rdeg rdung byed dang ngan spyod/ /ngan dgu thams cad tshang ba'i/ /nag mo de 'dras go dka'/ /171

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da bo/ dka' 'di la nyon dang / /kun gyis go rgyu'i go dka'/ /'jig rten 'di na sdod dus / /zas gos longs spyod cha rkyen/ /sngon gyi las 'bras dbang gis/ /longs spyod gang 'dzoms ma gtogs/ /kun slong kho nas ma 'khrug /bshas khe sdig las ma che/ /ci yod chog shes che dgos/ /zhar byung dge ba sgrub thabs/ /dka' tshegs med pa'i tshogs bsags/ /nangs nub brgya phyag phul dang / /dkon mchog dgyes pa'i mchod pa/ /spos dang mar me yon chab/ /rtag tu 'bul zhing brtson 'grus/ /thang lhod med par rem dgos/ /172

ri bya nga yi skad cha/gangs can ljongs kyi yi dam/ /lha gcig sngags gcig kho nas/ /ngan song skye sgo gcod pa'i/ /yi ge drug ma sgrongs dang / /'jig rten 'di na skyes pa'i/ /mtho dman med pa'i pho mo/ /skad cig yad yud tsam las/ /mi rtag 'chi la nye 'gro/ /sdug gsog ser snas bcings pa'i//nor rdzas rtswa kha'i zil ba /gcig kyang 'khyer dbang med do/ /longs spyod bza' mi gnyen 'dun/ /mdang gsum rmi lam bzhin du/ /lus sems bral dus so sor/ /gcig pur 'gro ba e go /tshe 'dir dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / /173

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chags sdang dbang gis spyod tshad/ /rang phung rang brlags e go /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster mkhan/ /mtshan ldan rje btsun bla mas/ /thar ba thob pa'i them skas/ /ngan song chu bo brgal ba'i/ /gru zam lta bu'i chos bshad/ /kun la go dka' gsung dus/ /rna ba'i dbang bos nyan dgos/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas lag bcang / /mtshan ldan bla mas gsungs pa'i/ /rang sems ngo bo skyongs dang / /bzang ngan bde sdug shar mkhan/ /gang shar ngang du bltas pas/ /gsal stong brjod med 'dug pa/ /gnas pa kho nar e go /174

ri bya nga yi skad cha/tshogs drug gang gi sgo nas/ /gzhan du 'gyu nas 'phros sar/ /'gyu ba yin par e go /de dag so sor dbye mkhan/ /rig pa yin par e go /bzang ngan bde sdug thams cad/ /rtsa ba bcad na rang sems /chos sku yin par e go /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog tshogs/ /spang blang med par rang grol/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgongs pa/ /rang chas yin par e go /rang lus phung khams skye mched/ /zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i/ /sku dang zhing khams dbyer med/ /rang la yod pa e go /175

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan nas 'tshol rgyu med pa'i/ /snang srid chos sku'i rol pa/ /spang blang med par skyong dgos/ /bden gnyis lam du 'khyer ba'i/ /rten 'brel bslu med go dgos/ /rim gnyis zab mor sbyangs pas/ /thams cad sangs rgyas 'grub par/ /'gro ba kun gyis e go /ma rtogs 'gro la snying rje/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i/ /bsngo smon dge la 'bungs mdzod/ /nga rang ri bya gong mos/ /mang bo bshad la mi khom/ /mdor bsdus de tsho e go /mi chos lha chos sgrub thabs/ /rang sems gsal ba'i ngogs la/ /176
me long gzugs brnyan bzhin du/ /rten 'byung dbang du shar tshad/ /yi ge'i lam du bkod pa/ /kun la dge bar gyur cig / maṅgalo/

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yid la bsam pa'i don tshig lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyungs bzhugs so/ /kerti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtshos mdzad/dpal dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus/ /don gcig bsdus drin can bla ma dang / /dbyer med pa rje btsun blo bzang grags/ /mgon de yi zhabs rdul gtsug gis mchod/ /dus thog med zhig nas rang sems 'di/ /dgra nyon mongs gdon gyis bslus pa'i mthus/ /las sna tshogs rlung gis rab bskyod pas/ /gnas mtha' med sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'khyams/ /dus da lta chos ldan rten bzang thob/ /178

yid la bsam pa'i don tshig lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs/chos 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying po dang / /de tshul bzhin 'doms pa'i bshes dang mjal/ /chos sgrub pa'i grogs dang mthun rkyen 'dzom/ /dus 'di 'drar rang gi lus ngag yid/ /nyin mtshan du dge la mi gzhol bar/ /ban bun gyi 'di snang bya ba'i ngang / /don med du 'da' ba kye ma blun/ /spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing / /sgos 'khor pa srin mo'i grong khyer 'dir/ /gnas lus dang longs spyod mdza' bshes sogs/ /blo thub pa'i nges pa cang ma mchis/ /dus snyigs ma'i tshe thung dgun nyi 'dra/ /'ar 'ur gyis gar song cha med thal/ /glo bur du skyes chen 'degs pa'i tshe /blo bde ba'i gdengs tshad ci 'dug soms/ /rje bka' drin mnyam med gang de yis/ /179

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bka' mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel bcas pa kun/ /don dam pa'i mchog tu ngo sprod pa'i/ /bstan 'di dang mjalabyu ba srid mtha' tsam/ /tshe 'di yi bya ba ci byas sla/ /dus gtan gyi skyid sdug 'dam kha byung / /bdag sgo gsum spyod pa ci 'dra zhes/ /rgud rtog dpyod byi dor byed re ran/ /tshul de ltar dran shes bag yod kyis/ /sdom gsum gyi bcas mtshams gces par srungs/ / rgyud sdig ltung dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir/ /stobs bzhi yi bshags bsdams 'bad par 'tshal/ /yongs mdo rgyud gzhung lugs chen mo kun/ /lung bshad chos tsam du mi 'dzin par/ /blo'i nus pa ci yod thos bsam gyis/ /lam nyams su len tshul shes par mdzod/ /zab rgyas kyi gsung rab dgongs don kun/ /180

yid la bsam pa'i don tshig lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs/nyams len gyi rim par dril ba'i gzhung / /med mi rung gdams ngag mthar thug de/ /chos byang chub lam gyi rim pa yin/ /dpal gsang chen rgyud sde'i snying po'i bcud/ /rje grub dbang yongs kyi gshegs shul lam/ /mchog tshe gcig ster ba'i nye lam de/ /lam bskyed rdzogs rim pa'i man ngag yin/ /don de 'dra'i gnad don nges byas nas/ /nges 'byung dang byang sems yang dag lta/ /lam rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor la/ /rgyud bag chags brtan po thebs par mdzod/ /lar gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rang rang gi /lugs grub mtha' 'cha' ba mang mod kyi/ /phyogs lhung gi rab rib dang bral ba'i/ /blo gzu bo'i mig gis brtags pa na/ /lugs gzhan gyi legs cha kun 'dus shing / /181

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chos mdo sngags lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad/ /rje rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug de/ /pha bla ma'i ring lugs 'di kho na/ /tshul 'di yang rang lta mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /phyogs zhen gyis bsngags pa ma lags te/ /bka' dgongs 'grel tshad ma dpang bzhag nas/ /lung rigs kyi srang la gzhal na shes/ /don des na 'khrul bral lugs bzang 'dir/ /blo yid gnyis med par bsten mdzod la/ /rang thos bsam bshad sgrub ci nus dang / /gzhan tshul der thabs kyis bkri bar mdzod/ /tshul de 'dra'i rang gzhan don 'grub pa'i/ /rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba bla ma de/ /dus 'bral med bsgom nas gsol 'debs shing / /da srog la babs kyang bka' bzhin sgrubs/ /pha bka' drin 'khor med blo bzang grags/ /182

yid la bsam pa'i don tshig lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs/bu skal dman snyigs ma'i mtshor bying ba/ /zhing chos kyis mtho ba'i pho brang nas/ /thugs brtse ba'i spyan gyis mi gzigs sam/ /rje'i bzhed srol dri med lam bzang po/ /sgrub 'dod pa'i rjes 'jug bdag cag rnams/ /dpal gsang gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi yis/ /dus rtag tu skyongs shig drin can rje/ /mgon khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyud las nyon sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /lam thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /nyams rtogs pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'bangs bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis/ /las bya ba gang brtsams dus rtag tu/ /bstan 'gro ba yongs la phan pa ru/ /rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig bla ma lha/ /dus ma 'ongs tshe rabs thams cad du/ /183

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rje bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmo dang / /skad cig kyang mi 'bral sgo gsum gyis/ /thugs sems pa 'ba' zhig sgrub par shog /chos 'khrul bral bstan pa'i snying po 'di/ /lus srog la mi lta phyogs kun tu/ /bshad sgrub kyis 'dzin cing spel nus pa'i/ /mthu snying stobs ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ /blo gzungs spobs rnam 'byed shes rab sogs/ /sa lam gyi yon tan rtsal rdzogs nas/ /ma 'gro ba'i don chen sgrub pa la/ /byams 'jam dbyangs kun bzang lta bur shog /dus snyigs ma'i sems can ma lus pa/ /skyabs mchog gsum gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin/ /las rnam dkar phyogs la sems mthun pas/ /'phral yun gyi legs tshogs gong 'phel shog /mgon bstan 'dzin mtha' dag zhabs pad brtan/ /184

yid la bsam pa'i don tshig lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs/grogs rig grol smra bas sa steng khyab/ /chos bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma shar/ /yongs 'jig rten shis pas khyab gyur cig /ces yid la bsam pa'i don tshig gi lam du mtshon pa'i bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs 'di ni/ gus slob chos bzhin spyod pa'i gnas brtan blo bzang dge 'dun nas bskul ngor/ 7'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i/ 7btsun gzugs blo bzang 'phrin las kyis dben pa'i nags khrod bde chen dga' tshal du bris pa dza yarnyu/ /185

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslab bya skyon mtshang zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman gyi thur ma bzhugs so/ /rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad/bskal bzang rnam 'dren kun gyi ye shes kyi rang gzugs/ /thub bstan snying po mdo sngags zung 'jug gi lam bzang / /'doms mdzad dbang phyug brgyad ldan ḍāki yi gtso mo/ /rgyal yum mkha' spyod dbang mo'i thugs rje yis skyongs shig /ngan bu'i rnam rtog 'phro rgod lang shor du song bas/ /yid la gya gyu'i ri mo chu gnyer ltar dkrigs pas/ /gang shar mu cor smra ba'i byung rgyal gyi rgyang glu/ /grogs med gcig pur 'khod pa'i skyo rog tu len no/ /bong rdog gser du snang bas slob ma yi ngag gis/ /skyon mtshang gnad la 'bab pa'i bslab bya zhig dgos zer/ /gdong la mdzub mo btsugs te rang rgyud la brtag na/ /186

bslab bya skyon mtshang zug rngu 'byin pa'i sman gyi thur ma/gzhan skyon sel bar rang mtshang rig pa zhig dgos gda'/ /na tshod phra mo'i dus nas chos sgo ru tshud kyang / /bsam rgyu nyon mongs bya rgyu sdig bsog las med pas/ /yid kyi dgu la'ang chos shig ma dran pas lan 'dug /da ni ngan goms blo sna e 'gyur rang blta'o/ /chos kyi rtsa ba bsam pa'i bzang ngan du gsung na/ /bya ba kun la brtag dpyad cung zad re byas te/ /mtha' dag min na'ang re gnyis chos phyogs su 'gro ba/ /byung na legs te de yi thag nye ru mi sleb/ /ma shi tshun gyi 'dod pa don gnyer 'di bor te/ /phyi ma'i ngan 'gro ldog pa'i thabs tshul tsam nus kyang / /pho skyes tshod du 'dug mod de tsam yang dka' na/ /thar pa'i lam sne zin pa'i re ba ni med do/ /nyon mongs gong bu sdig pa'i khres po cher 'dug cing / /dkor zan rkyal ba ltung ba'i sgye ral tu mchis pa/ /chos brgyad khol bo mdo med khram pa mkhan bdag ni/ /187

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang gzhan phung byed ltas ngan 'ug pa kho yin 'dug /dngos po khab skud tshun la shi spar rang 'tham ste/ /ster ba lta ci rang gis spyod par yang mi bra/ /'dod yon kun la zhen pa a 'thas su song bas /phyi phyir gdung nas sems bde'i go skabs kyang mi 'dug /snying la gzan pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyis sdig bsags/ /rdzun phra tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da'/ /sems rgyud chags sdang log lta gti mug gis 'tshos kyang / /col chung glen pa bdag gis go ba zhig ma byung / /ko long dam zhing 'khon 'dzin che ba 'di skyon che/ /mi dgos dgu dgos mkho nyams mang ba 'di skyon che/ /long gtam dga' zhing smra ba mang ba 'di skyon che/ /skyon du mthong bas mi chog spang ba zhig dgos gda'/ /g.yo 'phrul sna tshogs thabs kyis gzhan nor la 'phrog cing / /spyod ngan phag tu byas shing btsun btsun ltar byas nas/ /gzhan gyi mig 'drid chos pa yin khul 'dis mi chog /188

bslab bya skyon mtshang zug rtsa 'byin pa'i sman gyi thur ma/rang sems rang gi dpang bo thub pa zhig dgos so/ /srid la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i nges 'byung rang dka' yang / /khas 'che tsam gyis blang ba'i rang rgyud kyi tshul khrims/ /nyes spyod che phra kun las ldog pa zhig dgos kyi/ /nag chang spang ba gcig pus chog tshod du mi gda'/ /deng dus kha shos sna sho 'phya ba ltar min par/ /ma mtha' 'ang rtsa bzhi'i bsrung mtshams dag po zhig byas te/ /bslab bya byed dang zhu mkhan su byung gi ngos nas/ /legs srung bstan pa'i gzhi rtsa tshugs pa zhig bya'o/ /bla ma sangs rgyas mthong ba'i dad gus shig dgos kyi/ /phyogs lhung rmongs zhen gcig pus chog tshod du mi gda'/ /chos mdzad yongs kyi slob 'dre chags sdang du gsung bas/ /rang blo gzu bas kun la dag snang rang sbyong ngo / /mdo sngags kun la thos pa phyogs med cig dgos kyang / /tshe ni yun thung tha snyad gtugs pa rang med pas/ /nyams len gnad kyi don po 'chug med cig btsal te/ /189

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshe mjug sgrub la gzhol ba e yong zhig lta'o/ /gzhan gyi ngo srung rnyed pa cung zad re'i phyir du/ /mi tshe sdig dad sdug la bkol ba 'di bor te/ /dpe bltas phyag mchod kha 'don rgya chen rang min kyang / /kha rog bsdad pas nges par chog pa zhig byed do/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med pa de legs kyang / /kha bshad tsam gyis gzhan rgyud 'thul ba zhig mi 'ong / /des na rang rgyud 'dul ba'i nyams len gyi snying po/ /lto gos blos btang phyi ma'i mno bsam rang sems so/ /bka' pod lnga dang rgyud sde rnam bzhi yi dgongs don/ /shes par rlom ste phyi ma'i ngan song gi sgrub thabs/ /'gran 'dod sems kyis snga ma'i 'dra zhus kyi gzhung rtsom/ /mkho res med pas sos bde ku yangs su 'dug go /ltas ngan dang po rang mthong nga rgyal gyis khengs pas/ /shes rgyud sreg byed zhe sdang me char gyi rtsod pa/ /rang skyon ris bor gzhan gyi rtsom skyon tshun rtog pa'i/ / 190

bslab bya skyon mtshang zug ju 'byin pa'i sman gyi thur ma/dpe ltos la sogs mkho med ci dga' ru 'jog go /theg mchog lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed du 'dug kyang / /phyi ma'i mno bsam med par bskyed thabs rang med pas/ /smon lam tshun gyis bag chags thebs nges shig byas te/ /kun la bsam ngan mi 'chang kha rog tu 'dug go /thub bstan yang snying gsang chen lam bzang rang yin yang / /ji bzhin nyams su len pa'i kha thabs rang mi 'dug /'on kyang dad pas cho ga dag po re bton te/ /smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyor nan tan zhig byed ya/ /lus ngag byed spyod sems kyi 'khyer so kun ltos na/ /phyi ma'i 'gro sa ngan song kho na las ma 'das/ /deng nas bzung ste 'khor pa ma stong gi bar du/ /skyid sdug ci byung bla ma dkon mchog rang mkhyen no/ /rang sems dpang bor bzhag ste bsam blo rang btang na/ /kho chad yid mug cig las rnam kun tu mi 'dug /de lta na'ang bya thabs thams cad dang bral nas/ /191

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mchi mas brnangs bzhin kha rog sdod pa las ci bya/ /sdig ltung sbyangs na bdag ste ngan goms la zhen pas/ /'gyod sdom ji bzhin ma byung des kyang rang mi tshim/ /dge la 'bad pas chog ste 'di snang gi 'khri bas/ /slad pa phyis las mi tshor des kyang bdag skyo'o/ /ci drag ci drag bla ma dkon mchog rang mkhyen cig /rgyal yum rnal 'byor dbang mo'i thugs rje yis skyongs shig /mtha' med ngan song 'khor pa'i btson dong las sgrol cig /bde chen thar pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa zhig khyed mkhyen/ /nyams thag 'gro rnams khyod kyi thugs rje yi phyag gis/ /myur bar bzung ste bde chen mkha' spyod du 'khrid cing / /che zab gsang ba rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi lam las /mi gnas zhi ba mchog gi go 'phang la 'god mdzod/ /'di ni kun spang gcod kyi rnal 'byor pa chos 'dzin rgya mtshos snying la phan pa'i bslab bya dgos zhes bskul bar brten/ 7gyi na pa 'jigs med 'phrin las rgya mtshos rang gi byed spyod la ma mgu bas skyon bstan du chu stod zla 192
/nyam kun gyi skyon mtshang zug rngu 'byin pa'i

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba bzhugs so/ /rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad/kun gsal me long mnga' ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /yid 'phrog 'od zer stong gi dra ba can/ /blo bzang rgyal ba smra ba'i seṅge'i sku/ /gtsug na nor bu'i dge legs 'dzin gyur cig /dad gsum gser gyi ba gam yangs po nas/ /dbang phyug rgyal po rgyal ba'i rjes phyogs pa/ /gang gis blang dang dor bya'i rim pa la/ /gsal byed yi ge'i phreng ba dgos so lo/ /mang du thos pa'i ri rab dpangs mtho zhing / /rnam par dpyod pa'i rgya mtsho gting zab la /nang gi zla zer bsil ba'i rtser 'dzegs pas/ /shas tsam spel na snyam pa'i rtog pa 'gyu/ /194

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/phra zhib shes rab padma'i mig yangs shing / /brtag thub don gnyer 'dab ma 'bum bkra ba/ /gzur gnas ya rabs dam pa'i rigs mchis na/ /'di la rna ba'i bu ga gtod par 'os /rang re'i don du gau tai stobs bcu pa/ /dbyig gi thig ler bltams nas ring zhig 'das/ /de lta mod kyi de yi bdud rtsi'i 'phrin/ /lag tu thogs pa'i drang srong zam ma chad/ /gang na bkra shis rgyu ba'i sa phyogs der/ /sna nag ma yang 'jug pa gshis lags te/ /dam pa'i bka' la dam pa ma yin pas/ /kun nas 'gongs pa'i chu gnyer 'dzad pa med/ /de phyir 'khor pa srin mo'i grong khyer du/ /chags sdang gdon gyis gzir ba'i zlos gar la/ /sdig sdug gtam ngan mes po'i blo yis kyang / /gzhal dka'i tshor ba mi bzad nyams su bstar/ /195

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'jig rten 'di na phal ba dang / /dam pa'i skye bo rnam pa gnyis/ /lus ngag yid kyi khyad par las/ /mkhas pa'i gzigs ngor ma 'dres gsal/ /'dzem bag khrel dang ngo tsha'i gos/ /ral nas gyon du ma mchis par/ /gcer bur rgyu ba'i rnam thar la/ /rgyan gyi dwangs mar rlom pa mang / /bdag la smod pa gzhan yod na/ /bstod pas bdag dga' ci zhig ces/ /de nyid rig pas gdams pa yang / /'dod gdung gseg ma'i 'dam du 'khyer/ /gces par bskyangs pa'i pha ma dang / /drin gyis che ba'i slob dpon la'ang / /ngan g.yo'i sbyor ba lhur len zhing / /zhe gcod tsher ma yang yang gzugs/ /196

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/nang na rnam par dkar ba'i sems/ /til gyi cha yang ma dmigs la/ /bcos ma'i phreng bas tshe skyel ba/ /de dag mi ru bgrang ba mtshang / /nyam thag mthong na zas su 'dzin/ /stobs ldan mthong na thog tu 'char/ /rngon rdzas mthong na gnyid yal ba/ /gcan gzan mo dang mi nye 'am/ /phyi ma'i yul gyi ltad mo la/ /mig gi 'jug pa kun brtul nas/ /'di na rang gces 'ba' zhig gis/ /btsan lugs skyong ba kye ma hud/ /yid la rmongs pa'i mun pa nag /lce la sbrang rtsi'i rdzing bu 'khyil/ /dud nas 'gro ba mtho ba'i khrir/ /'phrul gyis 'dzeg pa lnga bdo'i rtags/ /197

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nyi ma 'od zer stong ldan nub/ /smag gi dkyil 'khor kun nas rdzogs/ /nyin mo long ba hūṃ sgra 'byin/ /rtog zhib yod dam mdzangs pa'i bu/ /rang la lta ba'i ngo tsha med/ /gzhan la lta ba'i khrel bag med/ /gnad la gtugs pa'i snying stobs med/ /med gsum tshang ba 'di re brjid/ /kha nas 'drer yang zol 'dzum spro/ /lkog tu lha la'ang skyon gyis 'dogs/ /log lam 'gal 'du'i khram ris can/ /de la ci rung brtag par rigs/ /gzhan la mkhas kyang rang la blun/ /bcol ba bor te ma bcol byed/ /don chen dor nas don chung 'thu/ /chang gis ma bed bzi bo lags/ /198

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/bskos pa'i las la phyi bshol byed/ /long gtam kha lo med par zlo/ /zas dang gnyid kyi go yangs pa/ /skye bo'i khrod na ya re nga / /bri ba'i las la lag rtsal chung / /'gro ba'i las la rkang rtsal chung / /bsam pa'i las la blo rtsal chung / /'di dag 'dod pa'i phyogs dang ring / /rgya mcho re sbal ba khrag can gyis/ /srog chags bye ba dung phyur brlag /ma rabs gcig gi byed 'dzol las /'jig rten ma lus phung la 'debs/ /snag tsha'i thigs pa phra mo yis/ /gos dkar rin thang bral ba nongs/ /lang tsho mtshar rgu'i mdzes ma yang / /shes rig 'od snang nub pas 'phongs /199

lesas bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phyi yi lus dang nang gi blo/ /mkhas rnams phyi ma gtso bor 'dzin/ /glang chen sha yi ri bo yang / /lcags kyu chung ngus btul la gzhigs/ /gzhan la skyon gyi khrag char 'bebs/ /rang la shog bu'i rgyal mtshan sgrig /don la bden rdzun mi dpyod par/ /gsob la g.yeng bas nor 'dzin dkrigs/ /dris na ne tso'i ca co zlo/ /yang na mi smra sa rdo'i dpe/ /yang na bye ma'i ri bo brtsegs/ /'di 'dra 'di yang dpyad pa'i rigs/ /yang yang mi sems mi dpyod pas/ /mang mang 'khrul ba cis mi 'os/ /zab zab mkhyen pa'i nga snyam can/ /che che drag drag ma mchis sam/ /200

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/gcig na rig pa'i rang bzhin rtul/ /gnyis na som nyis snying ga gang / /gsum na 'doms pa'i glegs bam ral/ /bzhi na dad 'dun zhan pas lan/ /lnga bar ma son de srid du/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi bka'/ /bdun phrag rgya yis btab pa'i don/ /brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mdzod bzhin srungs/ /phal ba'i mtshan nyid gzhan lta ci/ /phal ba'i mthong thos rdzogs par yang /phal ba'i ngag gis ga la lang / /phal ba'i skyon gyis ma gos gal/ /da lta'i rgya bod zhi chings dang / /da srol gang thung gang len la'ang / /da nas 'bad 'bungs mi lhod par/ /da ni nga 'o'i bar du sbyongs/ /201

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rmongs blo dog po'i rong nas gang du yang / /bgrod par dka' la sleb pa'i rlabs chung bas/ /'dzin ma'i rgya dang nam mkha'i mthongs yangs por/ /nang gi glog 'phrul zla dang bral bar gyis/ /yang gcig lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /byams brtse'i grib bsil snum po 'khor ba'i sprin/ /zhi ba'i char rgyun gser gyi snying po can/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bka' lung 'di ltar yod/ /'gro ba'i gru chen sgrub la mi khom pa'i/ /'gal rkyen kun dang bral phyir dal ba zhes/ /ming gi cod pan mes pos sgron pa 'dir/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i rtse mo gcig tu sgril/ /'tsho ba spel ba'i thabs kyi khyad par la/ /kun nas brtags dang rtsol ba skyed pa dang / /bgo ba'i gos dang spyod pa ji ltar yang / /tshe 'di'i gang zag nyid du mkhas la grags/ /202

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/mi pham rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med kyis/ /de la'ang gsal ba'i bye ba du ma zhig /rnam par dkar ba'i lam dang gcig shos su/ /kun mkhyen dgyes pa'i rol mor bsgrags pa thos/ /dal 'byor rnyed par dka' la don che ba/ /nges legs nam mkha'i mthongs yangs bde blag tu/ /gcod pa'i gshog rlabs zla dang bral bas yin/ /'dod 'jo'i nor las lhag par gsungs pa'ang de/ /rlung gi dkyil na gnas pa'i mar me bzhin/ /myur bar shi na ci zhig bgyid snyam du/ /'jigs shing skrag pa'i brel 'tshub mi zad pas/ /mi lus don yod bya ba 'dun ma'i phul/ / bzod dka' ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar 'khrid pa'i lam/ /bsod nams ma yin mi dge 'di lags pas/ /stobs rtsal spungs nas gnyen po'i mdung thogs te/ /'bur 'joms byed pa dpa' bo'i yang rtse yin/ /203

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sngon nas rang dbang med par yang dang yang / /'khor par 'khor ba'i rtsa ba rmongs pa ste/ / dam pa'i mgon dang mkhas pa'i gsung rab la/ /thos pa'i sgron me tshol ba gnad kyi 'gangs/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dug shing ma gsil na/ /bsam bzang tshul 'chos tsam gyis ga la grol/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i 'gag 'dir rtsol ba skyed/ /rgya bod mdo sngags grub mtha'i srol mang po/ /bstan pa'i sa chen 'di na grags mod kyi/ /lta ba nor na thar ba'i gnas med pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug yin/ /rang rang sa nas bden bden 'thad 'thad du/ /kha brgya lce stong zab zab rdzig rdzig gi /sgros shom ji 'dra bsgrigs kyang sbrul gyi mdud/ /ma bkrol ngang gis lhod par 'gyur ba yin/ /204

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/byis pa ri mo'i me la 'jigs lags te/ /'bri byed bzo bo'i snying bum ga la g.yo/ /paṇa grub bye bas bzhed pa'i rtse mo ste/ / lung dang rigs pa'i glog 'od bkram na shes/ /ngu ba'i kha la bltas na ngu bro zhing / /rgod pa'i kha la bltas na rgod bro ba'i/ /chags sdang rmongs pa'i dar gyi cod pan dag /ci dgar sbur bar mdzod ces brtse bas bskul/ /tshul khrims 'chal bas gsang sngags mi 'grub par/ /shākya'i rgyal pos yang nas yang du gsungs/ /dug gsum 'bar ba'i sangs rgyas rlon pa zhig /skal ldan las 'phro can la snang ba mtshar/ /mdo sngags gang gi theg pas bgrod na yang / /dam sdom dgos par gsar rnying gnyis ka mthun/ /gnang bkag phra mo 'byed pa'i blo yang yod/ /rmongs pa pho tshod ma thal tshugs por bzhugs/ /205

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kha bo gzhan la sdang ba ma lags te/ /phra zhib shes rab rgya mtsho 'phyur ba'i gshis/ /mi shes shes rdzu ma grub grub mdog dang / /nag chang du bas gzir ba'i kha 'chal min/ / gdams pa'i snying po bsdus na 'di lta ste/ /srog gcod ma byin len dang log par g.yem/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub kyal ba'i ngag /brnab sems gnod sems log lta spong la 'bungs/ /de las log par lta ba cung dka' yang / /mchog gsum las 'bras 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ /yod ces zhe nas smros dang de yis chog /zhib par dam pa'i mdun nas thos pa mdzod/ /rgyun du ngag bcad zab mo'i man ngag ste/ /rnam dag gzhung lugs zhal 'don mdzad na'ang legs/ /re zhig bcu bo mngon du ldang mi nus/ /log bshad mi bklag de yis phongs par 'gyur/ /206

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/gtong bas lag mdzes dad pas snying gang zhing / /spyod pas rigs rus yon tan me tog gis/ /chos dang srid kyi rje bo gnyis bkur na/ /ya rabs dam pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa lags/ /de ltar lcang can rigs las son pa'i sras/ /rwa dze shwa ra rig pa'i longs spyod can/ /mgu ba skyed byed padma dkar po'i ljon/ /zab gsal shes rab rgya mtsho'i ngogs nas 'khrungs/ /de yi dge ba rgyal ba'i byin/ /'gro ba'i snying la zhugs pa las/ /phal dang dam pa legs rtogs pa'i/ /tshad ma 'phel na ci ma rung / /stobs kyi 'khor bsgyur tse tung che/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yab sras zung / /rnam gsum zhabs kyi 'khor lo'i rdul/ /rtag brtan nor bu'i thig ler bzhugs/ /207

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor du/ /nad mtshon mu ge'i ming med par/ /skye rgu skyid pa'i khyim chen por/ /lha mi'i kun dga' rgyas par smon/ /bdag gi don du gzhan la btsan 'dzugs pa/ /bdag las gzhan la gces pas tshar bcad de/ /bdag gzhan phan bde'i gter chen zhi ba'i lam/ /bdag gzhan kun la dar bas mdzes gyur cig /'di na 'dra mnyam 'dra ba'i ri mo bcos min khyad par ches mang gis/ /skye bo phal cher phal la ma chags don mthun dga' mgu'i me 'bar te/ /ma rungs mtshon char mtshon gyis 'gog pa'i stobs rtsal ma lus gcig bsgril ba/ /srid pa gsum na gsum gyi grangs ldan dkon mchog dgyes pas rgyal gyur cig /208

bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba/ces bslab bya nyin mo'i snang ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ pe cin ta la'i pan si khru'u'i drung yig lcang can sras dbang phyug rgyal po lags nas rgyun par rang gi blo sbyong du 'khyer bde ba 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes gus pa chen pos bskul pa'i ngor/ bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po smra ba'i seng ge de nyid kyi rjes su dad pas rab tu byung ba shes rab rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i blo gros kyis sbyar pa'o/ /209

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/snying po'i lha chos byed par gdams pa bzhugs so/ /dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mdzad/gang la brten na bslu ba ma mchis pa'i/ /skyabs gnas rin chen gsum gyi thugs rje'i mthus/ /don med 'khor pa'i 'phrul snang kun zhi nas/ /blo sna chos la phyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ci la bsams kyang 'jig rten bya gzhag la/ /yang sgos snying po til tsam mi 'dug pas/ /yun thung tshe 'di'i blo sna bsgyur byas te/ /da nas snying po'i lha chos byed par bya/ /dar ma'i na tshod dbyar gyi me tog tsam/ /mdzes pa'i bkrag mdangs dgun gyi 'ja' tshon tsam/ /mi yi tshe la yun long mi 'dug pas/ /210

snying po'i lha chos byed par gdams pa/da ni snying po'i lha chos byed par bya/ /sdug pa'i dus su skyid pa'i thabs la re/ /skyid pa'i dus su sdug bsngal yong gis dogs/ /re dogs 'phrang las thar dus mi 'dug pas/ /da ni snying po'i lha chos byed par bya/ /gces par bskyangs kyang nad dang gcong gi gzhi/ /rgyan gyis mdzes kyang mi gtsang rang bzhin nyid/ /mi rtag lus la snying po mi 'dug pas/ /da ni snying po'i lha chos byed par bya/ /phyug po phyug po'i sa nas sdug gtam byed/ /dbul bo dbul bo'i sa nas smre ngag 'don/ /mi re'i sems la sdug bsngal khur bo re/ /'khor pa'i gnas na bde ba'i skabs ma mchis/ /spyir na phyi rol bde sdug snang ba kun/ /rang gi sems nyid gcig po'i cho 'phrul te/ /nang gi gzugs brnyan phyi ru 'char ba las/ /211

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phyi yi rnam pa tshur la 'ongs pa min/ /de ltar legs par go nas dpyad pa yis/ /kun gzhi sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa'i tshe/ /snang ba'i na bun 'di yi pha rol na/ /chos nyid don gyi nam mkha' dngos su bzhugs/ /yod ces bya ba 'di yang bcos ma ste/ /med ces bya ba 'di yang bcos ma nyid/ /de 'dra'i bcos ma kun gyis ma bslad pa/ /sems kyi rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin/ /yin min rnam rtog chu yi gnyer ma bzhin/ /gcig rjes gcig gis mthud de 'gro ba 'di/ /gtod med ngang du lhod kyis zhig pa'i tshe/ /chos dbyings gdod ma'i rgya mtshor slebs pa lags/ /mdor na snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul te/ /sems ni stong ba gzhi med rtsa bral nyid/ /gzhi med chos la bdag tu bzung ba yis/ /212

snying po'i lha chos byed par gdams pa/khyod dang nga yang 'khor pa'i gnas su 'khyams/ /de ni snang ba'i rjes su ma 'brang bar /snang mkhan kho la cer gyis bltas pa'i tshe/ /brjod du med pa'i rang ngo mthong 'gyur bas/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i lam de thag mi ring / /de ltar rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlabs kyis/ /myur du rang sems stong ba'i rtsad chod de/ /ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyal sa nas/ /mtha' med 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /ces pa 'di yang snying po'i chos la phyogs pa sgrol ma g.yang 'dzoms kyi ngor rgyal khams pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bris pa'o/ /213

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams bzhugs so/ /tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzad/'dir bod sog gi sku skye'i lam lugs skor la sngon byon dam pa'i gsung sgros dang 'brel bar bdag gi rjes su 'jug pa dag la phan pa'i don du dpyad pa cung zad bgyid na/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho yab kyi pang thog skabs nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'brug grags pa gsan nas yab la/ pha blo bzang grags pas chos gsungs pa 'dra ba'i sgra zhig go gsungs par/ yab kyis pha blo bzang grags pas chos ji ltar gsungs dris par/ 'o lags so/ / bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ /zhes gsungs pa red ces rje dge 'dun grub pas rje tsong kha pa las chos gsan pa rjes 214

bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams/su dran pa dang / yang dgung lo gsum gyi dus yum gyis sdigs mo byas par/ khyed rang nga la ma 'thab sdig yong gsol ba thob gsungs/ ji ltar 'debs zhus par/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu bsam 'phel khyod/ /yon tan thams cad ma bslabs thugs su chud/ /thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin grub pa brnyes/ /'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di thon gsungs te sku tshe de la tshigs bcad rtsom pa'i thog ma yin zhing /sku skye zer ba 'di 'dra'i mdzad pa ston dgos pa red/ dus phyis sum pa paṇḍi ta ye shes dpal 'byor dgung lo phra mo'i dus kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad par mjal kha zhus par/ khyod su yin zhes dris pas nga bla ma sems pa yin zhes lan btab/ gang nas 'ongs dris pas rgya nag nas 'ongs/ rkang thang ngam rta la zhon gsungs pas de gang yang ma yin pa'i 'ong lugs snang zhus pa na/bar do ba yin pas de bden gsungs nas phyag mdzub gcig mnan/ yang bla ma yin na slog pa ci la gon zhes pa na/ 'o na khyod kyis pags thul ci la gyon zhus tshe phyag mdzub gnyis mnan/ yang 215

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bla ma yin na chos shod chos thon gsungs tshe brjed pa med dam zhus pas phyag mdzub gsum mnan nas nga la 'khor gsum song bas byis pa shes rab can zhig 'ong a tsa ma gsungs nas mgo la byug pa mdzad/ ces sum pa'i rang rnam du gsungs te las snang ma dag pa rnams gong du 'dren pa'i sku skye 'di 'dra ba zhig yin na su la ya nga dad pa mi skye ba'i rang dbang med do/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho dgung lo bcu gcig gi dus smon lam tshogs dbus su sde khri rin po che nas maṇḍal bshad pa zhus/de'i rjes gsung 'phros su/ khyed kyis/ kā la tsakra mi 'gyur bde ba'i mkhar/ /sogs drangs nas shom chen po byed ki ang gsungs/shom los yod/ nged tsho mdzod dka' rams kyi dge bshes red mod ces rtsed mo zhus pa'i lan du/ chog gi ya/ cig nyan e yod bsams kyang da cig nyan song ba red gsungs/ gnas tshul de gung thang rin po cher zhus pas/ khong gis de 'dra zhig red/ nged lan gcig sku mdun du phyin par dpe sna thung zhig gzigs kyin 'dug ci red zhus par/ nged kyi sku gong ma'i gsang rnam khyed kyis 216

bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams/brtsams pa de red gsungs/ ngas shugs phud nas brtsams pa yin ga 'dra 'dug zhus par/ da dung gyong gyong bor yod ki mod gsungs/ skyabs rje gong mas nged kyi rtsom pa kha dam zhing gyong nyams che tshul gyis mi legs pa'i tshul yang yang gsung gi yod ces rnam gnyis thugs dad lhag par 'khrungs/ zhes kun mkhyen 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i rnam thar stod cha hor gtsang khri chen 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas brtsams pa las 'byung ste/ sprul ba'i sku zer ba ni 'di 'dra zhig yin dgos par snang ngo / /rgyal dbang lnga pa'i rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang du/ bod yul 'dir rgya gar dang mi 'dra ba'i bla ma la gdung brgyud kyis 'dzin pa dang skye bas 'dzin pa gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni sa skya tshang gi bdag chen rim byon ltar lugs gnyis kyi yon tan rnams pha shul bu 'jags lta bus bar gseng med cing bu slob 'khor 'bangs rnams bag phebs pa dang / skye bas 'dzin pa ni de las ldog ste bla ma grongs pa la sems ngal che zhing yul gru che ge mo na byis pa la pha ma sogs kyis g.yo sgyus bzos pa 'dra la tsham tshom med par bdag 217

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ —tu bzung ba'i bzhugs gral la chud nges dang skye bo du ma'i ri bong gi cal 'drog la brten wa skyes seng ger brdzu ba'i snang tshul kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sum pa'i rang rnam las/ sngon byon shāka thub rgyan drug mchog gnyis grub chen brgyad cu kha che bal bod kyi paṇa grub mar mi bu ston tsong kha pa lta bu la sku'i skye phreng rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar yol med du yod pa gzhir bcas kyang / yul dus der sprul sku sku skye'i dar so med pas sam zhing gzhan du byon pa ci rigs kyis snga ma'i 'khrungs yul kho nar sku skye byon pa'i gtam tsam yang med/ de lta na yang bod du zhabs drung sprul sku sku skye'i tshul ma bzung yang bstan don du bsam bzhin byon pa mang /dus phyis dbus gtsang mdo khams hor yul du rim gyis srol de dar nas/ yul lugs tshul du 'byor ldan phal cher gyis gdan 'dren/ de'i nang na skye ba'i sngon dang skye dus dang phyis su'ang ngo mtshar ba dang / yul mi la lar rmi lam nges 'drongs byung ba dang /skyes nas kyang rtags mtshan bkra shis pa shar ba dang / bla ma chos skyong gi lung bstan la dpyad log dang / bcos skyor med par nges 218

bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams/'drongs byung ba dang / byis pa des kyang mngal grib sogs kyis ma gos par smra thub ma thag nas sngon gnas rjes dran tshul du sngon ma'i gnas dang rten gsum ngos 'dzin dang / bya spyod bzang po'i rtags las nor so med pa srid mtha' tsam 'ga' zhig byon pa ni rgyal ba yab sras dang lcang skya lta bu byung / gzhan chos mthun gyi skyes bu yin kyang 'jig rten gyi stobs 'byor grags pa ha cang mi che ba dang / zang zing gi dngos po bdag gir mi byed cing grwa slob 'byor ldan med pa dang / mi la ltar sku chas srab pa phal cher la sku skye dkon par snang / yang bla chen kha cig snang ngor yon tan gsal lam mi gsal rung grwa slob rnams kyis lung bstan zhu yul la u tshugs byas nas sprul sku btsal ba la/ rnal ma yin pa'ang srid la phal cher ma nges/ gal te snga ma de'i skye ba min na lung bstan byed mkhan so thar sdom ldan yin na nyams rgyur 'gro ba dang / snga ma de'i lung gi yon tan brjed kyang rtogs pa'i chos sbyor lam dang rgyun zhugs thob pa yan chad yin na de che ru ma song yang nyams dogs med mod/ kha cig la blo gsar pa zhig gi tshod du yang mi 219

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sleb pa dang / da dung skyon gyi gong bur gyur nas dam pa snga ma'i zhabs 'dren nag chang smyo spyod kha mchu'i mgo 'dren byas pas skyes bu ma dag pa tshos las 'bras dang sa lam skye rim dang / de dag las nyams mi nyams kyi sa mtshams sogs la the tshom dang sgro skur dang chos la dbang za ba'i sdig pa gsog yang sngar gshegs de'i rgyus yod pa'i pha ma 'gas snga ma de ma gshegs gong nas skyes pa'i bu la rdzun gyis de'i skye ba yin par sgrogs pa dang / yang la las sku skye gzhon dus 'das pa na de dang lo mnyam re de'i go sar 'jog pa ni nor rdzas 'gugs thabs kho na yin/ zhes yang dag pa dang yang dag pa ma yin pa'i tshul so sor bkar nas khyad par phye ba dang / brtag pa byed pa'i thabs kyang / rgyal dbang lnga pa ni rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje'i drung dge lugs kyi bla ma'i bgres kha bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen rin po che dang gling smad zhabs drung dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis kyis zan ril bsgril ba'i thabs kyis thugs thag bcad ces rang rnam las gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam thar las/ gong ma chan lung gi dus 220
