bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams/gong ma chen pos bod sog gi bla ma'i skye srid ngos 'dzin byed skor la sngon dus 'khrul gzhi sna tshogs byung bar brten lha sa dang / yung hwa dgon du gser bum re gnang yod par phyin chad bum nang du ming byang bcug nas brtag pa byed dgos kyi bka' phab/ ces dang / 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i rnam thar las/ sngar gong ma chan lung nas sku 'bum yan chad kyi bla sprul rnams lha sa'i jo bo dang / de man chad kyi bla sprul rnams tsan dan jo bo'i mdun nas zan sgril gyis thag gcod dgos par bka' babs yod/ ces pa ltar rgyal ba dang rje btsun dam pa sogs bla chen phal cher thag gcod byed skabs gser bum dkrugs pa'i srol dar/ dper na rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho thag gcod byed skabs lha sa'i jo khang du gong ma'i 'dra thang mdun gser bum nang ngos gcig la rgya yig dang ngos gcig la bod yig 'bru tsha bris pa'i ba so'i byang bu gsum la am bhan nas dgu phyag sngon du btang nas bum nang du bcug ste li thang sgron 'dogs kyi khyi'u thon/ces pa lta bu ste srol 'di re zhig gi yun la gnas tshod red/ phyis 221

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/su rgyal ba yab sras sogs la chos 'khor rgyal gyi lha mo'i bla mtshor brten nas thag gcod pa'i thabs bla na med pa zhig yod par snang ste rgyus gsal ma nges so/ /yang du ku lar/ sog po'i dpon po bu mang po yod pa rnams sku skyer 'gro ba srol la 'dug pas da skabs nged kyang sku skye zhig yin nam gleng / zhes dang / kha dper/ me tog phal cher chu bo'i 'gram du skye/ /bla ma phal cher phyug po'i bu la 'khrungs/ /zhes pa ltar dus ches cher snyigs pa dang bstun sku skye 'tshol ba'i srol ga bzang po rnams rim gyis nyams nas rang 'dod gang byung gis bla rgan re grongs na sprul sku'am zhabs drung dang / sngags rgan re grongs na sku lo'am sku 'ba' zhes gces ming btags pa zhig btsal nas 'don chog tsam las yon tan ci yang mi slob par zang zing sdud pa'i tshong rten byed ci thub dang / blang dor la rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams bslu gang thub byed pa ni nges par bstan pa la gces par 'dzin pa zhig gis bltas na shin tu ya nga ba'i gnas so/ /de'i phyir rgyal dbang lnga pas/ mi shes gdol ba'i phru gu dar zab kyis/ /phang phung mdzes par byas te mthon 222

bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams/po'i khrir/ /blun po'i 'khor tshogs dbus na 'gying ba yi/ /ba mos thub bstan pad tshal bcom gyis dogs/ /chos spyod bcu yi sgrub pa rgyab bor nas/ /kha drag dpung dang rgyu nor g.yo khram gyis/ /'gro ba'i phan bde sgrub par rlom byed na/ /kun mkhyen shākya'i gtso de 'khrul bar nges/ /zhes dang / tshe 'dir sbyangs shing shes la tha mal zer/ /thos bral ma bslabs skyes bu dam par lta/ /gser dang snag tsha bsres pa'i rgyal khams 'di/ /yul dbus zer yang kla klo'i grong khyer 'dra/ /zhes dang / lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes/ byis pa'i dus nas thos bsam long med par/ /dar gos kyis bklubs tshong zong bzhin du 'grim/ /dad gshin dkor gyi zas la bag med spyod/ /gnas brtan dge 'dun phyag dang bsnyen bkur len/ /lnga bdo'i sku skye rnams la thugs rjes gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pas mtshon dam pa so so'i gsung na 'di 'dra ba shin tu mang ba dang / a rig dge bshes chen mo sku 'da' khar slob ma rnams kyis sku skye 'khrul med cig 'byon par zhus pa na spyir kho la rang dbang zhig yod na yid dga' chos 'dzin du 'gro bas sku skye med/ gal te dgos na 223

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byis pa'i dus su lam rim dang sngags rim gnyis blo thog nas shar shar 'don shes pa tsam du ma zad/ khyi gtum pos ded kyang kha nas mi 'chad pa zhig rnyed na kho'i sku skye yin/ zhes gsungs pa rnams la ltos dang bstan 'gror phan pa'i mgon skyabs kyi sku skye ni las sla ba zhig ga na yin/ phur lcog byams pa rin po ches 'khor slob mang ba la bka' chos gsung skabs shig 'di ltar gsung ste/ dus ngan gyi sku skye tsho skye ba re blangs kyin je ngan du 'gro zhes bkyon/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa phud ces kyal ka mdzad/ ces kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang po'i rnam thar du bkod yod de/ nges par phal cher zhig de kho na ltar red/ myi ring sngon ma 'dir bā yan stod kyi bla ma zhig yon bdag khyim du 'gro don la phebs par/ bla ma de la rgyus yod pa'i khyim bdag rgad pos kho'i bu chung pang du bzung nas bla ma de la 'di skad du/ a lags tshang/ nga'i bu tsha 'di bla ma zhig gi sprul sku red pa/ ya tha'i de yang kho la byin/ ma tha'i de yang kho la byin/ zer gi 'dug zhus pas/ bla ma des yon bdag lag nas brnab sems kyi lcags kyus dngos rdzas shig 'gugs 224

bod sog gi sku skye rnams la stsal ba'i zhal gdams/'dod pa'i re ba stong zad du btang zhes dgod bro ba'i ngag sgros de nga rang chung dus lan gcig ma yin par rna khung du babs pa zhig yin/ de'i phyir slob rgyu'i yon tan mi slob par/ mi slob rgyu'i ngan g.yo bslabs nas skye bo tha mal ba slu thub pa na bu skyes song snyam pa ni bdud kyi cho 'phrul gzugs su shar ba nyid yin no/ /sangs rgyas sku la chos longs sprul gsum ste/ /sprul sku sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul yin/ /bdag nyid sku gsum grangs la'ang rab rmongs na/ /sprul sku 'khrul med yin pa mthol lo bshags/ /'on kyang a lags snga ma de dang de'i/ /rnam shes 'khrul med byon pa los 'byung ste/ /de la mchog sprul dang ni sprul sku zhes/ /ming 'dogs bdag 'drar gtan nas 'os pa min/ /sbyangs yon che zhing tshul khrims yongs su dag /thugs bsam dkar zhing 'dod chung can yin na/ /mar me zan sgril thabs la ltos min par/ /skye bo kun gyis bkur ba'i bla mar 'os/ /zhes bya ba ni yid la ring du brnags pa'i bden gtam thol byung du smras pa'i tshigs bcad do/ /225

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs bzhugs so/ /dmu dge bsam gtan rgya mtshos mdzad/na mo gu ru bhyaḥ/'dir khyod kyis dris pa'i lan rags rim zhig brjod na/ spyir 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma yin zhing / de nas dris pa shin tu bzang ste/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos/ de nas 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ji snyed pa'i/ /rten 'brel legs par 'grig pa'i rtsa ba ni/ /lam ston bshes gnyen dam pa 'bad pa yis/ /bsam dang sbyor bas tshul bzhin bsten pa ru/ /mthong nas srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bar/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mchod pa thams cad kyi nang nas sgrub pa'i mchod pa mchog tu gsungs pa dang / lhag par snyigs dus 'dir nyams len la 'bad rgyu gal che/ re sa 'chang sa 226

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/gcig pu ni rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba7yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang ni dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang mkhan te/ bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/mdo lugs nas bshad na'ang lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa ste lam rim gyi man ngag cha tshang gnang mkhan yin phyir/ bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ sdom pa gnang mkhan gyi bla ma sogs chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma gzhan rnams kyang de'i sprul ba'am/ de dang thugs rgyud gcig tu lta dgos/ rang nyid 'dul ba'i phyir du rtsa ba'i bla ma des sdom pa gnang mkhan dang / klog slob mkhan/ man ngag phra mo yan chad slob pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs shig sprul ba yin/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rang re la thugs mi brtse ba ni gcig kyang med/ de thams cad kyi 'phrin las rang re 'dul phyir rang re'i bla ma dang 'tsham par shar ba ni rtsa ba'i bla ma de yin phyir/ de sgrub pas sangs rgyas thams cad sgrub pa dang / de la gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba btab pa yin/ dngos brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad thugs rgyud 227

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gcig tu 'dres nas yod phyir/ gcig gi gsol 'debs bton pas gzhan rnams la chad song bsam rgyu med/ dper na dmigs brtse ma yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yin/de bzhin du snying po dang gsol 'debs gang bton yang 'dra/tshogs zhing sgom dus ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de yin pa la/ rnam pa shākya thub pa sogs lhag lhar sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rang re'i snang ngor tha mal pa'i rnam pa bzung yod stabs/ tha mal pa'i snang ba de log nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ched yin/lha gang dang gang sgom yang ngo bo bla ma yin la rnam pa lha de'i rnam par sgom dgos/ skyabs 'gro dang / lam rim/ bla mchod sogs kyi tshogs zhing rang rang gi man ngag ltar sgom tshe/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de tshogs zhing gi gtso bo dang tshogs zhing gi lha tshogs gzhan rnams ni de'i sprul ba yin par sgom dgos/ gang ltar yang lam rim ltar bshes gnyen bsten tshul la dad pa dang mos gus sbyangs pa gal che/'gro mgon skyob pa rin po ches/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na/ /byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas/ /228

— da —nyalolenabyatsorangablo'ibacudajilto /wayid mos gus 'di la gzab par 'tshal/ /gsungs pa ltar yin/bla ma rnams la sgo sna tshogs nas dag snang sbyangs shing / rtsa ba'i bla ma tshogs zhing gi gtso bor bsgom nas gsol ba 'debs tshe/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal/'khor pa spyi dang bye brag gi sdug bsngal rnams la bsam blo shugs drag btang nas sems skyo lhang lhang du 'gyur bar byed/ de nas rang nyams la dpag nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul bsam ste snying rje ci skye gang skye byed kyang / snying rje des drangs pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod dang / de'i ched du bla ma lha'i go 'phang thob 'dod kyis skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs sogs bya dgos/ dal 'byor ni rgyu dpe ngo bo gsum gyi sgo nas rnyed dka' tshul dang / rnyed na don che tshul nan tan gyis bsam dgos/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa'ang rtsa ba gsum dang rgyu mtshan dgu'i sgo nas bsam zhing gtso bo nam 'chi cha med bsams dgos te/ rje btsun mi las/ ngas 'chi ba mi rtag sgom pa'i tshe/ /nam 'chi cha med yang yang sgom/ /gsungs so/ /ngan song gi sdug 229

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bsngal ni tsha grang dang skom ltogs kyi sdug bsngal de dang de rang thog tu babs pa lta bur bsams te/ bzod mi bzod ji 'dra snyam du sgom zhing / tshe tshad la bsams na'ang ha las dgos pa zhig yin te/ dper na grang dmyal gyi tshe tshad ni mdzod las/ til sbyang nang nas lo brgya zhing / /til gcig byung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus 'gyur/ /gsungs pa ltar dang / mi lo lnga bcu ni rgyal chen ris bzhi'i nyin zhag gcig dang / de sum cu zla ba dang / de bcu gnyis lo byas pa'i rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lo lnga brgya ni yang sos kyi tshe tshad/ 'og ma rnams ni rim bzhin brgyad 'gyur brgyad 'gyur du gsungs stabs/ skyes na thar rgyu med pa 'dra/ ji ltar bzod snyam du sgom dgos/ 'khor pa spyi'i sdug bsngal kyang skye rga na 'chi dang / 'dod pa btsal kyang mi rnyed/ mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab tshul/ mtho dman la nges pa med tshul/ dgra gnyen la nges pa med tshul/ 'thab rtsod mu ge sogs mdor na mi yul du'ang dmyal ba yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal lta bu yod tshul dang / snyigs dus kyi rgud pa mig mthong lag zin du yod 230

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/pa rnams kyang re re bzhin dran te sems skyo lhang lhang e 'gro blta/rang nyams la dpags nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyis mnar tshul sgom dgos la/ de rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas bsam tshul rtsa ba red/ de'i thog bdag gzhan mnyam brje sgom tshul gyi man ngag rnams ltar sgom na lhag par sa chod che/ spyir lam rim che chung dang / man ngag bde lam gyi khrid yig myur lam dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung / de'i khrid yig kun mkhyen gsungs lta bu'i lam rim khrid yig che chung gang zhig la blta thub kyang rang rgyud dang sbyar nas dpyad sgom byas na skyed mi yong mi srid/ mdor na rgyun du las 'bras la yid ches shing dkon mchog la blo phugs gtod rgyu de rtsa ba yin/ skyid na bla ma dkon mchog gi drin du lta zhing / sdig na sngon las su lta dgos/ sdig can la 'chi kha sdug bsngal byung na me tog kha 'bus zer ba yin/ sdug bsngal chen po'i 'bras bu smin pa'i 'go bzung ba red/ chos pa la 'chi kha sdug bsngal byung na dom bsal brgyab zer ba yin/ sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu'i lhag ma dag pa yin/ spyir rang re chos pa la rkyen bzang 231

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngan gang byung yang chos kyi gegs su mi 'gro bar lam du slong dgos/ lha'i dpal 'byor lta bu 'byor na'ang nga rgyal khengs dregs dang g.yeng ba'i dbang du mi 'gro bar chos phyogs su bsgyur ci thub byed dgos/ yi dwags lta bu dbul la sdug bsngal bas kyang sems zhum par mi 'gyur bar las ngan gyi 'bras bu zad pa'i rgyu yin snyam du dga' ba sgom/ sdug bsngal gyi yon tan ni spyod 'jug las/gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ /skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ /'khor pa ba la snying rje skye/ /dge la dga' zhing sdig la 'dzem/ /gsungs so/ /mdor na/ snod bcud sdig pa'i 'bras bus yongs gang ste/ /mi 'dod sdug bsngal char ltar bab gyur kyang / /las ngan 'bras bu zad pa'i rgyur mthong nas/ /rkyen ngan lam du slong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen ngan lam bsgyur lhag par gal che/ gzhan yang sdug bsngal gyi snang ba gang byung yang /ngan song du skyes na 'di las lhag yin rgyu red snyam du ngan song dang 'khor pa'i sdug bsngal bsgoms te dge sbyor la 'bad ci thub gang thub byed/ rang nyams la dpags te ma rgan sems can 232

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsams nas snying rje ci thub gang thub sgom zhing / sems bskyed bcos ma re tshun chad gsal btab ste/ de'i ngang nas dge sbyor la 'bad ci thub byed/ skyid sdug gang byung bla ma'i byin rlabs yin snyam du sems dga' lhang nger dge sbyor la 'bad dgos/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/srog 'tsho 'chi 'byor rgud bde sdug dang / /yang bstod smad snyan dang mi snyan sogs/ /gang byung yang bla ma'i byin rlabs yin/ /a la la ci byas glo ba dga'/ /re dogs kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /dpal zhi ba lha dang mar me mdzad/ /rje rgyal ba gnyis pa las 'ong ba'i/ /dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i gdams pa yis/ /a la la ltas ngan g.yang du len/ /rkyen ngan kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /gsungs pa ltar/ rkyen ngan lam 'khyer gyi gdams pa 'di shin tu zab/ yang rgyun du las 'bras la yid ches skyed ched/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa dang / byas pa chud mi za ba la nges pa 'dren ched/ dgra bcom pa sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyi byung ba dang /rgyal po in tra ya na'i byung ba/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi byung ba 233

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sogs/ 'dul ba lung dang / mdzangs blun/ las brgya ba sogs kyi byung ba sna tshogs la dpyad pa gtong zhing / de dag gis 'khor pa la snying po med pa la'ang nges pa 'dren nus pas gal che/snying rje sgom tshe/ spyir dngos po thams cad kyi rdzas rgyun la thog ma med/ bye brag gang zag thams cad kyi rdzas rgyun la'ang thog ma med gshis rang gi skye ba la'ang thog ma med/ des na skye ba blang ba la'ang grangs med/ de'i phyir sems can 'di'i mngal du ma skyes pa gcig kyang med/ skyes pa la grangs kyis mi chod/ mar gyur res kyis bskyangs pa tshad med tshul tshe 'di'i ma dang sbyar nas/ sgo sna tshogs nas drin che tshul bsams te/ sems can gcig mthong na'ang 'di ma rgan drin can yin snyam du bsam/ tha na khyi gcig zug pa'i sgra thos na'ang ma rgan drin can zhig grag gi 'dug snyam du bsam/ de nas rigs drug gi ma sems can thams cad nyam thag pa yin tshul dang / de dag gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs la 'dang brgyab nas snying re rje snyam du sgom/ byams snying rje'i gegs ni/gtso bo zhe sdang yin gshis/ de'i mgo gnon ci thub bya/ dper na 234

nyamazilenabyardzorang blo'i bcud thigs/gzhan gyis rang la gnod pa byed 'ong tshe/ de ni phar khro ba'i yul min/ snying rje ba'i yul yin/ dper na rang gi ma rgan gdon gyis zin te smyos na phan 'dogs mkhan dang nad g.yog byed mkhan rnams la gshe ba dang rdung ba sogs byed pa la khro mi rigs pa ltar yin/ dgra de dag kyang las ngan pa'i gdon gyis zin te/ nyon mongs pa'i nad langs nas las ngan bsags pa yin pa'i stabs/snying rje ba'i yul yin/ de dag gis rang la gnod pa byas na/ don la rang gi sdig sgrib 'dag pas sgrib sbyong du song gshis phan btags pa yin/ rang gis des gnod pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba de rang gis bsags pa'i las ngan gyi 'bras bu smin pa yin/ rang gi las ngan de'i dbang gis dgra bo la khong khro skye bcug nas las ngan bsags bcug pa'i stabs kyis/ phar dgra bo de la gnod bskyal ba red/ ngas ma rgan 'di la khong khro skye bcug pas/ de'i 'bras bu la dmyal bar skye dgos gshis sdug bsngal bzod thabs ci yod snyam du snying rje sgom/ yang pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ dgra sdang las kyi 'khrul snang yin pa la/ /zhe sdang gdug rtsub ma che ding ri pa//235

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gsungs pa ltar/ sems can 'di dgrar langs nas mtha' bskor kyang / don la rang gi las kyi 'khrul snang yin/ dper na dmyal bar skyes tshe las mkhan mtha' dag las kyi 'khrul snang las byung ba dang 'dra 'dra yin/ mdor na bzang ngan gyi snang ba gang byung yang dge sbyor 'phel ba'i grogs dang / byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'phel ba'i grogs su bsgyur dgos/ gang ltar rkyen bzang ngan gang byung tshe dkon mchog dang las 'bras la yid je che dang dge sbyor la brtson pa je cher song dus cig chog gi yod ni yin/ mdor na bzang ngan snang ba ci shar yang / /chos kun snying po stobs lnga'i nyams len gyis/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'phel ba'i lam bsgyur te/ /yid bde 'ba' zhig sgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsungs pa ltar red/ de ltar du blo sbyong thub tshe bzang ngan gang byung yang sems 'tshub rgyu med par bde chab kyis yod/ stobs lnga ni/ 'phen nga/'i stobs/ goms pa'i stobs/ dkar po sa bon gyi stobs/sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi stobs te lnga'o/ /'phen pa'i stobs ni/ mi tshe stong zad du mi gtong snyam du 236

nyamagalenabyajalarang blo'i bcud thigs/'phen pa gtong ba dang / nangs par langs nas de ring gi nyi ma 'di la'ang dge sbyor gyi dus 'da' bar bya snyam du bsam pa dang /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'dus yod/ goms pa'i stobs ni/ rgyun du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la goms pa 'di shin tu gal che gsungs/ dkar po sa bon gyi stobs ni/ tshogs bsags pa la zer/sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ sdig pa bshags pa la zer/ bsngo smon gyi stobs ni/ mjug tu bsngo smon rnam dag byed pa/ thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis gsungs pa de 'phen pa'i stobs dang bsngo smon gyi stobs la zer/ thog ma'i bya ba 'phen pa'i stobs gal che ste/dper na mda' 'phen pa'i tshe thog mar shugs bskyed na/ de nas 'ben la thug gi bar du rang shugs kyis 'gro ba dang 'dra/ mjug gi bya ba byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che ste/ 'bras bu dman par mi smin pa gal che/ dkar po sa bon gyi stobs ni yar dkon mchog sogs zhing dam pa la mchod pa dang / mar dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba de/ deng sang rang 'byor thog nas mngon chos byed pa dka' zhing dgos pa'ang med/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 237

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dang rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad na me tog sogs mchod rdzas gang yod thams cad yid yul du byas te phul na bsam gyis mi khyab/ tha na chu dwangs bsil mthong ba dang / spang ljongs mthong ba/ me tog dang ljon shing / shing thog sogs zas rigs/ dar gos sogs gos rigs legs pa gang mthong yang / de ma thag yid 'ong mchod yon sogs yid kyis bton/ bsam pa rtse gcig gis 'bul ba ni dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba yin/ yang rang gis yid kyis mchod rdzas bzang dgu nam mkha' gang ba sprul ba dang /rdul re re'i steng du rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho dang mchod rdzas bzang dgu sprul nas 'bul ba ni yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod pa yin la lhag par bsam gyis mi khyab/ sbyin pa ni/rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge rtsa dang bcas pa nyin re bzhin dus drug tu bla ma la 'bul zhing / sems tshocan rang rang gi mkho dgu'i yo byad du gyur par bsam nas/sems can la bsngo ba ni sbyin gtong gi mchog yin/ 'di dag kyang 238

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor nang du tshang dgos/ gcod kyi man ngag yod na de'i sgo nas mar dbul phongs dang gdon bgegs la spyin pa gtong ba'i dmigs rnam bskyangs na zab/ de la ki si la'i tshogs bsags kyang zer/ gang ltar gdams pa re re'i nang du stobs lnga ga tshang bar bya dgos/ sdig pa bshags pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mchod pa sogs tshang ma sdig bshags yin yang /spyir sdig pa bshags pa la stobs bzhi tshang dbo/sa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rten gyi stobs/ dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ sdig pa phyi ma mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems drag po nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs/ gzungs sngags zab mo dang ltung bshags sogs kyi sgo nas sgrib sbyong byed pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang bzhi'o/ /dper na rdor sems sgom bzlas lta bu la'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ 'gyod sems/ sdom sems/ bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyangs dang yig brgya bzla ba4bzhi tshang dgos pa lta bu yin/ sdom gsum dag pa nyams len gyi mthil du 'dzin rgyu 'di rang re'i bka' gdams gsar rnying gi 239

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/man ngag gtso bo yin/ so thar la mtshon na/ pham bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum/ chang sogs kyis gtan nas ma gos pa zhig byas te/spang ltung gi skor la gos 'bral spang lta bu la deng dus thabs bral bas rung mthun sbyar na chog snyam/ 'chang spang yo byad byin rlabs la rnam brtags byas na chog pa 'dul ba rang las gsung stabs des chog la/ de byed tshul ni nyin re bzhin du rang la longs spyod gang yod dkon mchog la 'bul ba'am/ sems can gyi don du bsngo ba de yin/ rgyun du nyams len byed mkhan zhig la 'di zhor la 'ong / de las gzhan pa'i spang ltung sum cu'i nang srung ba'i phan yon 'byung sa las/ yul dus kyi dbang gis ltung ba 'byung sa cher med/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dang sor bshags bzhi rnams phal cher la srung ba'i phan yon yod pa las ma srung ba'i ltung ba 'byung sa yul dus kyi dbang gis cher med pa 'dra snyam la/ 'ga' zhig la rung mthun kyang sbyar na chog snyam/ de 'dra byas na khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum de srung rgyu dka' rgyu rang med snyam/ byang sems la rtsa ltung bco brgyad dang / nyes byas zhe drug red/ rtsa ltung la'ang 240

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/kun dkris chen po bzhi tshang dgos sa mang gshis ltung ba dngos gzhi 'byung rgyu sla ba zhig min/ sngags la rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang /rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bcu dgu/ sbom po brgyad sogs red/rgyun du dran shes bsten na srung rgyu dka' mo ma red/ ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi yod pa'i ma gus pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo1/ de'i gnyen por dkon mchog dang las 'bras la yid ches shing / theg pa chung gi sdom pa'i spang blang gi phan yon dang nyes dmigs la yid ches shing / bslab bya la shin tu gus pa la slob dgos/ bag med pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo2/ de'i gnyen por rgyun du lus ngag yid gsum bag yod par byed dgos/ nyon mongs pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo3/ de'i gnyen por rang rgyud la brtags nas nyon mongs gang shas che na de'i gnyen po sgom/ dper na/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa sgom pa dang / zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa sgom pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por khams kyi rab dbye sgom pa/ rnam rtog gi gnyen por dbugs 'byung rngub bsgom ste rnam rtog mi 'phro bar byed pa lta bu yin/ mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i 241

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sgori de'i gnyen por thos bsam byas nas sdom pa so so'i bsrung bya rnams yid la nges par byed dgos/ 'di deng sang dka' mo red de/ sdom gsum bslab bya bsdu ma re tshun chad la rku lta re byas nas/ rags rim re yin yang nges thub na bzang / gung thang rin po che'i tshe gcig nyams len gyi nang du sdom gsum bsngo bgrang rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa zhig yod/ a khu blo gros tshang gi sdom gsum bslab bya ni shin tu legs la 'gran zla bral mod/ 'byor dka' rgyu red snyam/ mdor na/ rang gis shes tshod dang thub tshod nas 'bad na mi shes pa dang thabs med pa la ha cang 'dang brgyab nas rlung lang gi bcug ma bcug med/ gal te ltung ba byung na bshags sdom la 'bad dgos shing / bshags sdom byed thabs mang po yod/stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang 'brel yig brgya 'bum bzlas na gsang sngags kyi rtsa ltung yang 'dag par rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ byang sems dang so thar gyi rtsa ltung 'dag par lta ci smos snyam/ 'on kyang ltung ba bcos thabs logs su yod/ so thar la gso sbyong red/ byang sems la phyir 242

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/bcos las logs su med/ sngags la dbang dang bdag 'jug gi sgo nas rtsa ltung gso dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi blangs na bdag 'jug gi go chod gsung / rang res so thar ma zad sdom pa gong ma gnyis ka yang blangs yod gshis/ thun drug gi rnal 'byor gal che/ de yang yongs grags kyi thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor de'am/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma lta bu'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor la'ang de'i man ngag tshang bar byas chog khrid yig rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i gsung na yod/ ma mtha'/ so thar byang sems rdo rje theg pa yi/ /rnam dag bcas pa'i bslab pa phra mo las/ /rmi lam du yang 'da' bar mi bya bar/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bdag gis bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pa 'di nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bton te bsam na ltung ba khegs gsung / spyir kha ton gang byed kyang don yid la dran pa gal che/ don dran thub na tshig kha nas ma bton kyang chog tshig 'don pa don dran ched red/ sngags kyi bzlas pa sgra dag gsal gsum gyi sgo nas 'don dgos par gsung mod/ deng sang de yang yid 'don mi byed ka med yin gshis/243

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yid 'don byas na'ang los chog gang ltar yang rang nyid 'khor pa dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa1dang skyabs yul gyi tshogs zhing rnams la de las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par yid ches pa2'di gnyis la skyabs 'gro'i rgyu gnyis zer/ de ltar skyabs 'gro dang / de nas rang nyams la dpag te byams snying rje'i dmigs rnam bskyangs nas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ de nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang sogs lhag lha gang rung gi rnam par bsgoms te phyag 'tshal/mchod 'bul/ maṇḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa rnams byas te mthar bla ma snying kar bsdus te/ stong ba nyid la mnyam par bzhag nas/ de'i ngang nas rang nyid lhar ldang / lus1longs spyod2dge rtsa3bcas sems can la bsngo zhing / sdom gsum bsngo bgrang rgyas bsdus ci rigs byed pa ni thun drug gi rnal 'byor yin/bla mchod lta bu la de los tshang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma lta bu la de tshang lugs yod/ sbyor shes na cho ga gang la'ang tshang bar byas chogathun drug gi rnal 'byor zer ba ni/ nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /gsung ba lta bu'i dus drug la bsngo 244

nyams len bya tshul rang blo'i bcud thigs/bgrang dang nyams su len dgos pa'i sngags byang sems kyi sdom pa rnams thun gcig tu nyams su len tshul gyi man ngag zab mo grub mtha' gzhan gyi gser chos zer ba las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams pa zab mo yin/ spyir mdo sngags kyi lam yongs rdzogs la bag chags 'jog ched yon tan gzhir gyur ma'am/ bla mchod kyi zhing mchog dam pa ma'am/ lam rim bsdus don lta bu re'i sgo nas lam yongs rdzogs shar sgom re byed pa ni gnad dam pa yin te/ tshul 'di thun rer bton dang nyan pas kyang / /dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon sogs/ /rlabs chen sdud par nges pas de don bsams/ /gsungs so/ /mjug tu bzang po spyod pa lta bus bsngo smon rnam dag bya dgos te/ thog mtha' gnyis la bya ba gnyis gsungs pa red/ rgyun du'ang bya ba gang byed sems can gyi don du bsngo ba gal che/ dper na zhing las byed pa/ phyugs 'tsho ba sogs gang byed kyang / 'di lta bu'i sgo nas kyang sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs/ spyod 'jug smon lam gyi nang gi bsngo smon mtha' dag byang chub sems sgom gyi man 245

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ngag yin pas de ltar byed dgos/ khyod kyi 'dri tshul la bltas na nyams len byed 'dod re yod 'dra bas de ma thag lan 'di bris pa yin/ re zhig 'di'i mig byas la 'bad brtson bskyed 'tshal/man ngag 'di tsho snod ldan re yod tshe bstan na los chog sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa sems can gyi don red/ de min snod min la shin tu gsang ba gal che/ snod min la bstan na chos kyi byin rlabs nyams 'gro ba chos nyid yin/ phyi bltas rgya rgan mgo dkar te/ /nang bltas paṇa rgan sems dkar des/ /rang blo yol ko'i bcud thigs 'ga'/ /khyed kyi ched du sug pas spel/ /'di ni mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po bka' drin gzhal du med cing mtshan brjod par dka' ba slob dpon rin po che bsam gtan rgya mtsho mchog gis gang gi dngos slob 'jam dbyangs nyi ma la lo bcu'i zing 'tshub drag po'i nang mtshan mo zhig gi glog sgron 'og 'phral mar gsung ris su gnang ba lags la/ da reb dpar du bskrun pa'i dge bas 'gro ba rnams yang dag lam la bgrod par gyur cig gu/ /246

tha ma kha dang / myos byed/ sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/tha ma kha dang / myos byed/ sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rang gzhan gnyis 'phung gi zas ngan rnams kyi nyes pa brjod pa la gsum/ tha ma kha'i nyes dmigs/chang gi nyes dmigs/ sgog skya sogs kyi nyes dmigs/ zhar byung sna tha kha'i nyes dmigs dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdzas ngan tha ma kha zhes grags pa 'di ni sngon sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya tsam song ba na bdud rigs kyi bu mo zhig gi zla mtshan sa la 'dzag nas de las sngo zhig skyes pas bdud rigs des 'di ni ma 'ongs pa na skye bo thams cad kyis longs spyod cing / khyad par 'di'i du ba nam mkhar song nas lha'i grong khyer 'bum tsho mang po stongs par gyur cig du ba sa 'og tu song nas klu'i grong khyer mang po stongs par gyur cig de la brten pa'i nad mug 'khrug rtsod 247

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sad ser rnams rgyun mi chad par shog ces smon lam log par btab pa'i bden mthu las/ da lta'i skya ser rnams kyis longs spyod pa'i zas ngan 'di byung ba yin cing / gzhan yang sngon slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis lung bstan pa'i ratna gling ba'i gter ma las/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /dam sri spun dgu dam la bzhag pa'i tshe/ /spun dgu'i tha chung nyid kyis 'di smras so/ /spun rnams mya ngan ma byed gtam la nyon/ /nga ni rgya yul tha ma kha ru sprul/ /dug gi ming ni ha la nag po zer/ /bod kyi mtha' 'khob rnams su skyes nas yod/ /mtha' mi rnams kyis dbus su khyer nas yod/ /bod 'bangs bde skyid longs spyod de la byed/ /de yi stobs kyis dug lnga rags shing rgyas/ /dge bcu spangs nas mi dge bcu la spyod/ /bstan 'dzin sku tshe mi brtan zhing du gshegs/ /dug gi du ba sa yi 'og tu song / /klu yi grong khyer chen po 'bum tsho 'jig /char chu mi 'bebs lo phyugs mi legs shing / /nad 'khrugs rims nad mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung / /dug gi du ba nam mkha'i mthongs su song / /de yi stobs kyis lha yi grong khyer 248

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/'jig /gza' 'dzin dus log skar ma rtags can shar/ /'thungs pa'i mi de byang chub sems rtsa skam/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams ldang bar byed/ /'thung bas shi tshad ngan song gsum du skye/ /zhes gsungs/ der ma zad ma cig lab kyi sgron ma'i lung bstan las/yang cig nyon dang bu slob kun/ /dus kyi tha ma rtsod ldan dus/ /dug lnga tshang ba'i kha zas gcig /'byung ni nag po rgya nas 'byung / /dar ni hor gyi yul du dar/ /zas ni bod khams 'gro ba'i zas/ /de yi dbang gis 'dzam gling 'dir/ /char chu mi snyoms sad ser ldang / /sgom sgrub byed pas 'di zos na/ /bskal pa brgyar yang lha mi 'grub/ /phyi mar ngan 'gror gtan 'khyams byed/ /mchog gsum thugs rjes skyob mi nus/ /zhes sogs dang / paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung las/ mi gtsang rtsog gis mnal bas sad ser dang / /mi 'dod 'bras bu sna tshogs 'gro la 'byung / /rnam smin rang nyid mi bzang dri phog pa'i/ /'gro rnams dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro sogs/ /gnas ngan mi khom gnas su skye bas na/ /rig ldan su zhig de 'dra la mi 'dzem/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gis 249

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'then na a cang che ste gzhan gyis 'then pa'i du ba phog na yang tshul khrims 'chal zhing dge sbyor la shin tu gnod pas/ dam sri bdud sprul rnams sna drangs te nag phyogs gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad sha rul la sbrang bu 'khor ba bzhin du 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis nad rims tshad pa sogs tha na lus la shu thor gyi rigs sna tshogs 'byung zhing / yul khams su yang sad ser lo nyes mi nad phyugs nad mu ge dmag 'khrug sogs bkra mi shis pa sgo du ma nas 'byung zhing / du ba 'di rgyu'i dbang du byas na dam sri bdud sprul bud med kyi mngal khrag las byung bas dge sbyor byas kyang phan yon mngon du mi 'gyur ba dang / chos skyong srung ma rnams thugs khrel zhing mchod bstod 'phrin bcol byas kyang 'dod don mi 'grub pas nyon mongs dug gsum me ltar 'bar zhing tshe 'di la yang mi kha gtam ngan rkyen ngan 'ba' zhig gis 'chi dgos shing / shi ma thag tu ngan song gi sdug bsngal bskal pa mang po'i bar du myong dgos pa ni gong gi lung bstan dang / bla ma dam pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gsungs pas bkres skom gang la'ang mi phan pa'i 250

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/zas ngan 'di srog gi phyir yang spang bar byas na bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams zhabs pad brtan cing / yul phyogs rnams su bde skyid phun sum tshogs shing rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yun du gnas pa'i phan yon tshad med pas/ don 'di la dgongs nas de mo rgyal tshab ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs nas grwa sa rnams kyis gtsos dgon sde rnams su chang dang lhag par tha ma kha'i bkag bsdams legs par byas nas grwa sa rnams su me phag rtsa tshig zhes lo re bzhin klog rgyu mdzad pas/ de skabs klong rdol bla ma rin po che nas rgyal tshab de mo nas bsam yas gsar gso byas pa bas/ mgon sde rnams su tha ma kha 'then mi chog par mdzad pa ni bka' drin shin tu che zhes thugs dgyes tshor chen po mdzad pa yin zhes bla ma rnams kyis gsungs so/ /gnyis pa chang gi nyes dmigs ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis srog gi phyir yang 'thung mi chog par mdo sngags gnyis ka'i skabs su gsungs shing / klu sgrub thogs med sogs 'phags yul gyi grub chen rim byon dang khyad par rje 251

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tsong kha pa chen po yab sras sogs nas chang ni nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin tshul gsung rab las gsal bar gsungs zin pas 'dir brjod ma dgos kyang / rang nyid dran gso'i phyir du cung zad spros na/ chang zhes bya ba'i smyo chu 'di ni/ sngon rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las lha mo mdzes sdug mthong tshad chags pas myos nas brgyal 'gro ba zhig byung ba tshang ba'i dug zer dug chang gi lha mo de me tog dkar po 'dab ma lnga par gyur pa ni chang rtsi me tog ces chan la btab nas chang du langs par byed pa 'di yin/ de las chang rtsi zer ba'i phabs 'di 'chos pa yin pas chang 'thung na nyes pa chen po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di la brten nas mdzes pa'i lha mos ngan song du 'khyer ba yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ chang ni dug gi mchog yin te/ /chang 'thung ba la bstan pa ni/ /dge ba'i chos rnams nyams par 'gyur/ /gang gis rtag tu chang bsten pa/ /de yi blo ni mi brtan zhing / /blo g.yo ba la chos med de/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /nyams byed nang na nyams mchog ni/ /chang zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /de lta 252

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/bas na dug lta bu'i/ /chang 'thung ba ni rnam par spongs/ /chang gis 'dod chags skyed byed cing / /de bzhin khro dang gti mug dag /yang dang yang du skyed byed pas/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /ces dang / rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba ni/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /zhes dang / rje bla mas kyang / chang 'thung ba phung khrol te nyes dmigs kun gyi rtsa bar gsungs pa ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kho na ma yin gyi bla med dang thun mong pa yin te/ bla med kyi dkyil chog tshad ldan du mar rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nas 'byung ba ltar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / 'dul ba lung las chang 'thung dmyal ba ngu 'bod skye/ /sbyin mkhan de yi 'khor du skye/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ chang 'thung ba ni tsha ba'i dmyal bar ltung zhing skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der ltung ba'i sems can rnams ni lo stong phrag mang por 'tshod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyir phyung nas chu bo rab med kyi ngogs su brgyugs par byed do/ /gang du yang 'gro sa med par yang dang yang du skye bar byed do/ /der dmyal ba'i srung ma rnams kyis mchil bas nya 'don pa ltar/ lcags bsregs kyi sa 253

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhi la 'debs par byed do/ /de nas 'di ltar sgrog ste/ kye skyes bu khyod ci 'dod zer bas/ jo bo skom 'dod byas pas/ dmyal ba'i srung ma des me 'bar ba'i lcags kyu'i kha phye ste lcags zhu ba'i khu ba nas blugs par byed do/ /de la des mchu sreg go /mgrin pa yang sreg go /brang sreg go /rgyu ma sreg go /snying sreg go /bshang lam du lcags khu mar 'thon par byed nas sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong bar byed cing / de'i dus su 'chi bar ni mi 'gyur te/ ji srid kyi bar du sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bu myong bar byed do/ /de srid du de rnams kyi rnam par smin pa tshor ba myong bar byed do/ /gal te sdug bsngal de dag las thar na yang / yi dwags dang dud 'gro dag tu skye la/ mir skyes na'ang las kyi rgyu mthun pa des shin tu dbul ba dang lam po che dang bzhi mdo sogs su skye zhing / mdog ngan pa dang / so 'ba' zhig snang ba dang / rkang pa rdol ba dang / lus rtag tu bkres pa dang / skom pas gdungs pa dang / bu dang chung ma pha dang ma dang / gnyen bshes rnams kyis gtang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung / yang mdo las/ don med gzhi ni chang yin te/ /254

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/sems can dmyal ba bzhad gad pa/ /dbang po thams cad rnams nyams shing / /don med pa yi rgyur gyur to/ /chog la shin tu dga' ba dang / /chags pa dang ni 'jigs pa dang / /ngag gi skyon dang rlom pa dang / /tshig rtsub bzhi ni de yin no/ /chang ni kun tu g.yeng bas yid/ /bya dang mi bya mi shes pas/ /mi de phyugs dang mtshungs pa yin/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /chang gis g.yengs pa'i mi dag ni/ /gson yang shi ba dag dang mtshungs/ /gang zhig rtag tu gson 'dod pas/ /rtag par chang ni rnam par spongs/ /chang ni nyes pa kun gyi gzhi/ /rtag par don kun med par byed/ /ngan song gsum gyi them skas te/ /mun nag gnas ni chen po yin/ /chang gis sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bzhin yi dwags 'jig rten dang / /chang gi skyon gyis bslus pa yi/ /yi dwags dud 'gro rnams su 'gro/ /dug gi nang du dug ni chang / /de bzhin dmyal ba'i nang nas dmyal/ /nad kyi nang na nad mchog ni/ /chang zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /blo dang dbang po nyams byed cing / /rin chen chos ni zad byed pa/ /mi bzad chang ni skye gnas gcig /chang la 255

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/brten pa'i mi dag ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi sta re yin/ /ngo tsha med par byed pa'i mchog /yang bar rtag tu nye bar bstan/ /chang gis 'phrog par gyur pa'i sems/ /bya ba dang ni mi bya ba/ /mi shes rnam par mi shes shing / /thams cad mi yis mi shes so/ /gang zhig chang la bsten byed pa/ /skye bo re 'ga' dga' byed cing / /res 'ga' yongs su gdung byed la/ /res 'ga' sdig pa byed pa yin/ /blo ni shin tu rmongs byed cing / /'jig rten gnyis ni rnams 'jig byed/ /thar pa'i chos la me lta bur/ /sreg byed kho na chang yin no/ /chang 'thung ba yis bslus pa dag /de ni byed pa dman pa yin/ /mi bzad sems can dmyal bar ltung / /don med ci zhig yongs su gdungs/ /'thung ba'i tshe na chang zhim ste/ /rnam smin tshe na mchog tu tsha/ /chang ni dmyal bar 'gro bar byed/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams byed pa la/ /sems g.yengs pa dag dga' bar byed/ /phyi ni rnam smin tsha ba ru/ /blo ngan yongs su gdung bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams la blo mi gtong / /'dod pa mchog tu bslu ba yin/ /'khor pa'i 'ching ba dran po ste/ /sems can dmyal ba kun gyi rgyu/ /gang zhig 'dod pa 256

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/rnams la dga'/ /de yi sdug bsngal mtha' med do/ /'dod pa'i sbrul gyis zin pa la/ /bde ba rnams kyang ga la yod/ /ces dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'i nyan thos rnams kyis 'dul ba la bslab pa'i gzhi 'di ltar 'don pa bya ste/ 'bru'i chang dang /bcos pa'i chang / myos par 'gyur ba 'thung na ltung byed do/ /'bru'i chang zhes bya ba ni chan gyi btung ba dang / phye'i btung ba dang / phab kyi btung ba'o/ /bcos pa'i chang zhes bya ba ni rtsa ba'i btung ba dang / sdong bu'i btung ba dang / 'dab ma'i btung ba dang / me tog gi btung ba dang / 'bras bu'i btung ba'o/ /de gnyis ka bsres pa ni 'bru'i chang dang bcos pa'i chang zhes bya'o/ /de 'thung na zhes bya ba ni mgul du mid na'o/ /ltung byed do zhes bya ba ni sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro yi dwags ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba dag tu sreg par byed/ 'tshed par byed/ltung bar byed pa'o/ /gzhan yang ji srid du ltung ba de ma bshags shing so sor ma bshags na dge ba'i chos rnams la sgrib par byed pa ste/ ltung byed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sngon bud med cig gis 257

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/chang bum pa gang lag na khyer ra gcig khrid nas btsun pa zhig la khyod kyis chang 'di thungs shig yang na ra 'di sod cig yang na nga la log par spyod cig de ltar ma byas na kho mo shi'o zer skad/btsun pa de'i bsam pa la kho mo la spyad na sdom pa shor yong / ra 'di bsad na srog gcod kyi nyes pa shin tu che/ de bas chang 'di 'thung na cung drag bsam nas chang bum pa gang bo 'thung bas kho bo ra bzi nas bud med de la log par spyad/ ra de yang bsad pas nyes pa gsum ga byung zhing / chang 'dis ni 'dod chags la sogs pa bskyed par byed cing chang 'thung nas ngo che sgril de rang gi tshe 'di'i ma la yang chags pa spyad pa la the tshom med cing / khyad par btsun pa rnams chos mgo mi thon pa phal cher chang la brten nas 'phung ba sha stag yin pa ni kho bo'i rang yul gong bo'i btsun pa phal cher la bltas na shes par 'dug go /der ma zad chang 'dis zhe sdang bskyed pa yang shin tu mthu che ste/ sngon bud med cig skyes pa gzhan zhig dang ja chang byed pa la kho mo'i sngar gyi skyes pa de chang gis bzi nas yong bas zhe sdang skyes nas bud med dang 258

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/ skyes pa gnyis ka bsad nas rang gi khyim yang me la bsregs par byas zer ba sogs gtam rgyud shin tu mang bas nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba chang 'di ni rnam pa kun tu spang ba gal che'o/ /gsum pa sgog skya sogs kyi nyes pa bshad pa mi// 'di dang po gang nas byung tshul ni/ sngon lha dang lha ma yin bdud rtsi 'dod cing mi mthun pas 'thab pa na lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin gyi ske tshangs pa'i 'khor los bregs pa'i khrag gi thigs pa sar lhung ba las sgog pa'i rigs sgog skya gtsor gyur pa byung bar bshad cing / de'i rigs la sgog skya dang / sgog pa'i rigs dang /btsong dang / ri sgog brag sgog rgya sgog rlung sgog bye'u sgog kun dong gi rigs la sogs pa'o/ /'dul ba lung las/ sgog skya dang /kun dong dang / ke'u dag za bar mi bya'o/ /rtse mo las kyang / sha dang chang dang btsong la sogs/ /dri ngan kha yi sgregs pa dang / /'khris pa 'dod dang bstan pa dang / /sems can tshe la dga' mi bya/ /zhes dang / sngon dge slong zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa la kha mi lta bar kha gzhan du lta bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 259

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/kun dga' bo la de gang yin gsungs pas/ btsun pa dge slong des sgog skya 'tshal to/ /zhes zhus pas/ kun dga' bo gal te dge slong 'dis de ring sgog skya zos par ma gyur na da lta nyid du 'dis 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu mtho ba ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo de lta bas de phyin chad sgog skya dang /kun dong dang / ke'u yongs su longs spyad par mi bya ste/ yongs su longs spyod na 'gal tshab can du 'gyur ro/ /ngas dge slong sgog skya za ba'i kun tu spyad pa'i chos bca' bar bya ste/ dge slong sgog skya za bas sgog skya za bzhin du gtsug lag khang la yongs su longs spyod par mi bya/ gnas mal la ma yin/ dge 'dun gyi nang du 'gro bar mi bya/ bram ze dang khyim bdag 'ongs shing lhag pa rnams la chos bstan par mi bya/ mchod rten la phyag mi bya/ bram ze dang khyim bdag rnams kyi khyim du nye bar 'gro bar mi bya/ skyed mo'i tshal dang / tshogs khang dang / lha khang dang / skye bos gang ba gzhan dag tu gnas par mi bya'o/ /nad la sogs pa dgos pa'i phyir yod 260

tha ma kha dang / myos byed/ sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/na za bar bya'o/ /gang gi tshe bya ba zin par gyur pa de'i tshe phyogs de nyid zhag bdun 'dug par bya'o/ /kun dong ni zhag gsum/ ke'u ni zhag gcig go /de nas khrus byas la chos gos dag kyang bkru bar bya zhing bdug pa dag gis bdugs par bya'o/ /sgog skya za ba'i dge slong gis kun tu bcas pa'i ji ltar bcas pa rnams yang dag par blang ste/ mi gnas na 'gal tshab can du 'gyur ro/ /zhes sdom pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis za mi rung ba dang / nad la phan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba yin kyang gtan du za mi rung ba'i lha khang sogs kyi drung du zhag grangs ma song bar du 'gro mi chog pa sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis gsungs shing de dag la/ yid ches par byas nas spang dgos so/ /'ga' zhig nas las 'bras khyad du gsad nas rten gyi drung du sgog btsong sogs bag med du longs spyad nas dge 'dun gyi dbus su kho bos sgog btsong sogs za gi yod cing khyed cag tsho yang zos na rlung la phan par 'gyur ro zhes lam ngan du 'khrid pa de ni kho bo ni dmyal bar 'gro ba yin cing /khyed cag tsho yang mnyam du 'gro zer ba'i dpe bzhin bdud kyi 261

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/grogs po yin par go bar gyis shig 'o na sman gzhung rnams su sgog sna'i phan yon gsungs 'dug pas/ de dag zos na nyes pa mi 'gyur snyam na/ de ltar gsungs pa nad la phan pa'i slad gsungs pa yin cing / de ltar ma yin na sman gzhung rnams su btsan dug sbyar ba bshad yod pas/ rgyun du btsan dug zos na phan gnod gang yong rang gi sems la bya ra byas nas gzhan dag 'phung la ma sbyar ba gal che'o/ /zhar byung sna tha kha zer ba 'di ni dang po gang nas byung bar gsung rab dang bla ma'i zhal nas dngos su ma thos na'ang nyes tshab che bas gsung tshul la dpag na/ tha ma kha dang phyogs mtshungs pa yin 'dra zhing / bdag gi bla ma rnams kyis sna tha kha zer ba 'di'i du ba'am dris rtsa thams cad 'gag par byed cing rtsa kha 'byed mi nus shing / rtsa rlung thig le dang 'pho ba la sogs pa mi sbyong ba dang /du ba'am dri des lha klu sogs la phog thug che zhing / khyad par bsnyen sgrub sogs ji ltar bgyis kyang yi dam gyi lha dang je ring 'gro ba ma gtogs lha 'grub pa'i skal ba med cing / sngags ji ltar 262

tha ma kha dang /myos byed/sgog btsong bcas pa'i nyes dmigs gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/bgrangs kyang 'bras bu mi 'grub pa dang / mkhris pa'i gtso byas pa'i nad mang po bskyed nas sman bcos sogs kyi bya thabs bra la zhing 'ga' zhig sna tha kha 'then ches nas mig long ba sogs gtam rgyud mang zhing / rnam smin gyi 'bras bur tshe phyi mar ngan song gi sdug bsngal drag po myong dgos par gsungs pas/ don de dag la dgongs nas da lta rgyud stod smad sogs dgon sde 'ga' zhig tu sna tha kha la do dam shin tu che bar mdzad pa ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i thabs kho nar 'bad pa yin 'dug cing / sngon du bdag gi bla ma gtsang gi shar rtse mkhan po dbus su phebs nas bka' chos gnang skabs/ grwa ba rnams nas sna tha kha bag med du chos nyan pa'i tshe longs spyod pas bla ma rin po che thugs khro ba'i tshul gyis bdag tsho'i gtsang gi btsun pa rnams kyis chang la bag med du spyad/ dbus kyi btsun pa rnams kyis sna tha kha bag med du spyad gsungs bkas bkyon par mdzad pa 'di dag la sems na nyes tshabs shin tu che ba yin 'dug pas sangs rgyas kyi bcas pa ni ma gnang snyam nas bag med du longs spyod par mi bya'o/ /tshoms 263

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/las/ sdig pa shin tu chung ngu la'ang / /mi gnod snyam du brnyas mi bya/ /chu yi thigs pa bsags pas kyang / /snod chen khad kyis gang bar 'gyur/ /zhes dge ba phra mo nas sgrub cing / mi dge ba phra mo nas spangs dgos shing / nyes byas phra mor gtogs pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam smin la pham pa las kyang lci ba yang yod par gsungs pas/rang cag rnams da len rnyed par dka' ba'i mi lus rin po che thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang khyad par rje tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa dang mjal/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ blang dor gyi bya gzhag shes pa'i dus 'dir ma le sor gsum kha la bcug nas da len yod na yod pa yin/ da len med na med pa yin zer ba'i dpe bzhin snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan pa zhig da lta nyid du bya dgos so/ /kye ma/ snyigs dus bdud kyi bar chad ches mang ba'i/ /lhag par zas ngan 'di rnams 'phung tshabs che/ /tha ma khas ni 'dod chags bskyed par byed/ /chang gis zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba byed/ /sgog skya sogs kyis gti mug bskyed par byed/ /gsum 264

thamakhadang/myosabyed/gausabatsongabacas pa'i nyes dmigs gsalabarastonapazhesabyang /wags dug gsum so sor spel bar byed/ /tshul 'di shes par byas nas ma spangs na/ /phyugs dang khyad par med de go bar gyis shig /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla mas 'bral med rjes bzung ste/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin nas/ /sku gsum go 'phang myur du thob par shog /bskal bzang zhing 'di'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /thugs bskyed mdzad 'phrin smon lam yongs bzlums sku/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rje btsun bla ma mchog /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o/ /gang gi gsang gsum mdzad 'phrin mtha' klas pas/ /snyigs dus skye bo'i bag med spyod ngan zas/ /gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gog pa'i sman mchog dang / /mtshungs pa'i bka' bstan dgongs bsdus snying po 'di/ /nor gling rtag brtan pho brang gad dar ba/ /dad dam dge 'dun mtshungs med lhag bsam las/ /chos sbyin mi 'dzad par bskrun dge ba des/ /rgyal bstan mi nyams dar rgyas yun gnas shog //de 'dzin skyes chen sku tshe brtan pa dang / /rlabs chen thugs bskyed mdzad 'phrin 'od snang gis/ /sa gsum yongs la phan 265

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bde'i rdzogs ldan 'bras/ /longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston mchog stsol shog /bslab ldan dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing / /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bag dang ldan gyur nas/ /legs nyes dge sdig blang dor bya ba la/ /'jug ldog nam yang lhod med spyod par shog /ces pa 'di ni chos bzang bla ma rin po che'i gsung 'bum ga pa nang nas zur du phyungs pa'o/ /bslu med ston pa mchog des 'gro ba la/ /chang ni bag med kun gyi rtsa bar gsungs/ /sna tha tha ma kha yang de bzhin te/ /nad dang byur sna 'dren cing dge phyogs 'grib/ /de phyir nyes pa'i chu lon zhal gdams 'di/ /lhag bsam dag pas par du bskrun pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang 'gro kun bag med las bzlog ste/ /spyod pa bzang po'i ngang tshul lhur len shog /tshe rabs kun tu bag yod la goms shing / /yon tan yar ngo'i ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin/ /gong nas gong 'phel gang ba yongs rdzogs te/ /blang dor gsal ba'i byed por 'gyur bar shog /ces pa 'di yang jo lags dpal ldan nas par bskrun gnang skabs ser lho chos ming pas smon pa dge /sarba maṅga lo/ /266

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /nom chi mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis mdzad/gsang gsum yon tan rmad byung 'dab brgya ba/ /bzhad pa'i dge legs sbrang rtsi'i snying po'i bcud/ /skal bzang bung ba'i tshogs kyi nyer 'tshor grub/ /dpal ldan bla mas bkra shis mchog 495 cig /rigs gsum gcig bsdus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin mdzad blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /la sogs rim byon mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs/ /gus pas mchod do rnam kun rjes su zungs/ /dal ba'i rten bzang don ldan bya ba'i phyir/ /rgyal ba'i lam bzang bsgrub par 'dod rnams la/ /thog ma bar dang tha mar phan pa'i gtam / /267

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/slob gnyer bslab bya 'dir brjod nyon cig ang / /nang rkyen dal 'byor mi lus thob pa'i skabs/ /phyi rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa dgos/ /phyi nang mthun rkyen 'dzoms thabs thog mar gces/ /legs tshogs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yin no ang / /bla mas gang legs mdzad tshe dad pa byed/ /skyon la reg tshe kha drin tshun chad brtsi/ /dad pa gting khul skyon med ma skyes phyir/ / mi ldog dad pa'i rgyu tshogs bskyed cig ang / /bla mar skyon rtog skur 'debs bka' dang 'gal/ /nyes tshogs gang bgyis bshags sdom ma byas na/ /yon tan yar bskyed med cing sngar yod nyams/ /nyes dmigs shin tu che bas sgrims shig ang / /khong khror spyir 'dzem khyad par yul gnyan la/ /khros pa'i nyes dmigs shin tu lci gsungs pas/ /khro yul dag la 'khon 'dzin chung byas te/ /268

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/dge rtsa chud mi za bar 'bungs shig ang / /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rten bzang po/ /phyin chad 'di 'dra 'thob par ches dka' bas/ /snying po len tshul ngo bo go rim sogs/ /ma nor ched du thos bsam gyis shig ang / /gzhon lus lang tsho ston ka'i me tog 'dra/ /myur bar mi rtag bad kyis 'khyer 'gyur bas//ma khyer gong du gus rtag brtson 'grus gyis/ /rdo rus thug pa'i slob gnyer gyis shig ang / /ngan song sdug bsngal myong ba rang steng babs/ /de tshe lus dang sems kyis ji ltar bzod/ /skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya las 'bras bsam tshul sogs/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas tshags chud byos shig ang / /mi dag kho na bshad pa dang po'i dus/ /mtshams shig dag dang mi dag spel mar 'ong / /rjes nas yun gyis je bzang je dag 'gro/ /269

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dang po bslab tshul de ltar min no ang / /dang po dag nas dag mo smra mi nus/ /mi dag smra bas dgos pa ci yod snyam/ /kha rog bsdad pas yar bskyed mi thon pas/ /rjes bzlas tshun gyis ca co sgrogs shig ang / /sor mo lnga la ring thung yod pa bzhin/ /rang rang blo stobs bzang ngan 'byung 'gyur bas/ /blo kha dma' na yi chad mi bya zhing / /mtho na nga rgyal rgyags la 'dzem zhig ang / /shes rab bskyed phyir 'jam dbyangs zhi khro 'am/ /dbyangs ldan lha mo ārya tā re ma/ /la sogs lhag pa'i lha ru bsten byas te/ /bsnyen pa ched du 'khyol bar sgrubs shig ang / /ma sha'i sbyor ba dbyangs can ril bu sogs/ /yid ches dad pas bsgrubs na ches blun yang / /dngos grub ji ltar 'tshams par thob gyur pas/ /270

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/bden gsungs bka' la bslu ba med do ang / /mthun rkyen tshang yang thos gral 'jug mi 'dod/ /zhugs kyang tshul bzhin bslab la g.yel ba dang / / bslabs kyang bzang grags snyems pa'i dbang song rnams/ /grogs ngan dbang ngam las kyis mnar ro ang / /mi lus thob kyang yon tan mi slob na/ /mi shes rmongs rgan gral du tshud 'gyur bas/ /mi shes shes mgo'i rang tshugs ma 'dzin par/ /mi shes tshe na lhag par slobs shig ang / /da skabs lo chung nyams len dus min te/ /rig pa kho na bslab sbyang bya dgos zer/ /'di la mi rton tshe srog long med phyir/ /nyams len skor yang 'dris su tshugs shig ang / /gang tshe slob gnyer rnal ma bya 'dod tshe/ /zas gos gya nom bzang dgu mi sems par /srog 'tsho tsam gyis chos kyi ro myangs nas/ /271

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'di phyi'i don chen sgrubs par gyis shig ang / /slob gnyer sbyong skabs kha ton phyag skor dang / /bsnyen mtshams chu mchod smyung gnas grangs mang po/ /sgra snyan sman rtsis rgyun skyong ri khrod zhu/ /slob gnyer gegs su ngos zin gyis shig ang / /bzhon pa zas gos bzang dang khe spogs thob/ /rgyu rdzas nor mang grong chog lag 'ong bzang / /sos dal skyid por 'dug sogs mthong rkyen gyis/ /bslab sbyang bya 'dod blo sna ma 'gyur ang / /rig blo rnon pos brdar sha chod nges rigs/ /mi shes rigs lam thos gnon mi mdzad par/ /rang gis gang shes gzhan la g.yo med ston/ /rgyud drang rang bzhin bzang brtan dkon no ang / /phyi bltas rno bas rigs can yin 'drar snang / /nang bltas gzhan mgo bskor ba'i thabs tsam dang / /g.yo sgyus mkhas pa'i ngag sgros brku ba can/ /272

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/'di 'dra'i gral du chud dam rtog cig ang / /dag snang sbyong skal gus sems che 'dra bo/ /rkyen phrad gzhan skyon rtogs pa shugs che bas/ /pha rol dag gi yon tan mthong dka' zhing / /cung shes nga rgyal rgyu ru 'gyur ro ang / /dang po rang blo rno bas shes so zer/ /bar du cung zad shes kyang zil gnon gtong / /tha mar mkhas pa su yang khas mi len/ /'di 'dra brtag la 'dor byar gyis shig ang / /dbang po rtul bas ci yang mi go yang / /yang yang brtson pas dpe cha ma bral na/ /'dus byas so na mi sdod je bzang 'gro/ /brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin sten cig ang / /zab gsal che myur shes rab 'phel ba'i sgo/ /gzhung bzang nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i gru/ /'jam dbyangs mngon sum nyid du bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /273

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bsdus pa'i grwa la thog mar sbyongs shig ang / /phyogs glang grags pa'i gzhung lugs gnam ru'i rgyud/ /shes brtson sor mos nyer bkug dgag sgrub mdas/ /phas rgol snying la 'jigs pa ster byed pa/ /lugs bzang bsten la dga' bar gyis shig ang / /shes bya thams cad gzhi lnga'i chings kyis bsdu/ /rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ma lus gsal bar ston/ /kun bya chos la blang dor bgyid pa'i mig /mngon pa'i chos tshul rtogs 'dod skyed cig ang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bgrang yas bskal pa ru/ /rlabs chen dge legs bskrun pa las 'khrungs pa/ /zab mo sher phyin gsung mchog chos kyi dung / /nyan bsam byed 'dod skal bzang sgrubs shig ang / /klu yi zhabs sogs rigs 'phrul du ma'i sgos/ /shing rta'i srol phyes legs par gtan phab pa'i/ /bdag med rnam gnyis mtha' bral stong pa nyid/ /274

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/ston mdzad dbu ma'i gzhung la slobs shig ang / /thar pa'i them skas srid las sgrol ba'i gru/ /nyon mongs gdung sel tshul 'chal gdug pa'i sman/ /kun mkhyen bslab gzhi ston bstan nyid kyi phyir/ /rgyun du gus pas tshul bzhin sten cig ang / /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi tshig don la/ /thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i shes rab kyis/ /zab rgyas gnad don legs par rtogs pa zhig /nam zhig 'ong snyam bsam pa skyed cig ang / /dpe cha blor 'dzin nyan bsam sgom gsum sogs/ /gang byed tshe na blo mthu chung ba'i dus/ /zhing gi mthu la bsten pa man ngag ste/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong legs par gyis shig ang / /sdig pa'i grogs kyis phan pa'i zol gyis bslu/ /sha tsha'i tshig smra 'jig rten las la sbyor/ /yun gyis chos dang bla mar rgyang ring byed/ / 275

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/shes par gyis la dug bzhin spongs shig ang / /phyogs nas bsags na sprang po zas kyis 'grang / /zer ba'i dpe bzhin blo kha gang mtho las /blo bskyed gang lon bre bsog phul bsog bya/ /brjed ngas rkun por ma shor sgrims shig ang / /'jigs rung 'khor pa'i gnas las ma thar phyin/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i tshul bsams te/ /rnam dag nges 'byung bsam pa shugs drag pos/ /thar pa don du gnyer la 'bod cig ang / /'gro rnams bzod dka'i sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs/ /de dag sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las sgrol te/ /bde ba bla med byang chub 'god 'dod kyi/ /sems mchog bcos min yang dag bskyed cig ang / /de nas phyin drug nyams len bsdu bzhi yi/ / 'gro don khyad par gsang chen chos sgor zhugs/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i yongs rdzogs bstan pa la/ /276

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/bag chags ci thebs gus pas slobs shig ang / /slob gnyer bslab bya ang yig so bdun can/ /blo gsal 'jug ngogs dam pa'i phyag bzhes te/ /dal rten snying po len pa'i thabs su gces/ /ngag dbang ming can bkod do dge legs 'phel/ /oṃ swa snyi/ /dpal khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / /dbyer med kyi bla ma drin can rje/ /mchog gsum po kun 'dus gtsug gi rgyan//'bral med du rjes su bzung du gsol/ /dal 'byor ni rnyed dka' don che zhing / /yun ring du mi gnas blos dran pas/ /tshe don ldan du bya 'dod rgyun du bsten/ /rnam dkar la gzhol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dkar nag gi las 'bras bsam mi khyab/ /blang dor la tshul bzhin brtson pa'i sgos/ /277

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad de/ /ngan song gi skye sgo gcod byin rlobs/ /thar med kyi srid mtsho chen po las/ /thar 'dod kyi bsam pa shugs drag pos/ /thar lam la ring du 'dris byas te/ /thar pa yi btsan sa bsnyegs byin rlobs/ /rgyud byang chub sems kyi sa zin nas/ /lam phar phyin drug dang bsdu ba bzhi/ /dpal byang chub chen po'i nyams len la/ /dus rgyun du gzhol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam zab mo nges pa'i shes rab kyis/ /don gshis lugs phu thag chod pa zhig /lam gol bar ma song 'khrul med nges/ /dpal klu sgrub dgongs don rtogs byin rlobs/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud rgyal sogs/ /mgon sangs rgyas las kyang rnyed dka' ba'i/ /278

slob gnyer bslab bya blo gsal 'jug ngogs/rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i lam/ /chig dril du bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus nam mkha' zad par ma gyur pas/ /don 'gro ba kun gyi re skong phyir/ /dpal mthar thug zung 'jug yid bzhin nor/ /bde blag tu thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag chung ngu'i dus nas da lta'i bar/ /chos gang shes bla ma'i drin las byung / /don de phyir dge rtsa gang bsags 'di/ /dpal bla ma'i rjes 'dzin rgyu ru bsngo/ /zhes dgon gsar btab kyi dar rgyas chos 'phel gling la phyin chad nyams len gyi rim pa mi nor ba'i slad du rje bla ma'i mdo sngags lam rim gyi gnad don snying por bsdus te phyogs tsam ma nor bar gdams pa thar 'dod 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ nom chi mkhan po ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rab rgyal lcags 'brug lor sbyar pa dge legs 'phel/ /279
